title: Opus Motion Library — props schemas
description: One JSON Schema per motion id describing its `props`. Generated by cli/gen-schemas.mjs from catalog.json.

accum-render-3d.title: Accumulation render 3D — props
accum-render-3d.description: Film-quality three.js frames by brute force: every frame is rendered N times with sub-pixel camera jitter (anti-aliasing), a jittered sun (soft area shadows) and sub-frame time offsets (true motion blur), then averaged in a float buffer — shown on a candy studio scene with a fast-spinning torus knot and an orbiting chrome ball, optionally split against the raw 1-sample render.

samples.description: renders averaged per frame (render-time; preview always uses 2)

shutter.description: shutter fraction of a frame covered by the sub-frame samples (0–1)

sunJitter.description: sun position jitter in world units (soft shadow size)

spin.description: torus-knot spin speed (rad/s) — faster = more visible motion blur

compare.description: split screen: left = 1 sample, right = accumulated

seed.description: unused variation seed (kept for spec compatibility)

title.description: heading at the top of the frame (shown when labels is on)

x-opus.useFor: A Blender-like finish for 3D shots and a drop-in AccumPass pattern (copy the component) for any three.js motion that needs real motion blur and soft shadows; preview uses 2 samples, renders use all.

book-open-3d.title: Book open 3D — props
book-open-3d.description: A closed cloth hardback on a felt desk mat swings its cover open round the spine, two leaves turn over with a bend, and the camera pushes in and levels out onto a lesson spread whose figure then draws itself in ink.

coverTitle.description: title on the cover and the title page

coverArt.description: optional image for the cover inset (public/ path or URL); procedural ink jar drawing if empty

lessonEyebrow.description: small caps eyebrow on the left page

lessonBody.description: body paragraph on the left page
lessonBody.default: Energy is never made or lost. It sits in stores and moves between them whenever something happens: a fall, a push, a spark.

equation.description: boxed italic equation on the left page ("" hides)

figureCaption.description: italic caption under the right-page figure
figureCaption.default: Fig. 1  Eight things, each with a store of its own.

figureSrc.description: optional image for the right-page figure; procedural ink rack drawing (drawn on) if empty

contents.description: chapter titles on the contents leaf

editionLabel.description: small caps line at the foot of the title page

prefaceEyebrow.description: small caps eyebrow on the preface leaf

prefaceTitle.description: italic heading on the preface leaf

hintLabel.description: small caps label of the taped hint card on the left page

hintTitle.description: bold line on the hint card
hintTitle.default: Lift the flap after you guess

hintNote.description: handwritten note at the foot of the hint card

turns.description: leaves that turn after the cover (0-2)

openAt.description: frame the cover starts to open (source 0.40 s)

speed.description: timing multiplier for everything after openAt (1 = source)

x-opus.useFor: Textbook, storybook or "chapter 1" openers; education products; any brand story told as a book.

brick-collapse-physics.title: Brick collapse physics — props
brick-collapse-physics.description: A built brick tower creaks, tips about its base edge and breaks into independent bricks that bounce with restitution 0.3 and settle flat; the camera shakes on impact and tilts down to the rubble. Deterministic pre-simulated rigid bodies, bricks stepped at 12 fps.

caption.description: subtitle pill after the dust settles (empty = none)
caption.default: Well. Back to the drawing board.

x-opus.useFor: Failure / pivot beats, "break it to rebuild it", playful destruction before a rebuild.

brick-fx-fire-smoke.title: Brick FX: fire & smoke — props
brick-fx-fire-smoke.description: Stop-motion brick VFX on a toy rocket launch: the flame is 8–20 translucent orange round plates re-seeded every drawing at 12 fps, the smoke is white round bricks that grow and roll outward — no particles, no gradients — as the rocket shivers and lifts off.

kind.description: fire = flame + smoke, smoke = smoke only, water = cool splash plates + smoke

liftAt.description: frame the rocket lifts off (ignition 12 frames earlier)

caption.description: subtitle pill (empty = none)
caption.default: And every launch starts with one brick.

stepFps.description: stop-motion re-seed rate of the flame drawings

x-opus.useFor: Launch beats, "we have lift-off", stop-motion VFX vocabulary reusable across brick / clay / papercraft looks.

brick-rebuild-morph.title: Brick rebuild morph — props
brick-rebuild-morph.description: The same set of glossy toy bricks lifts off one word and reassembles into a different one: bricks matched by size and colour arc across on staggered 8ths and snap on landing, with spare bricks flying in from bins behind the baseplate.

captionFrom.description: subtitle shown with the first word
captionFrom.default: It spelled one thing for years…

x-opus.useFor: Transformation stories in a playful material: career change, before/after, rebrand, a word re-spelled.

brick-snap-build.title: Brick snap build — props
brick-snap-build.description: Stop-motion macro toy bricks fly in on arcs, one per beat, and click into place with a tiny overshoot, stacking into a word (or custom voxel list) on a studded baseplate; bricks step at 12 fps while the camera glides on ones.

text.description: word built from bricks via a 5×7 pixel font (A–Z 0–9, ♥)

bricks.description: custom brick list [{x,y,z,w,d,h,color}] in stud units (y up, h 1.2 = brick); overrides text

colorBy.description: letter = one colour per letter, row = per row stripes, random = scattered

stepFps.description: stop-motion stepping of brick movement (12 = on twos at 24)

caption.description: subtitle pill under the build (empty = none)

x-opus.useFor: "Built from the ground up" brand / product / logo builds, education and kids' content, countdowns.

chart-to-installation.title: Chart to installation (crane to top view) — props
chart-to-installation.description: Two series of physical plate stacks spiral around a walnut dial; the camera tracks the spiral while they assemble, then cranes back and up to a ~70° top view where the stacks read as one data sculpture and the inlaid tick ring and years become the typography, with an end card beside it.

labels.description: period labels inlaid on the dial (one per stack pair)

materialA.description: aluminium | acrylic | brass | oak | stone | copper

materialB.description: aluminium | acrylic | brass | oak | stone | copper

kicker.description: tracked caps line above the title

verdict.description: accent verdict line under the rule

craneAt.description: frame the 4 s crane to the top view starts

x-opus.useFor: Signature ending / summary shot for any physical-data film: a decade of values revealed as one installation.

cloner-bed-ripple.title: Cloner bed ripple — props
cloner-bed-ripple.description: A dense pin-art bed of glossy two-tone candy capsules in soft pastel studio light; effector bands roll across it raising and tilting the pills along the height gradient, and timed impacts send damped ripple rings racing outward — a satisfying C4D-cloner ASMR field.

sweeps.description: how many effector bands roll through

x-opus.useFor: Satisfying backdrop or floor for product idents, logo stings and hero sections; pair with jelly-type-drop for the full candy ident.

colour-ignition-wave.title: Colour ignition wave — props
colour-ignition-wave.description: A matte white clay isometric city waits; the exposure dips, the hero tower flashes and a cyan pulse ring races out across the ground — as it reaches each object, colour climbs its facade from the ground behind a thin bright scan line, empty tiles hop and flip to their coloured undersides, windows light and the camera kicks.

map.description: rows of map chars (see iso-city-build): r road, b block, p plaza, c core, w water, t tree, h house, s solar, u turbine, g grass

origin.description: [x, z] grid offset from the centre where the pulse starts

speed.description: pulse front speed in tiles per second

climbSpeed.description: how fast colour climbs a facade (tiles per second)

x-opus.useFor: A universal "before → after / switched on / launch" hero moment for product, city, platform and data dioramas.

exploded-stack.title: Exploded stack (teardown 3D) — props
exploded-stack.description: A stack of five flat layers (base, battery, board with chips, keyboard with keycaps, glass top) sits on a dark seamless; they lift apart top-first with a stagger while the keys and chips ripple up, the camera orbits and a leader-line label column cascades in; hold with a gentle float, then it closes bottom-first with each part landing with a tiny mechanical dip.

layers.description: bottom to top: name, spec, w, d, h (3D units), colour, optional src image on top face, optional parts grid (cols, rows, size, height, colour)

openAt.description: frame the top layer starts to lift

closeAt.description: frame the bottom layer starts to close

wave.description: frames the part ripple takes to cross a surface

orbitFrom.description: camera azimuth at the start, degrees

x-opus.useFor: Hardware launches, "what is inside" explainers, layered architecture (UI, API, DB as slabs), feature stacks on landing pages; any product screenshot can be one layer via src.

exploded-view-3d.title: Exploded view (3D parts, labels, cutaway) — props
exploded-view-3d.description: A real three.js assembly (end cap, battery, circuit board with chips, motor, shaft, spinning gear, front plate inside a hollow housing sleeve) lit by a studio environment separates part by part along its axis with a 3-frame stagger while the camera orbits and numbered leader-line labels project from the 3D parts, then reassembles; the cutaway variant stays closed and a clip plane slices the shell open.

parts.description: [{name, spec?, mesh:"box|cyl|tube|gear|board|sphere|ring", pos:[x,y,z], size:[...], dir:[dx,dy,dz], dist, color, spin?, shell?, metal?}] x is the assembly axis; size = box [x,y,z], cyl [radius,length], tube [outerR,length,innerR], gear [R,thickness,teeth]

variant.description: 'explode' (parts separate) | 'cutaway' (closed assembly, shell parts sliced open by a clip plane)

x-opus-optionLabels.cutaway: closed assembly, shell parts sliced open by a clip plane

explodeAt.description: frame the first part starts to move (or the cut starts)

reassembleAt.description: frame the parts start coming back

orbitSpeed.description: camera orbit speed, degrees per second

sectionLabel.description: mono caption top-left while the cutaway is open

x-opus.useFor: Hardware launches, engineering and teaching explainers, "how it is made" and product feature call-outs. Replace `parts` (mesh box / cyl / tube / gear / board / sphere / ring) to explode your own object; the axis turns vertical in portrait.

faceted-sea.title: Faceted sea — props
faceted-sea.description: An endless low-poly ocean in orthographic view: every triangle glints on its own, a turquoise shallow rim and foam ring wrap a tiny hex islet that rises from the water, a boat bobs on the wave function, and the far water dissolves into a horizonless pastel sky while the light drifts from day to dusk.

timeStart.description: time of day at the start: dawn | day | dusk | night

timeEnd.description: time of day at the end (the light eases from start to end)

azimuthEnd.description: camera azimuth at the end (slow turntable)

elevation.description: camera elevation in degrees (25-35 day, 20-25 night, 50 map-like)

zoom.description: orthographic frustum height in world units (12-16 = island scale)

glint.description: sun specular strength on the facets (too high = white flashes)

islet.description: show the small hex islet (drives the shallow rim and foam)

boat.description: a small boat circling the islet

skyColor.description: sky zenith colour, '' = from the time of day (overrides the whole clip)

horizonColor.description: sky / haze colour at the horizon, '' = from the time of day

waterColor.description: deep water colour, '' = from the time of day

shallowColor.description: shallow rim water colour, '' = from the time of day

tree2Color.description: big pine upper cone / small pine lower foliage colour

x-opus.useFor: Calm 3D backdrop for island / travel / logistics / calm-brand heroes and diorama scenes; a looping website hero; put title words in HTML over it.

floating-devices-stack.title: Floating devices stack (3D laptop, tablet, phone) — props
floating-devices-stack.description: A real-3D laptop, tablet and phone rise into a layered, slightly rotated stack and float with a gentle sway, lit by a soft studio. Each screen shows your image (cover-fitted) or a generated app UI in your colours; an optional headline sits beside or above.

devices.description: device per slot, in order of importance (slot 0 is the hero): 'laptop' | 'tablet' | 'phone' (up to 5)

screens.description: screen images (public/ path or URL), one per device, cycled; empty = generated app UI in your colours

title.description: headline (\n for a line break; empty with an empty subtitle = devices only, centred)

background.description: background colour ('transparent' to composite over other content)

accent.description: brand colour (generated screens, headline bar, rim light)

darkScreens.description: generated screens use a dark theme

startAt.description: frame the first device starts rising

floatAmount.description: strength of the idle float / wobble (0 = still)

sway.description: degrees the camera swings around the stack across the clip

x-opus.useFor: App / SaaS launches, "works on every device" beats, store previews and landing-page heroes. Pass `screens` (your screenshots), `devices` order, brand colours and a `title`.

glass-strip-sweep.title: Glass strip-light sweep — props
glass-strip-sweep.description: A dark glass product in black space: a tall strip light passes behind the camera and its reflection slides across the object, drawing a thin white contour with rainbow fringing at the edges; between sweeps only side-strip silhouettes remain.

passes.description: start frames of each strip sweep

passFrames.description: frames one sweep takes (arc -1.35 to +1.35 rad)

dispersion.description: rainbow fringe strength (rad of environment offset per channel; 0 = off)

sideStrips.description: intensity of the permanent side strips that draw the silhouette

kicker.description: small tracked caps above the name

orbit.description: slow camera orbit amplitude in rad

x-opus.useFor: Premium product reveals for SaaS / hardware brands, app-icon glass hero, launch-film openers.

globe-3d.title: Globe (3D, day/night, arcs) — props
globe-3d.description: A shaded three.js Earth (procedural land and ocean, soft day/night terminator with warm city lights, atmosphere rim) turns slowly; glowing arcs lift off the surface and fly between cities along great circles with pulsing markers and name labels, then the camera swings to a focus lat/lon and zooms in with a coordinates caption.

points.description: [{name, lat, lon, color?}] markers (only points used by an arc get a marker/label)

arcs.description: [{from, to, at?, color?}] great-circle flights; from/to are point names or indexes, at = start frame

focus.description: {lat, lon, at, label?, zoom?} camera swings and zooms to this place from frame `at`; null = never

textureSrc.description: optional equirectangular day-map image (public/ path or URL); empty = procedural Earth

background.description: backdrop outer colour ("transparent" to overlay the globe on your own scene)

nightLights.description: show city lights on the night side

startLon.description: longitude facing the camera at frame 0

stars.description: draw a faint starfield behind the globe

size.description: globe size multiplier (1 = about 80% of the short side)

x-opus.useFor: Global reach stats, travel and logistics routes, climate and space explainers, "we ship worldwide" beats. Use `textureSrc` for a real equirectangular map; set `background: "transparent"` to overlay.

hex-island-grow.title: Hex island grow — props
hex-island-grow.description: A flat-shaded low-poly hex island builds itself in an orthographic turntable: tiles rise from a faceted sea with a splash ring and damped overshoot, houses stack floor by floor with bounce and squash and get prism roofs, trees pop, a windmill turns, lamps and windows light as the day drifts to dusk.

radius.description: island radius in hex rings (1-3); 2 = 19 tiles

buildings.description: number of houses (1-3 floors each, prism roofs)

lamps.description: number of lamp posts (glow at dusk)

boat.description: a boat sails around the island once it is built

bpm.description: build tempo: one tile per 16th note, floors per 8th

azimuthEnd.description: camera azimuth at the end (turntable sweep)

timeStart.description: time of day at the start: dawn | day | dusk | night

timeEnd.description: time of day at the end (windows light as it darkens)

palette.description: sand, sandSide, grass, earth, walls[], roofs[], pine[], leaves[] hex colours

x-opus.useFor: "Growth" stories — a startup year, city planning, community, a product ecosystem; a satisfying loop for websites; pair with the faceted-sea look.

holo-globe.title: Holographic globe — props
holo-globe.description: A wireframe Earth in cyan: coastlines draw on, a 10 degree graticule, fibonacci-dotted land, fresnel atmosphere, tilted orbit rings and a scan band; it turns onto a target, a beam and surface rings mark it, then the camera dives to a regional map with city dots and moving sea tracks.

turnAt.description: frame the globe starts turning onto the target (1 s hermite)

diveAt.description: frame of the dive into the regional map

dots.description: fibonacci sample count for the dotted land

cities.description: city dots on the regional map

tracks.description: moving sea tracks on the regional map

x-opus.useFor: Geo explainers, news intros, cyber / defence and logistics films. Pairs with target-lock and supply-route-map. transparent=true for an overlay.

holo-solid-ignite.title: Holo solid ignite — props
holo-solid-ignite.description: A cyan hologram wireframe builds up through a scan plane, then ignites into a translucent solid: faces fill with edge-bright Fresnel and scrolling interlace lines, a light wave climbs the model, lines thicken then settle, and a projector beam with rays and dust motes rises from the pad while it turntables.

igniteAt.description: frame the wireframe ignites into a solid

turns.description: turntable turns over the whole duration

background.description: stage colour, or "transparent" for an overlay

beam.description: projector beam with rays and dust

motes.description: number of dust motes in the beam

x-opus.useFor: The once-per-film "the whole thing is ready" launch beat for products, apps and logos.

iso-blocks-3d.title: Iso blocks (3D clay) — props
iso-blocks-3d.description: Soft clay isometric 3D bar chart: a white ball with eyes hops down the bars painting each top orange, slams onto the tiled floor with a ripple, rolls back and rides a rising pillar while the caps un-paint — a seamless loop with a follow camera.

values.description: bar heights in slabs (any series; the ball hops left to right)

grooveColor.description: colour of the gaps between tiles

ghost.description: cap colour at the moment of touchdown

hopHeight.description: hop arc height (world units, 1 = one cell)

zoomOut.description: camera zoom at the reveal (1 = close follow)

x-opus.useFor: Declining (or any) metric stories, step-by-step progress, playful looping data explainers in real 3D.

iso-city-build.title: Iso city build — props
iso-city-build.description: A pastel isometric island builds itself in true orthographic 3D: floor tiles fall in rings from the centre with spin, squash and a cyan rim flash, the soil slab slides under, buildings, houses, trees, solar fields and wind turbines grow along a sweep front with overshoot and lagged roofs, a navy hero tower stacks in segments and lights up, windows glow, cars loop the ring road, drones ferry packets, and the camera pulls back to float the island top-right.

map.description: rows of map chars: r road, b block, p plaza, c core (2x2 hero tower), w water, t tree, h house, s solar, u turbine, g grass

heroTower.description: stack the navy hero tower on the c cells

drones.description: drones carrying packets from the tower

pullback.description: camera pulls back at 7.75 s to leave room for a title

pullTo.description: where the island floats after the pull-back: top-right | center | top-left

x-opus.useFor: Smart-city, platform, ecosystem and architecture explainers; "watch it grow" openers; pass your own map rows and leave room for a title after the pull-back.

isometric-room-build.title: Isometric room build (3D furniture drop-in) — props
isometric-room-build.description: A cut-away isometric room builds itself: the plank floor grows, two walls rise with a window and framed art, then rug, sofa, table, shelf, desk, plant and lamp drop in one after another with a squash-and-settle while the camera drifts a few degrees.

furniture.description: pieces in drop order: 'rug' | 'sofa' | 'table' | 'shelf' | 'desk' | 'chair' | 'plant' | 'lamp' | 'bed' | 'tv' (each has a fixed spot in the room)

wallArt.description: picture on the left wall (public/ path or URL); empty = generated abstract art

title.description: headline (\n for a line break; empty with an empty subtitle = room only, centred)

subtitle.default: Piece by piece, room by room.

background.description: background colour ('transparent' to composite over other content)

accent.description: main furniture colour (sofa, screens, headline bar)

drift.description: degrees the camera swings while it builds

x-opus.useFor: Interior design, real estate, home / furniture e-commerce, "build your space" and game-lobby beats. Choose the `furniture` list, palette colours and `wallArt` image; add a `title`.

jelly-type-drop.title: Jelly type drop — props
jelly-type-drop.description: Inflated glossy candy letters fall one per beat into a soft bed of two-tone capsules, sink past the surface, wobble back up with jelly squash-and-stretch and fire a damped ripple ring through the pill field on every landing; a late wave can hop the whole word again in reading order.

text.description: the word (lowercase reads most candy-like, up to 10 letters)

beats.description: drop time in seconds per letter (cycles if shorter than the word)

relift.description: a late wave hops the letters again in reading order

seed.description: unused variation seed (kept for spec compatibility)

x-opus.useFor: Playful brand word reveals and candy idents; with cloner-bed-ripple gives the full C4D-ident look in the browser.

last-object-drop.title: Last object drop (engraved brass puck) — props
last-object-drop.description: A single brass puck engraved with the final number falls with gravity into the centre of a walnut dial ringed by plate stacks, unwinds its yaw, lands with one tiny damped bounce while its shadow tightens; the room dims for a breath before the hit and an accent verdict settles.

value.description: big engraved number on the puck face

topLine.description: small engraved line above the number (e.g. a year)

material.description: puck material: brass | copper | aluminium | stone | oak

dropAt.description: frame the fall starts (lands 15 frames later)

stacks.description: number of context stack pairs ringed around the dial (0 = bare dial)

caption.description: accent verdict line that settles after the landing

introLine.description: small spaced line at the top-left before the drop

x-opus.useFor: Totals, ratios and "target met" endings for data films; the one heavy object that closes the argument.

lidar-canopy-peel.title: Lidar canopy peel — props
lidar-canopy-peel.description: A dense teal-to-pale point-cloud forest. A horizontal cut plane steps down on the beat; returns above it lift, glow white and vanish, a bright rim marks where the plane meets the crowns, and a height ruler with a canopy-height histogram tracks the cut. Bare-earth scan stripes remain at the end. Procedural seeded forest, slow orbit camera.

cutKeys.description: cut-plane heights in metres, one step per entry (30 → 0)

stepFrames.description: frames per step (the move takes 45 % of it, then holds)

ramp.description: three height-ramp colours low → mid → high

x-opus.useFor: Archaeology / forestry / engineering reveals; "strip away the noise to find what matters" in product and brand stories.

light-beam-ribbon.title: Light beam ribbon — props
light-beam-ribbon.description: A soft volumetric beam sweeps like a clock hand from a lighthouse lamp over a night sea: a camera-facing additive ribbon with a Gaussian profile, a root-bright core and a wide halo, tilted 7 degrees down, while the faceted water under it lights in a band with per-facet sparkles. An overlay mode draws only the beam.

bpm.description: tempo used to time the sweep

beatsPerTurn.description: beats for one full 360 degree turn (12 = a slow clock hand)

startAngle.description: beam azimuth at frame 0 (degrees, ground plane)

tiltDeg.description: degrees the beam points below horizontal

lighthouse.description: draw the lighthouse the beam comes from

overlay.description: draw only the beam on a transparent background (host scene shows through)

timeStart.description: time of day at the start: dawn | day | dusk | night

timeEnd.description: time of day at the end

elevation.description: camera elevation (20-25 night shows more sky and stars)

x-opus.useFor: Night scenes, "spotlight on X", searching / discovery / guidance metaphors, lighthouse and projector beats; overlay mode sweeps a beam across any host scene.

liminal-corridor-3d.title: Liminal office corridor (3D) — props
liminal-corridor-3d.description: A handheld camcorder walks an endless, empty office of mustard wallpaper partitions on a 2.4 m grid under a drop ceiling of fluorescent troffers (a few dead, a few flickering), the far corridors fading into dark fog, one red EXIT sign far ahead and a REC / clock OSD.

seed.description: layout seed (partition placement, dead / flickering panels)

wallpaper.description: wallpaper colour (pool tile #9fc7c0, school #b9c49a for alternatives)

fogDensity.description: exponential fog density (higher = darker far corridors)

osd.description: camcorder REC / battery / clock / date overlay

osdLabel.description: camcorder on-screen-display label next to the red dot (osd: true)

x-opus.useFor: Liminal / uncanny backdrops for horror-lite, mystery, "corporate dread" satire and found-footage openers.

low-poly-terrain-flyover.title: Low-poly terrain flyover — props
low-poly-terrain-flyover.description: A seeded, flat-shaded low-poly island (mountains with snow caps, grass, sand, pine forests, a faceted sea and drifting clouds) under a gradient sky and fog, with the camera flying low across it (or circling it).

seed.description: island seed (any integer): a different landscape each time

sky.description: [zenith, horizon] sky colours (the horizon colour also tints fog)

seaLevel.description: raises (positive) or lowers (negative) the sea relative to the land (-0.15..0.2)

path.description: 'fly' (low pass across the island) | 'orbit' (circle around it)

speed.description: how much of the path is covered (1 = the whole path over the clip)

altitude.description: camera height above the ground (world units)

title.description: headline ("" with an empty subtitle = scene only)

x-opus.useFor: Travel and outdoors intros, game / world-building teasers, nature or sustainability titles, calm looping hero backdrops. Change `seed` for a new island, `palette` and `sky` for the mood (autumn, desert, arctic), `title` for the words.

ocean-surface-3d.title: Ocean surface 3D — props
ocean-surface-3d.description: A perspective sea built from Gerstner waves with analytic normals, fresnel sky reflection, sparkling sun glitter, crest foam and horizon fog under a gradient sky and sun glow; low-skim, high or drifting camera.

skyZenith.description: sky colour overhead (also what the sea reflects)

skyHorizon.description: sky + fog colour at the horizon

sunElevation.description: sun height above the horizon in degrees (low = long glitter path)

sunAzimuth.description: sun direction in degrees (0 = straight ahead)

title.description: optional serif title over the sea (empty = none)

x-opus.useFor: Travel, maritime and calm brand heroes, film openers, looping website backgrounds (put the words in HTML over it). For a stylised low-poly sea use faceted-sea instead.

orbiting-icons-sphere.title: Orbiting icons sphere — props
orbiting-icons-sphere.description: Icon (or logo) badges with labels cover a slowly rotating, tilted sphere: they pop out of a glossy core with a stagger, near-side badges are large and highlighted while far-side ones shrink, dim and pass behind the core. Latitude rings and a dotted shell give the globe form; a title sits on the core.

items.description: badge labels (1-40); the count sets how many badges cover the sphere

icons.description: glyph per badge: design | code | cloud | data | mail | chat | music | photo | map | pay | docs | video | bolt | star | heart | lock | user | globe (empty = pick from the label, else cycle)

images.description: logo / icon images per badge (public/ path or URL); overrides the glyph for that badge
images.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

title.description: text on the core (\n for a line break; "" for none)

background.description: background colour ('transparent' to composite over other content)

coreInk.description: title colour on the core (empty = auto contrast)

colors.description: badge colours, cycled

coreStyle.description: 'solid' (glossy core, hides the far side) | 'wire' (dark wireframe core) | 'none' (open globe)

x-opus-optionLabels.solid: glossy core, hides the far side

showLabels.description: show the text label under each badge

dots.description: number of dots in the shell (0 = none)

x-opus.useFor: Integrations / "works with" walls, feature or skills clouds, ecosystem and partner beats, community and category hubs. Pass `items` (labels), optional `icons` names or `images` (logos) and brand `colors`.

particle-shape-morph.title: Particle shape morph — props
particle-shape-morph.description: A title glyph dissolves into ≈ 5 k sand-like particles that sweep (left first) into a rotating Fibonacci sphere around a red core, open into a tilted spinning torus, then collapse into a tiny glowing core with an orange bloom, while a mono caption tracks N and the stage.

text.description: word the particles start as (sampled from the rendered font)

shapes.description: shape sequence: glyph | sphere | torus | ring | cube (glyph only makes sense first)

holdFrames.description: frames each shape holds (the first glyph holds half of it)

morphFrames.description: frames per morph (glyph → first shape is 20 % longer, swept left to right)

collapse.description: end by collapsing everything into the glowing core

colors.description: particle colours

rotation.description: rotation speed of the 3D shapes in degrees per second

captions.description: show the mono "N = … · A → B" caption

x-opus.useFor: "Ideas / data take shape" beats, logo-to-particle intros, tech-product hero loops; the collapse hands off to a shockwave or flash transition.

plan-tilt.title: Plan tilt to 3D — props
plan-tilt.description: An ink floor plan draws on top-down, then the camera tilts to eye level as the walls extrude into a 3D line drawing, dollies through the front door, and cranes back up until it reads as the plan again.

walls.description: wall segments [x1, z1, x2, z2] in metres (gaps = openings)

rooms.description: floor labels {name, x, z, w, d} (w×d prints the area string)

furniture.description: extruded blocks {x, z, w, d, h}

doors.description: door swings {x, z, r, a0} (hinge point, radius, start angle)

entrance.description: [x, z] of the front door the camera tilts to and walks through

wallHeight.description: wall height in metres after extrusion

accent.description: accent colour (last title line, construction line)

kicker.description: small mono line above the headline

showTitle.description: show the headline over the plan

walkIn.description: dolly through the doorway before craning back up

mode.description: 'tour' (default: tilt, walk in, crane back) or 'popup' (the flat line drawing rises off the page into a 3D ink model, camera tilts to an oblique and orbits)

popupFrames.description: popup mode: frames each wall/object takes to rise (with paper-pop overshoot)

pageGhost.description: popup mode: opacity of the flat wall footprints left on the page (0-1)

x-opus.useFor: Architecture, product or system explainers: show that the diagram and the 3D thing are the same; walk into a space.

plinth-progress-ring.title: Plinth progress ring — props
plinth-progress-ring.description: A round matte studio plinth whose ~120-notch ring lights orange clockwise as a clay-voxel model is placed, stays lit while the model exists and drains grey while it lifts away: a progress / loading indicator that lives in the scene.

progress.description: ring fill 0..1 (model builds to this fraction); -1 = automatic fill, hold, drain

count.description: number of notches on the ring

fillFrames.description: frames to fill the ring (auto mode)

holdFrames.description: frames the full ring is held before the lift

drain.description: lift the model away and drain the ring at the end (loop seam)

percent.description: show the small mono percentage readout

x-opus.useFor: A loading / unlocking / onboarding-step indicator on a product pedestal; bind `progress` (0..1) to a counter, or leave it at -1 to auto-run fill, hold and drain.

pointcloud-orbit.title: Point cloud orbit — props
pointcloud-orbit.description: An image (default: a procedural swordswoman) becomes a 3D cloud of coloured beads pushed forward by brightness; the camera orbits, beads extrude into voxel columns, then the figure disintegrates into white particles blown sideways.

src.description: optional image in public/ (e.g. demo/owl.jpg); empty = procedural figure
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

depthScale.description: how far brightness pushes beads toward the camera

beadSize.description: bead diameter in world units (picture is 10 units tall)

extrusion.description: 0..1 voxel column extrusion (0 = flat relief only)

disintegrate.description: blow the cloud away at the end

direction.description: +1 blow to the right, -1 to the left

speed.description: particle drift speed (world units per second)

fringe.description: RGB rim split on each bead (0 = off)

keyDark.description: for images: luminance below this is keyed out (0 = keep all)

scan.description: photo-to-points scan: a bright seam sweeps left to right; ahead of it the picture is a flat plate of beads, behind it the 3D relief stands up

scanFrames.description: scan: frames the seam takes to cross (~3 s = 90)

craneTilt.description: degrees the camera tilts up during the scan (0 = default gentle pitch); e.g. 44 for a nadir-to-oblique crane

x-opus.useFor: Turn any still into a living 3D data sculpture; "Thanos snap" exits; tech/AI vision moments.

popup-spread.title: Pop-up book spread — props
popup-spread.description: An open pop-up book on a walnut desk: flat cut-paper cards with die-cut borders flip up around their bottom edges with a springy overshoot — back row first, then forward — sway gently with soft contact shadows, and fold back down in the same order at the end. CSS-3D (no WebGL), so it is light enough for web heroes.

pieces.description: cards [{art: hill|pine|tree|mushHouse|cloud|sun|sign|fence|flower, x (0..1 across the spread), z (0 back … 1 front), scale, color?, label? (sign text)}]

skyColor.description: sky band at the back of the page

riseAt.description: frame the back row starts rising

stagger.description: frames of delay from back (z 0) to front (z 1)

foldAt.description: frame the cards start folding down (beyond duration = never)

tilt.description: book tilt in degrees (how far we look down onto the page)

x-opus.useFor: Children's stories, game trailers, feature-set 'unboxing', onboarding chapters, kids' edtech, playful website heroes.

product-turntable-3d.title: Product turntable (3D hero shot) — props
product-turntable-3d.description: A procedural can, bottle, box or phone (with your label image or a generated label) rises onto a seamless peach sweep lit by an image-based studio, orbits slowly 40 degrees while a key-light streak crosses its glossy surface, a soft contact shadow and floor reflection ground it, and a hero headline fades in beside it.

labelSrc.description: label / box-face / phone-screen image (public/ path or URL); empty = generated label

colors.description: [label colour A, label colour B (also bottle glass), accent]

orbit.description: degrees the product turns across the clip (20-40)

lightSweepAt.description: frame the key-light streak starts crossing the product (45 frames)

headline.description: hero headline ("" with an empty subline = product only, centred)

subline.default: Crisp, cold and made with real citrus.

textAt.description: frame the type starts fading in

x-opus.useFor: E-commerce, product launches, packaging reveals and hero sections: set `labelSrc` to your label artwork (for a phone, your screen), `colors` and the headline.

shockwave-flip-field.title: Shockwave flip field — props
shockwave-flip-field.description: A heavy chrome ball glides in, hangs for a beat, then slams into a bed of two-tone candy capsules: a shock front races outward and every pill it reaches leaps, tumbles half a turn and lands showing its other colour — the whole field recolours as the ring passes, nearby pills fly off frame, the camera kicks and the moment plays in brief slow motion.

flipColor.description: pill colour after the flip (the takeover colour)

impact.description: [x, z] impact point in world units

flingRatio.description: fraction of nearby pills that fly off frame

slowMo.description: brief 0.35x slow-mo just after the hit, then catch-up

seed.description: unused variation seed (kept for spec compatibility)

x-opus.useFor: A hero "state change" beat: brand colour takeover, before/after, launch moments; strong for idents and thumbnails.

stack-plates-3d.title: Stack of plates (data physicalization) — props
stack-plates-3d.description: Data series as stacks of real thin plates — brushed aluminium and milky acrylic with a brass ruler plate every 10th — assembling piece by piece on a walnut base in a warm studio, then the newest increase feeds in plate by plate while pinned readings roll with the landings.

rulerEvery.description: every Nth plate is brass (a physical ruler)

feedSeries.description: index of the series fed plate-by-plate at the end (−1 = none)

feedValue.description: how much value arrives during the feed

x-opus.useFor: Premium annual-report / ESG / investor / energy / budget numbers built as countable physical objects.

studio-plinth-stage.title: Studio plinth stage — props
studio-plinth-stage.description: Seamless warm studio backdrop with a soft vignette and a round matte plinth with a bevelled top and notch ring, lit by one soft key from the upper left so shadows fall right/back; an original subject turns on it like a product turntable.

ringLoop.description: run a lit sweep around the ring (4 s loop)

spin.description: subject turntable speed, degrees per second

orbit.description: camera orbit speed, degrees per second (0 = locked-off)

elevation.description: camera elevation above the plinth plane, degrees

floatAmp.description: subject hover amplitude in plinth units

entrance.description: frames of the pop-in of the subject

x-opus.useFor: A neutral turntable stage for products, logos, mascots and 3D charts; use `subject: "none"` for a clean studio backdrop under your own content.

sun-shadow-measure.title: Sun shadow measure — props
sun-shadow-measure.description: A low winter sun swings across a white massing model while a clock readout runs; shadow sides go deep projected blue. Then one tower's shadow is traced as a cool fill with a bright edge while a range line with 100 m ticks grows from its base to the tip and a counter lands; the roofs inside the shadow ping on one by one.

date.description: ISO date for the sun path

tz.description: timezone offset in hours (clock times are local)

measure.description: the length printed at the end of the trace (scales the metres)

tickEvery.description: tick spacing on the range line, in units

amber.description: colour of the earlier data layer (old buildings)

x-opus.useFor: Shadow-impact stories for a new building, solar-panel roof ranking, "daylight in a courtyard", sundial / education pieces, any measured "how far does it reach" beat.

terrain-build-3d.title: Terrain build (3D) — props
terrain-build-3d.description: A procedural mountain heightmap rebuilds itself in labelled stages — flat, noise, fractal, erosion, materials, sun, atmosphere, clouds, lens — with a typing code panel, then a cinematic eased fly-by past the peak.

stages.description: list of {title, subtitle, file, code}; index order maps to the fixed build techniques (0 flat … 8 lens)

default.title: FRACTAL
default.subtitle: twelve octaves. mountains.

default.title: EROSION
default.subtitle: 10,485,760 simulated raindrops.

default.title: MATERIAL
default.subtitle: rock. scree. snow.

default.title: SUN
default.subtitle: a star, 8 light-minutes away.

default.title: ATMOSPHERE
default.subtitle: rayleigh · mie · ozone.

default.title: CLOUDS
default.subtitle: volumetric. perlin-worley.

default.title: LENS
default.subtitle: and a camera.

flyby.description: fly past the peak after the build (overlay fades out)

showTitle.description: show the stage title block + progress dashes

sunElevation.description: final sun elevation in degrees (low = golden hour)

sunAzimuth.description: final sun azimuth in degrees (90 = from screen right)

snowLine.description: height above which snow settles (world units, hero peak ≈ 32)

look.description: natural (default) | contours (illuminated topographic iso-lines on a dark void: no sky, clouds or lens; the build stages still run)

x-opus-optionLabels.contours: illuminated topographic iso-lines on a dark void: no sky, clouds or lens; the build stages still run

camera.description: fly (default fly-by) | dive (camera dives from above down the canyon toward the lowest point)

x-opus-optionLabels.dive: camera dives from above down the canyon toward the lowest point

trail.description: a glowing orange route descending the steepest slope during the fly-by (the spark path)

contourStep.description: contours: height between lines in world units (hero peak ~ 32)

colors.description: rock / scree / grass / snow / clay / sun / zenith / horizon / cloudShadow / cloudLight

x-opus.useFor: "How it is made" / generative-art explainers: show a world being built step by step, then reward with a hero fly-through.

3d-text-extrude-spin.title: 3D text extrude and spin (settles) — props
3d-text-extrude-spin.description: Your words as real extruded, bevelled 3D letters: they scale in spinning on the vertical (or horizontal) axis, ease out of the spin with a damped wobble, then a light streak sweeps across the glossy faces. Spin the whole word or each letter in a stagger.

text.description: the word(s); use '|' or \n for a new line (Latin letters, digits and basic punctuation; at most 60 characters)

subtitle.description: small caps line under the word ("" for none)

mode.description: 'word' (whole word spins) | 'letter' (each letter spins on its own with a stagger)

x-opus-optionLabels.letter: each letter spins on its own with a stagger

spinFrames.description: frames the spin takes to settle

background.description: background colour ('transparent' to composite over other content)

idleSway.description: degrees of slow sway after it settles

x-opus.useFor: Title cards, logo-style hero words, brand stings, countdown numbers and chapter openers: set `text`, `faceColor`, `sideColor`, `accent` and the background.

voxel-burst-swirl.title: Voxel burst swirl — props
voxel-burst-swirl.description: Clay-studio three.js scene: an original voxel creature on a round plinth shatters into ~1.1 k tumbling cubes that fly into a thick ring, orbit the plinth with the black eye voxels still readable, then fly back and reassemble into the creature so the clip ends on a finished, loopable frame (exit=lift sends the cloud up and out leaving the empty stage; also fall / scatter).

cells.description: custom model as [[x,y,z,colourSlot],...] (y up, +z faces camera); overrides preset

accent.description: lit notch colour of the ring

orbitFrames.description: how long the cloud orbits before the exit

orbitSpeed.description: orbit speed in degrees per second

liftFrames.description: exit length (top of the cloud leads by 9 frames)

ringRadius.description: mean ring radius in voxels (plinth radius = 14)

ringHeight.description: vertical thickness multiplier of the cloud

reverse.description: play backwards: the cloud gathers into the creature (intro)

hud.description: show the mono counter + phase badge HUD

x-opus.useFor: A dramatic "disrupt / transform / remix" beat, data turning into particles, or a loop outro that returns to the empty stage; reverse it for a gather-in intro.

voxel-diorama.title: Voxel diorama — props
voxel-diorama.description: A voxel island with beach, grass, rock, block trees and a little hut builds itself as cubes drop in waves (low and central first, decorations last) in a sea of bobbing water cubes on a slab, under drifting cube clouds, with a slow orbiting camera, soft shadows and a cube-count caption.

subtitle.default: built one cube at a time

heightmap.description: optional rows of integer column heights (0 = sea); empty = generated island

maxHeight.description: peak height of the generated terrain in cubes

buildAt.description: frame the first cube starts to fall

buildFrames.description: frames over which the build runs (1-3 s)

orbit.description: camera orbit speed in degrees per second

x-opus.useFor: Gaming content, playful brand "worlds", kids explainers, a loader or intro that builds a place. Pass heightmap (rows of integer column heights) to build your own terrain.

voxel-rain-build.title: Voxel rain build — props
voxel-rain-build.description: Clay-studio three.js scene: ~1.1 k rounded orange cubes rain from above the frame and stack bottom-up into an original voxel creature on a round white plinth, while the plinth notch ring fills and a mono HUD counts the voxels; the creature then blinks and looks around.

cells.description: custom model as [[x,y,z,colourSlot],...] (y up, +z faces camera, slot 0 body / 1 eyes); overrides preset

accent.description: lit notch colour of the progress ring

buildFrames.description: frames from first to last landing

dropHeight.description: how far (in voxels) each cube falls

hud.description: show the mono counter + phase badge HUD

x-opus.useFor: An "assembling the product / team / feature" beat, a loader that builds a mascot or logo, or the opening of a voxel-studio loop.

white-model-projection.title: White model projection (data as light) — props
white-model-projection.description: A white massing model of a city on a dark plinth in a dark room. House lights snap off, a projector strikes with a flicker and a warm wash spreads from its axis lighting one set of buildings amber; a second layer pops buildings on one by one with a white flash, a rising level of light colours every facade by height, and a final pick-out lights one tower alone. The model never changes, only the light.

layers.description: [{mode:'wash'|'grow'|'level'|'pick', at(frame), dur, select('all'|'tower'|'block'|'tallest'|'year<1940'|'h>1.5'|'rank<0.5'), color, ramp(level colours), spread(frames)}]

lightsOutAt.description: frame the house lights snap off

lightsUpAt.description: frame the house lights come back and the data ends

readouts.description: [{from,to,name,figure,label}] left-third readout; empty figure = count of buildings in the matching layer (replace with your numbers)

x-opus.useFor: Data-as-light hero for urban planning, real-estate portfolios ("our sites by year"), campus plans, flood/height studies, infra and B2B brands; any "data on a physical model" museum-style piece.

wireframe-build.title: Wireframe build — props
wireframe-build.description: A glowing amber wireframe galleon lifts out of a parchment blueprint part by part with sparks, then hull strips flash white-hot and cool into dark wood and sails fill with canvas, under a slow orbiting camera.

hot.description: white-hot colour of fresh lines / materialising strips

lineWidth.description: core wire width in px at 1080

variant.description: blueprint (default) | holo (hologram: hue-coloured additive wireframe grows through a glowing scan plane over a projector pad; no parchment, solids or masts)

x-opus-optionLabels.holo: hologram: hue-coloured additive wireframe grows through a glowing scan plane over a projector pad; no parchment, solids or masts

hue.description: holo: wire hue in degrees (188 cyan, 38 amber, 300 magenta)

pad.description: holo: projector pad rings and the rising scan plane

x-opus.useFor: "From plan to product" reveals, build/compile metaphors, engineering and making-of sequences.

auto-frame-camera.title: Auto-frame camera — props
auto-frame-camera.description: Self-framing camera for build-up diagrams: as blocks are added the isometric scene pans and zooms (0.7 s easeInOutCubic) so the current assembly always fills the viewport with a constant margin, while the header and readouts never move. Dashed guides show the margin box and the content bounds.

steps.description: array of {title, blocks:[{id,label,x,y,w,d,h,color}], links:[{from,to}]}; blocks are diffed by id between steps

stepAt.description: start frame of each step (the camera starts moving here)

margin.description: margin around the content as a fraction of the viewport

guides.description: show the dashed margin box and content bounds

zoomLabel.description: word before the zoom value in the readout pill

marginLabel.description: legend text for the orange margin guide ("- - " is prefixed)

boundsLabel.description: legend text for the teal content-bounds guide ("- - " is prefixed)

x-opus.useFor: Keeps any multi-step build-up diagram readable without hand-keyed cameras; the same `fitCamera` / `autoFrameAt` helpers (src/core/r2-x58-kit.tsx) drive any step-based motion.

board-camera.title: Board camera (one huge board, one long dolly) — props
board-camera.description: A very large board holds every idea in its own region; the camera dollies between regions with log-zoom weighting and small rolls, pushes into one symbol, then pulls back past the board edge to show the whole lesson hanging on a wall in an aluminium frame with a pen tray. Directional motion blur appears when the camera moves fast.

regions.description: [{id, x, y, w, h (board px), title, doodle:bars|cycle|tree|bulb|gear|wave, at (draw-in frame), layers? (LayerSpec[] to host library motions)}]

camera.description: [[frame, x, y, zoom, rollDeg, ease]] ease arrives at the key: 'quintic'|'cubic'|'inOut'|'linear'|'hold'

frame.description: aluminium frame + pen tray when zoomed out

motionBlur.description: max blur px when the camera is fast (0 = off)

x-opus.useFor: Turns hand-drawn motions into one continuous explainer: course intros, "how it works" product videos, onboarding; the full-board pull-back is a natural recap / end card. Regions can host any library motion via `layers`.

canvas-flythrough.title: Canvas flythrough — props
canvas-flythrough.description: One tall layout holding every section; a virtual camera flies between stations with a van Wijk smooth zoom (zooming out slightly while travelling, settling on a long ease, speed-proportional camera blur) and at the end pulls all the way out to reveal the whole canvas was a phone screen.

keys.description: camera stations [{t: arrival frame, dur: travel frames before arrival, x,y: world centre (canvas is 1200x2600), w: visible world width in portrait (widened to at most 1.15x the canvas in landscape; 0 = fit whole canvas), move: 'drift'|'fly'|'pull'}]

frameStyle.description: 'phone' wraps the canvas in a device bezel for the final pull-out reveal, 'none' leaves it flat

tagline.description: grey sub-lines under the headline (one entry per line)
default: One canvas. Every section a station

sectionLabel.description: small caps label above the cards

x-opus.useFor: Explainers, product tours and pitch one-shot infographics: lay out sections as one canvas, list the stations, and let the camera do the storytelling.

crash-zoom.title: Crash zoom — props
crash-zoom.description: Snap punch-in on a point of interest: expo-out zoom, ghosted zoom blur, decaying shake, radial speed lines and a flash.

src.description: public/ path or URL (empty = procedural scene)
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

hits.description: [[frame, zoom, x, y], ...] each punch-in; x,y = target point 0..1

shake.description: initial camera shake in u (0 = none)

shakeDecay.description: frames for the shake to decay

speedLines.description: radial manga speed lines on each hit

flash.description: white flash strength on a hit (0 = off)

creep.description: slow push-in applied before the first hit (e.g. 0.05)

release.description: frames to ease back out after the last hit (0 = stay punched in)

releaseAfter.description: frames to wait after the last hit before releasing

x-opus.useFor: Comedic or dramatic emphasis on a face, product, number or object in any image; reaction beats; "wait, what?" moments.

dolly-zoom.title: Dolly zoom (vertigo) — props
dolly-zoom.description: Vertigo effect: the subject holds its size while the background stretches behind it, with a tightening vignette.

src.description: public/ path or URL of the scene/background (empty = procedural scene)
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

subjectSrc.description: optional transparent cut-out PNG kept at constant size (empty = feathered centre of src)

direction.description: in = background swells, out = background relaxes back

hold.description: frames held still before the dolly

subjectSize.description: size of the kept centre region when only src is given (0..1)

tension.description: vignette tightening as the dolly runs (0 = none)

x-opus.useFor: A moment of dread, realisation or "oh no" on a portrait, product or place photo; thriller and true-crime beats; dramatic reveal punctuation.

orbit-parallax.title: Orbit parallax — props
orbit-parallax.description: 2.5D camera orbit around a cut-out subject: depth layers slide against each other while the subject turns slightly.

src.description: background picture (empty = procedural layered scene)
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

subjectSrc.description: transparent PNG cut-out subject (empty = procedural figure)

orbitDeg.description: subject turn at the extremes of the orbit, degrees

cycles.description: full left-right-left orbits over the clip (loops seamlessly)

x-opus.useFor: Bringing a still product, person or character photo to life; hero images and portfolio shots; photo-to-3D-feel loops.

rack-focus.title: Rack focus — props
rack-focus.description: Focus pulls between a foreground, a subject and a background layer: blur follows depth, bokeh blooms, lens breathes.

maxBlur.description: blur at the furthest depth in u

bokeh.description: bokeh discs bloom on the blurred background

x-opus.useFor: Shifting attention from one thing to another in a still-image scene; cinematic reveals; product-then-environment shots; drama beats.

time-remap-clock.title: Time remap clock — props
time-remap-clock.description: Explains and demonstrates the punctuation-hold clock: two balls on a track, one on the constant timeline, one on the remapped clock that eases to a full stop on each hold, then runs up to ~2x to catch back up; a live speed graph shows the dip, the stop and the sin² catch-up. The same pure remap (buildTimeRemap in src/core/r2-mg1b-kit.tsx) can drive any motion for musical breaths.

holds.description: holds [{at seconds on the timeline, dur seconds}]

release.description: seconds of the catch-up run after each hold

length.description: timeline length in seconds shown on the track

notes.description: two caption lines under the title (landscape joins them with " · ")
default: STOP ON THE HOLD · CATCH UP TO ~2x

timelineLabel.description: label of the straight timeline track

holdLabel.description: readout text while the clock is stopped on a hold

x-opus.useFor: Visualising or tuning holds / slow-mo on beats; template for retiming any library motion without drifting off the timeline.

whip-pan.title: Whip pan — props
whip-pan.description: The camera whips sideways to the next picture: expo-fast slide, directional motion blur, speed streaks, a settle.

images.description: public/ paths or URLs, shown in order and looping (empty = procedural scenes)
images.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

scenes.description: how many procedural scenes when images is empty

direction.description: pan direction: left | right | up | down

streaks.description: speed streak lines during the whip

flash.description: accent flash strength at the peak (0 = off)

punch.description: extra scale at the peak of the whip

x-opus.useFor: Energetic cuts between product shots, locations, slides or portfolio images; a swish-pan transition inside one clip; travel and event recaps.

blob-mascot.title: Blob mascot hop & roll — props
blob-mascot.description: White eyed sphere hops down an isometric bar staircase with squash/stretch, painting each cap, lands with a tile ripple, then rolls back with its eyes coming round, leaving a fading peach trail.

steps.description: number of bars in the staircase

hopFrames.description: frames per hop at the top (hops speed up toward the bottom)

rollFrames.description: frames for the roll back along the floor

trailFade.description: frames for a trail tile to fade back

squash.description: landing squash amount (sy = 1 - squash; floor landing is 1.6x)

x-opus.useFor: Declining-metric metaphors, playful loaders, step-by-step progress where a tiny character visits each step.

body-vessel-glow.title: Body vessel glow character — props
body-vessel-glow.description: A friendly flat-vector kid in a hoodie in a night landscape: the camera eases in, the hoodie turns see-through and a glowing pink vessel network draws on from the heart through head, arms and legs with light pulses, then a small element chip ("Fe") pops out of the chest.

chipText.description: element symbol on the chip ("" hides the chip text)

chipSub.description: small line under the symbol (e.g. amount; "" for none)

zoom.description: camera zoom into the torso (1 = none)

x-opus.useFor: Biology and health explainers, "what is in your body" reveals, nutrition and iron/mineral stories, science-for-kids channels, origin-of-elements intros.

box-bot.title: Box-bot mascot — props
box-bot.description: Orange cube mascot with dark rectangular eyes, little arms and four stubby legs acting out a script: walk on twos, look around, emote, hop with squash and landing, wave, run off.

style.description: 'sketch' (v20 pencil on paper) | 'clean' (v13 sunny toon) | 'toon' (v12 comic synthwave)

script.description: sequence of actions: {action:'walk'|'run', to?|dx?, frames} {action:'hop', dx?, height?, frames} {action:'look', dir:-1|1} {action:'emote', icon:'?'|'!'|'heart'|'bulb'|'sweat'|'scribble'|'sparkle'|'zzz'} {action:'wave'} {action:'turn', yaw} {action:'blink'} {action:'idle'|'expression', expression?} {action:'hop-spin', dx?, height?, frames} (hop with a full 360 degree turn)

startX.description: start position as a fraction of frame width

size.description: body width as a fraction of the short side

legs.description: 'quad' (v20 four corner legs) | 'row' (v13 four legs in a row)

x-opus-optionLabels.row: v13 four legs in a row

flower.description: pink flower on the head (v20 later acts)

onTwos.description: step the character every 2nd frame (12/15 fps hand-animated feel)

floorY.description: ground line as a fraction of height (0 = auto)

hat.description: wardrobe: none | party | wizard | crown | helmet | cap | tophat | beanie (follows the body)

mood.description: body-colour mood tint: none | fear (pale) | anger (red) | sad (blue) | love (pink) | disgust (green) | pride (gold)

tint.description: custom tint colour mixed into the body (overrides mood)

gloom.description: indigo gloom lines hanging from the forehead 0..1

x-opus.useFor: A friendly guide/mascot that walks in, reacts (? ! idea, hearts) and leaves; explainer beats that need a character.

character-rig-2d.title: Character rig 2D (presenter) — props
character-rig-2d.description: A flat-vector humanoid presenter on a jointed rig: walks in, idles with a 1.5 s breathing bob, blinks every 2-5 s, lip-flaps through four mouth shapes from text or an amplitude array, and plays cue actions (wave, point, nod, shrug, cheer, walk, talk). Body parts can be swapped for your own images.

say.description: text whose letters drive the 4 mouth shapes (empty = silent)
say.default: Hi there, welcome to the show. Let me walk you through it.

amplitude.description: optional per-frame audio amplitude 0..1 (30 fps) for real lip-flap; overrides `say`

walkInFrames.description: frames of the walk-in from the left (0 = already standing)

parts.description: optional image paths per part: head, torso, armL, armR, legL, legR (replace the vector part)

x-opus.useFor: Presenters, mascots, explainers with a host and story shorts: set `say`/`amplitude` for speech, `cues` for gestures, colours for the brand, `parts` for a custom character.

collage-puppet.title: Collage puppet — props
collage-puppet.description: A cut-out engraving portrait split into scalp lid, face and jaw: the jaw flaps between three stepped poses to "talk", dashed cut lines and scissors snip across the forehead, then the scalp flips open on a brass brad to reveal a torn wedge of space from which a rocket, planet, bird, rose and butterfly spill out one per beat, with ransom-letter chips and paper confetti. Animated on twos at 12 fps on kraft paper.

faceSrc.description: optional cut-out portrait (public/ path, transparent PNG ~380x540); default is a drawn engraving-style head

revealSrc.description: optional image revealed under the lid (default: a nebula)

spillSrcs.description: up to 5 optional cut-outs that spill out (default: rocket, planet, bird, rose, butterfly)

talkAt.description: frame the jaw starts flapping (3 flaps)

cutAt.description: frame the dashed cut line appears; scissors snip 5 times after it

endTalkAt.description: frame of the closing jaw flaps (and the caption band)

speech.description: speech scrap beside the mouth during the first talk (empty to hide)

bang.description: ransom-letter chips that pop when the lid opens

caption.description: diagonal black band text at the end (empty to hide)

x-opus.useFor: Monty-Python style comedy beats, music and street-culture promos, "mind blown" explainers. Pass faceSrc / revealSrc / spillSrcs to use your own cut-outs.

colour-model-relight.title: Colour-model relight — props
colour-model-relight.description: One cel character re-lit through day, dawn, night, backlit and silhouette by multiplying each paint role separately (fills, shadows, lines, hand-set skin), beside the muddy result of a single filter over the whole frame.

sets.description: sequence of light sets: day | dawn | night | backlit | silhouette (30 frames each, blended)

jacket.description: jacket fill colour (shade and line colours are derived)

scarf.description: hero accent colour — stays readable in every set

skin.description: daylight skin colour (each set overrides it by hand)

compare.description: true = left panel shows one filter over the whole frame, right panel the per-role relight

swatches.description: show the set chips at the bottom

frameLabel.description: caption of the left (whole-frame filter) panel in compare mode

relightLabel.description: caption of the per-paint-role relight panel

x-opus.useFor: Reuse the same character or asset across times of day and moods without a frame filter; copy relight(palette, set) from r2-la1-kit into your own character motions as a timeOfDay prop.

creator-hand.title: Creator hand — props
creator-hand.description: A giant storybook hand in a chunky red ribbed sweater reaches in from the edge, unpins a light-bulb idea card from a corkboard, carries it on a slow S-curve on twos and drops it onto a closed laptop in a warm gouache desk room.

background.description: 'desk' = procedural storybook desk room, 'transparent' = overlay (hand + card only), or any CSS colour

from.description: edge the arm enters from: right | left | top

onTwos.description: hold each hand drawing for 2 frames (hand-made 12 drawings/s feel)

cardIcon.description: doodle on the carried card: bulb | star | heart | none

cardSrc.description: optional image (public/ path or URL) printed on the card instead of the doodle

handSize.description: hand length in u (1u = 1 px on a 1080 short side)

seed.description: seed for the corkboard notes and textures

x-opus.useFor: "Your input enters the product" promo beat, tutorial hands, a big friendly hand acting on a small illustrated world; overlay it (background transparent) over any shot.

crowd-bob.title: Crowd stomp / cheer — props
crowd-bob.description: A massed perspective crowd of box-bots, ink-etched soldiers or paper dolls; the camera cranes up to reveal its size while everyone stomp-hops in sync (or cheer-bobs with hearts).

character.description: 'boxbot' (v12 synthwave clones) | 'soldier' (v5 blue ink etching) | 'doll' (v20 paper sketch)

mode.description: 'stomp' synchronised hop (v5) | 'cheer' random-phase arms-up bob with hearts (v20) | 'beans' (toy bean contestants drop from the sky one per half-beat, hop on the beat, shout on accents)

x-opus-optionLabels.beans: toy bean contestants drop from the sky one per half-beat, hop on the beat, shout on accents

crane.description: camera cranes up and tilts down to reveal the crowd

amplitude.description: hop height in character heights at the front row

depthFalloff.description: exponent of the amplitude falloff toward the back rows

bpm.description: beans: tempo for the drops and hops

names.description: beans: name-tag texts in order ([] = built-in names)

shoutEvery.description: beans: every Nth beat is an accent where all beans shout (0 = never)

x-opus.useFor: Scale beats (“thousands of users / sessions / agents”), community and celebration moments, armies of AI.

flame-sprite.title: Flame sprite — props
flame-sprite.description: A hand-inked flame mascot (red outer, yellow core, paper-white glint, dot eyes, rubber-hose arms with white gloves) wakes on a cream paper stage, looks around, hops three times along red dotted arc guides with squash and stretch, throws a ta-da with sparkles, squashes to a pancake and pops back with a wink — all on ones, twos and threes with boiling ink.

poolColor.description: stepped light-pool colour behind the flame

showBox.description: draw the inked box the flame stands on

expression.description: 'auto' runs the acting script; or lock a face: neutral | happy | sleepy | determined | squeezed

flicker.description: how much the flame tongues lick between drawings (0–1)

slate.description: show the scene slate and drawing counter

x-opus.useFor: A warm mascot for energy, ideas, "spark" and craft metaphors; intros, explainers and stickers with hand-animation charm.

flat-person-desk.title: Flat person at desk — props
flat-person-desk.description: A geometric flat-vector person with round glasses works at a laptop in a cosy sunflower room (window with skyline and sun, framed print, swaying pendant lamp, plant, steaming mug); the room pops in with springs, they type and blink, the phone pings with a bell bubble, their head snaps round with an "!" mark, they reach for the phone and break into a smile, bobbing on the beat.

expression.description: 'auto' runs the acting; or neutral | surprised | smile

message.description: optional tiny word on the phone screen after the ping

x-opus.useFor: A reusable "user" moment for app, SaaS and notification explainers; pairs with sms-thread, chat-bubbles and kinetic-captions.

paper-critter-rig.title: Paper critter rig — props
paper-critter-rig.description: An original paper-cut critter (fox-like by default) made of overlapping scale-shaped paper pieces, with walk-in-place, stand, sit and look-up poses, tail swish, head tilts and ear flicks, paper rims and a contact shadow on a mossy paper ledge.

bodyColor.description: override body colour (hex), shade is derived

size.description: critter size multiplier (1 = 46 % of the short side)

scene.description: draw the paper ledge / mountains / sky (false = plain background, use background "transparent" for an overlay)

background.description: background when scene is off ('transparent' for an overlay)

star.description: golden guide star in the sky

x-opus.useFor: A reusable storybook hero for explainers, kids’ content and brand journeys; a mascot in a paper world.

pictogram-figure.title: Pictogram figure (geometric athlete) — props
pictogram-figure.description: Faceless geometric pictogram figure — round-capped bars and a disc head driven by beat-timed key poses (run, walk, jump, throw, kick, lift, wave, cheer) — far-side limbs tinted toward the background, standing on a big sun disc with a light sweep over a low-contrast motif grid, assembled from horizontal bands that slide into register.

action.description: run | walk | jump | throw | kick | lift | wave | cheer

bpm.description: tempo; key poses are timed in beats

hue.description: chapter hue (five tones derived from it)

farMix.description: how far the far-side limbs mix toward the background

disc.description: big sun disc behind the figure

assemble.description: arrive by horizontal bands sliding into register

label.description: big title beside the figure ("" to hide)

meta.description: mono index line above the title

pattern.description: low-contrast motif grid in the background

x-opus.useFor: "Person doing X" icon animation for explainers, onboarding, sports, workplace steps, fitness and safety instructions — any brand colour, no character design needed.

sign-drop.title: Sign drop & swing — props
sign-drop.description: A neon, comic banner or wooden sign drops in on ropes with a springy bounce, swings on a damped pendulum and settles into a gentle sway; neon flickers on after landing.

text.description: main sign text

style.description: 'neon' (dark plate, glowing tube) | 'banner' (v12 maroon comic banner) | 'wood' (planks on ropes)

restAngle.description: resting tilt in degrees (v12 banner hangs at about -10)

width.description: sign width as a fraction of frame width (landscape)

exit.description: pull the sign back up at the end

x-opus.useFor: Announcements, chapter cards, “now open / limit reached / reset” beats, shop or level names.

silhouette-runner.title: Silhouette runner (cut-paper chase) — props
silhouette-runner.description: A flat black cut-paper agent with a streaming red tie sprints on twos across red rooftops under a paper moon, leaping the gaps, chased by a taller villain in a wide brim whose red coat lining flashes as he runs.

caption.description: subtitle strip text (empty = none)
caption.default: Tonight, the courier runs out of roof.

accentColor.description: the only colour on the figures: tie and coat lining

objectColor.description: mustard windows and the carried case

x-opus.useFor: Chases, heists, couriers on a deadline, detective or spy-themed explainers and title sequences.

stickman-rig.title: Stickman rig — props
stickman-rig.description: Round-capped stick figures with circle heads walk, run, punch, kick, fall, cheer, moonwalk, wave and dance from a joint-angle pose library with 2-bone IK legs; lines boil on twos and strikes trigger impact frames (flash, burst, hit-stop shake).

actors.description: [{name?, color, track:[{at, pose, x, face?, speed?}]}] — pose: idle|walk|run|punch|kick|fall|cheer|moonwalk|wave|dance|think|getup; x: -1..1 across the ground; face: 1 right, -1 left

boil.description: line-boil jitter in px (on twos; 0 = steady)

impacts.description: flash + burst + hit-stop shake when a punch or kick lands

caption.description: handwritten sub-caption

x-opus.useFor: Comedy and meme shorts, fight parodies, process explainers with people, "someone does a thing" beats where a full character is overkill.

toon-object-character.title: Toon object character — props
toon-object-character.description: An everyday object (mug, box, bottle, can) becomes a 1930s rubber-hose cartoon character: pie eyes and a big mouth on its front, black noodle arms and legs, white four-finger gloves, huge round shoes, boiling ink outlines and a steam carrier that shows the mood; it walks in, hops with squash and stretch, points, waves and cheers.

accent.description: mouth tongue, heart steam and bottle cap colour

script.description: [{at, dur, action:'idle|walk|run|hop|point|wave|cheer', x?}] ; x = horizontal target (fraction of the frame width) reached at the end of the segment

startX.description: starting x as a fraction of the frame width (0 = centre)

bpm.description: beat-breathe tempo

boil.description: ink boil amplitude in character units (0 = off)

x-opus.useFor: Product mascots from the host's own product shape (mug, bottle, box), retro ads, kids content; a second character family beside box-bot.

walker-world-scroll.title: Walker world scroll (era wipe) — props
walker-world-scroll.description: A chibi explorer in a bucket hat walks in place at 37.5 % W while procedural era panels (cave, Egypt, Greek vase, ink wash, 8-bit, vaporwave) scroll by with eased stop-and-go; torn decorated seams restyle him as they pass, with a confetti burst and an era badge swap.

speed.description: cruise speed in frame widths per second (source ≈ 0.29)

stopFrames.description: hold length of each gag stop

eraWidth.description: width of each era panel in frame widths

stopAt.description: where in each era the walker stops (0..1)

heroX.description: hero screen x as a fraction of width (0 = auto: 0.375 landscape)

gags.description: play a small gag (wave / jump / point / cheer) at every stop

badge.description: show the year / title badge top-right

background.description: colour behind the era panels (only visible at the extreme edges)

confettiColors.description: confetti colours (hex list); [] = the palette of the era being entered

vaporStamp.description: vaporwave panel small VHS-style stamp text

x-opus.useFor: History / timeline / evolution stories, “through the ages” montages, product version timelines, chapter travel.

api-request-flow.title: API request flow — props
api-request-flow.description: A request / response round trip: client, server and database nodes in a row; labelled request packets travel between them, responses come back in a second colour, each arrival pulses the node and pops an HTTP status badge, and a call log fills in underneath.

steps.description: packets in order [{from, to (node indexes), label, status? (HTTP code, 4xx/5xx = red + shake), statusText?, ms?, type? ('request' | 'response'; default: response when going back toward node 0)}]

showLog.description: show the call log under the diagram

x-opus.useFor: Explaining how an API call works, backend architecture, REST / HTTP basics, error-handling stories (a 500 shakes the node), latency and developer-docs videos.

atom-electron-cloud.title: Atom electron cloud builder — props
atom-electron-cloud.description: Dark blue space: a nucleus of protons and neutrons grows one proton per beat with a counter and an element symbol/name card updating (H, He, Li ...) while each new electron is a seeded particle swarm that spreads into its shell, expanding the electron cloud.

caption.description: mono sub-line

protonNote.description: floating note when a proton is added

x-opus.useFor: Chemistry and physics explainers, "how elements are built" lessons, periodic-table intros, science channel hero shots.

axis-ratchet-rescale.title: Axis ratchet rescale — props
axis-ratchet-rescale.description: A pencil chart draws calmly until one value pierces the top frame line — torn red scar, 2-frame punch-in, decaying shake — holds the break for a beat, then the y-axis rescales in 4 ratchet clicks with every tick and mark sliding to its new position.

values.description: the series; one value should exceed domainBefore

spikeIndex.description: index of the record value (-1 = third from last)

domainBefore.description: y domain before the rescale (the spike must overshoot it)

domainAfter.description: y domain after the 4 ratchet clicks

subtitle.default: DAILY VISITS, THOUSANDS · ONE MARK PER DAY

note.description: handwritten red note at the spike

x-opus.useFor: "Record-breaking" moments — a viral spike, price bubble, flood level, heat record — in any chart story; pairs with number-counter.

bar-race.title: Bar chart race — props
bar-race.description: Ranked horizontal bars that grow, then re-order smoothly over time as the data steps through keyframes: bars overtake each other, values roll, the leader changes, and a big faded period label (year, quarter) changes behind them.

names.description: one name per bar; colours follow the name index so a bar keeps its colour while it moves

frames.description: keyframes [{label, values[]}] — one values row per period, same order as names

topN.description: how many bars are visible at a time (others slide off the bottom)

subtitle.description: small line under the headline (empty = none)

stepFrames.description: frames per keyframe step at speed 1

scale.description: "dynamic" rescales to the current leader, "fixed" keeps one scale for the whole race

showRank.description: print the live rank number at the left

showPeriod.description: big faded period label behind the bars

colors.description: bar palette by name index

startAt.description: frame the bars start to grow

x-opus.useFor: Rankings over time: market share by year, top products by quarter, followers by month, league tables, "who is winning" stories. Give the names once and one values row per period in `frames`.

beat-montage.title: Accelerating beat montage — props
beat-montage.description: Hard-cut image montage whose cuts accelerate 12 f -> 6 f -> 3 f, a persistent centre dot, breathing sonar rings on the beat, per-shot micro push and beat-synced style swaps.

images.description: public/ image paths cycled through the shots (empty = procedural scenes)
