images.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

steps.description: frames per cut for each block (accelerating)

counts.description: number of shots in each block

bpm.description: beat tempo: sets the sonar ring period and the dot pulse (150 bpm = 12 f)

shuffle.description: 0..1 chance that a shot after the first block is restyled

styles.description: styles to shuffle between: duotone | dot | invert

pingBeats.description: insert 6-frame paper ping beats between blocks

mode.description: images (default) | shapes (graphic match cuts: one circle keeps its centre and size while it becomes a wheel, roulette, pupil, moon, keyhole, target; steps [10,8,6,4] + dotColor as accent)

x-opus-optionLabels.shapes: graphic match cuts: one circle keeps its centre and size while it becomes a wheel, roulette, pupil, moon, keyhole, target; steps [10,8,6,4] + dotColor as accent

reverse.description: replay the shots in reverse order with contracting rings (rewind / flashback; combine with steps [4,2])

shapePalette.description: shapes mode: background colours cycled per shot

x-opus.useFor: Recaps, "so many examples" sequences, showreels, building energy before a reveal.

bubble-scatter-grow.title: Bubble scatter grow — props
bubble-scatter-grow.description: A bubble chart: axes and grid fade in, then bubbles grow in from left to right at their x / y position with area proportional to size, coloured per group, with collision-aware labels and an optional highlighted bubble with a ring.

points.description: bubbles [{label, x, y, size, group?, color?}]; group sets the colour and builds the legend

subtitle.description: small line under the headline (empty = none)

sizeLabel.description: small note about what the bubble size means (empty = none)

zeroBased.description: start both axes at zero (false zooms to the data range)

showLabels.description: print bubble labels (inside when they fit, else beside, skipping collisions)

labelTop.description: only label the N largest bubbles (0 = all that fit)

maxRadius.description: radius of the largest bubble in u (capped to the plot size)

highlight.description: label of a bubble to ring and spotlight at the end (empty = none)

colors.description: palette for groups / bubbles without their own colour

background.description: page colour, or "transparent" to sit over other content

startAt.description: frame the axes start to appear

x-opus.useFor: Three-variable comparisons: markets by size, growth and margin, countries, products, campaigns, startups. Pass points as [{label, x, y, size, group?, color?}], axis titles and number formats; works on a transparent background.

budget-envelope-split.title: Budget envelope split — props
budget-envelope-split.description: An income bar at the top splits into coins that travel down dashed lines to a grid of paper envelopes; each envelope pops in, opens its flap and lifts a slip showing the amount and share, while the "left to assign" counter on the bar runs down to zero.

income.description: total income on the bar; envelopes are scaled to add up to it (0 = sum of the envelopes)

leftLabel.description: caption over the running "left to assign" amount

envelopes.description: envelopes [{label, amount, color?}] up to 9; amounts are shares of the income

showPercent.description: show each envelope's percentage share on its slip

colors.description: palette for envelopes without their own colour

x-opus.useFor: Personal-finance and budgeting apps, envelope / zero-based budgeting explainers, salary or revenue allocation stories, "where does my money go" reels. Pass the income and a list of labelled envelopes with amounts and colours.

cause-effect-chain.title: Cause and effect chain — props
cause-effect-chain.description: Step boxes linked by dashed arrows; each arrow fills with a travelling pulse and the next box lights up, the colour sliding from the cause colour to the effect colour, ending with a pulse ring on the last box.

steps.description: chain step texts, in order (up to 7)

x-opus.useFor: Domino-effect explainers, "how X leads to Y" chains, root-cause stories, economics / science / news cause chains — pass `steps` (2-7 short strings).

chip-stack-bars.title: Chip stack bars — props
chip-stack-bars.description: Horizontal bars built from labelled unit chips, one chip per item: each row has a tiny tracked label above and a rolling count at the end, rows grow left to right chip by chip (about one chip per frame), and the highlighted row uses the accent colour with a gentle wave once complete.

rows.description: rows[{label, items: string[] (chip texts), accent?: true}]

subtitle.description: small tracked line under the headline

chipFrames.description: frames per chip (1 = one chip per frame)

x-opus.useFor: A unit-chart (isotype) alternative to bar charts for counts of things that have names: parts per system, features per tier, ingredients per category.

clock-time-teach.title: Clock time teach — props
clock-time-teach.description: A friendly analogue clock for learning to tell the time: the short hour hand and long minute hand sweep forward to each target time, a coloured minute wedge follows, a digital readout ticks along and a caption ("half past six") pops in, with a hand legend.

times.description: target times in order, "h:mm" with optional am/pm or 24h (e.g. "3:00", "6:30 PM", "15:15"); the clock starts at 12:00

captions.description: optional caption per time (empty or missing = auto English such as "half past 6")

showMinuteNumbers.description: show 5, 10, 15 ... around the outside of the rim

hourHandLabel.description: legend text for the hour hand

minuteHandLabel.description: legend text for the minute hand

ink.description: numbers, ticks and readout panel colour

accent2.description: minute hand, wedge and readout digits colour

fontFamily.description: optional CSS font-family for clock numbers and captions (empty = display)

timeFrames.description: frames each time is shown (sweep takes ~40%)

x-opus.useFor: Telling-the-time lessons, kids' routine and schedule videos, ESL time vocabulary, timetable explainers and clock-based countdown/scheduling graphics — pass any list of times and optional captions.

comparison-dumbbell.title: Comparison dumbbell — props
comparison-dumbbell.description: A dumbbell (before / after) chart: for each category a "before" dot appears on a shared axis, then the "after" dot slides away from it, stretching a connector coloured green for improvement and red for decline, with value labels and a change pill at the right.

subtitle.description: small line under the headline (empty = none)
subtitle.default: Score out of 100, before and after the redesign

beforeLabel.description: legend name of the first dot

afterLabel.description: legend name of the second dot

suffix.description: text after every number, e.g. "%", " pts"

showValues.description: print the before and after values beside the dots

showDelta.description: show the change pill at the right

goodDirection.description: "up" (increase is green) or "down" (decrease is green, e.g. cost, time)

zeroBased.description: start the axis at zero (otherwise it zooms to the data range)

goodColor.description: connector and pill colour for a good change

badColor.description: connector and pill colour for a bad change

background.description: page colour, or "transparent" to sit over other content

x-opus.useFor: Change between two states per item: before vs after, last year vs this year, plan vs actual, men vs women, A vs B, scores pre- and post-launch. Pass data as [{label, before, after}], set the two series names, colours, prefix / suffix and which direction is good.

crowd-tracks.title: Crowd tracks — props
crowd-tracks.description: A locked-off concourse plate darkens and desaturates while every walker becomes a glowing sodium-orange dot trailing a decaying polyline of where it just was, linked to its nearest neighbour — people as data — with a lock-digit footfall count.

decay.description: trail alpha multiplier per frame of age (0.9 = source)

revealAt.description: frame where the plate starts darkening and the tracks appear

number.description: counter value (digits lock left→right one per sixteenth); empty = no text

caption.description: tracked line under the rule

src.description: optional public/ crowd still used as the plate (procedural concourse otherwise)
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

x-opus.useFor: Footfall / mobility / network-activity explainers, smart-city and retail-analytics films, "everyone is connected" beats; drop a crowd still into `src`.

deploy-pipeline-stages.title: Deploy pipeline stages — props
deploy-pipeline-stages.description: A CI/CD pipeline of stage cards (build, test, scan, deploy): each runs in turn with a spinner that becomes a check or a red cross, sub-steps tick off, a timer counts up and the connector fills; a failing stage stops the line, later stages show as skipped, and a banner ends it.

subtitle.description: branch / commit line under the title

stages.description: stages in order [{name, steps? (up to 5 sub-steps), seconds? (timer end value), result? ('pass' default | 'fail' — stops the pipeline, later stages are skipped)}]

successText.description: banner text when every stage passes

failText.description: banner text when a stage fails

x-opus.useFor: DevOps / CI-CD explainers, "how we ship" and release-process videos, deployment tooling promos, incident stories (set one stage to fail).

dna-helix-unzip.title: DNA helix unzip — props
dna-helix-unzip.description: A rotating DNA double helix draws on, coloured A-T / G-C base-pair rungs fill in, then a zipper point runs along the axis and the two strands peel apart into half-rungs with letter tags.

caption.description: line shown once the strands have separated

sequence.description: bases for strand A (A/T/G/C); complements are derived; repeats if shorter than pairs

unzipFrames.description: length of the unzip in frames

letters.description: show base letters on the separated half-rungs

seed.description: seed for bases when sequence is empty

x-opus.useFor: Biology / genetics explainers, "copying the code" or "unlocking" metaphors, biotech and health intros.

donut-breakdown.title: Donut breakdown — props
donut-breakdown.description: A donut chart that sweeps round clockwise segment by segment with percentage labels, a count-up total in the centre and a legend whose values count up as each segment lands; an optional highlighted slice pops out while the rest dim.

data.description: slices [{label, value, color?}]; any count, values are relative

subtitle.description: small line under the headline (empty = none)

centerLabel.description: small caption under the centre total (empty = none)

suffix.description: text after every number, e.g. "K", "%", " users"

showPercent.description: print each slice share on the ring

showLegend.description: legend beside (16:9, 1:1) or below (9:16) the donut

legendValues.description: show the count-up value next to each legend label

highlight.description: index of a slice to pop out once the sweep ends (-1 = none)

ringWidth.description: ring thickness as a fraction of the radius (0.1-0.8)

colors.description: palette used for slices without their own colour

background.description: page colour, or "transparent" to sit over other content

x-opus.useFor: Share-of-total stories on any brand: revenue by channel, budget split, traffic sources, survey answers, market share. Replace data, colours, prefix / suffix; works on a transparent background over footage.

dot-tally.title: Dot tally (people as dots) — props
dot-tally.description: One dot per person in labelled groups; selected dots turn one by one from filled cream discs into open red rings while a huge counter runs; the total and a two-symbol legend land at the end.

groups.description: [{label, count, marked}] one grid per group; `marked` dots turn

ink.description: colour of the filled dots and text

accent.description: colour of marked dots and the big number

shuffle.description: mark in seeded random order (false = row order)

total.description: text for the final big figure (default: number of marked dots)

x-opus.useFor: Casualties, survey answers ("37 of 100 said…"), seats won, users affected, failure rates — a restrained alternative to a bar chart an agent can generate from two numbers.

dot-to-stripes-morph.title: Dot-to-stripes morph — props
dot-to-stripes-morph.description: A hand-drawn pencil dot chart on cream paper sweeps mark by mark into a full-height warming-stripes band: each dot falls to the band centre, stretches into its coloured stripe and loses its ink ring, while the graphite line fades and a handwritten note returns as a tiny pencil tick.

subtitle.default: ANOMALY VS 1951–80 MEAN, °C · ONE MARK PER YEAR

half.description: symmetric half-span of the diverging ramp

noteIndex.description: which mark gets the handwritten ring note (-1 = the last one)

x-opus.useFor: Climate / finance / health "the whole century in one band" reveals; the ramp centre, span and colours are props so it stays brand-safe.

element-columns-3d.title: Element columns 3D — props
element-columns-3d.description: A periodic table of 3D tiles on a wooden bench in a dark lab: the columns rise from the floor to heights set by a property (melting point), the camera drifts round, the tallest column is tagged with a label and a caption pill sits at the bottom. Sample values are illustrative.

values.description: 118 numbers in atomic-number order (default: illustrative melting points in K); sets column heights

unit.description: unit shown in the auto label

caption.description: bottom caption pill text
caption.default: The taller the column, the higher its melting point.

highlightLabel.description: text for the tallest-column label (empty = element name + value)

highlightIndex.description: zero-based element index to highlight (-1 = the tallest)

colors.description: six group colours: alkali, transition, post-transition, nonmetal, noble gas, f-block

maxHeight.description: tallest column height in tile widths

orbitDeg.description: camera orbit over the clip, degrees

x-opus.useFor: Show a property across the periodic table (or any 118-item grid dataset) and call out the extreme; science explainers.

emission-spectrum-lines.title: Emission spectrum lines — props
emission-spectrum-lines.description: A glowing gas-discharge tube sends light through a slit and a prism; a dark spectrum panel with an nm axis draws bright emission lines at element-specific wavelengths (hydrogen, helium, neon) as a scanner sweeps across, then swaps to the next gas.

subtitle.default: Every element glows in its own lines

gases.description: gases [{symbol,name,tube (tube glow colour),lines: [wavelength nm, ...]}] one per step

minNm.description: left end of the nm axis

maxNm.description: right end of the nm axis

showLabels.description: print the wavelength under each line

spectrumLabel.description: caption after the gas name above the spectrum panel

axisLabel.description: axis caption under the spectrum panel

x-opus.useFor: Physics and chemistry explainers on atomic spectra, "how we know what stars are made of", element fingerprints, astronomy intros.

empty-next-cell.title: Empty next cell — props
empty-next-cell.description: After a short run of pencil data marks, a dashed red rectangle draws itself around the next empty slot with a handwritten "?", holds, then widens into a frame-within-frame end card for the value nobody knows yet.

values.description: the known series (one mark per slot; the dashed cell sits after the last)

labels.description: [first, last+1] slot labels; the second is the unknown slot in the accent colour

cardSub.default: THE NEXT CELL IS STILL EMPTY

widenAt.description: frame where the cell widens into the end card (0 = never)

color.description: pencil colour of the dashed cell (red = records/warnings)

x-opus.useFor: Forecasts, "what's next" end cards, upcoming launches / quarters / seasons at the end of any chart story.

energy-jar-fill.title: Energy jar fill — props
energy-jar-fill.description: Ink-line glass jars on a clay shelf rack light up one by one: saturated self-lit liquid rises with a meniscus, its glow spills onto the shelf, panels and label cards, and handwritten values count up, then everything drains.

jars.description: jar list in reading order (top row first): {label, color, value (full value shown on the card), unit}

timeline.description: fill / drain events: {jar (index), level 0..1, at (frame)}; level 0 drains

drainAt.description: frame where every lit jar drains (staggered 3 f); 0 = never

fillFrames.description: frames for a fill (easeOutCubic; source 0.35-0.45 s)

drainFrames.description: frames for a drain (easeInCubic; source 0.3 s)

eyebrow.description: small letter-spaced eyebrow above the title ("" hides)

caption.description: italic figure caption bottom-left ("" hides)
caption.default: Fig. 1  Eight stores on one shelf. Each jar lights when its store fills.

labels.description: show the paper label cards with handwritten values

yaw.description: 3/4 view yaw in degrees (drifts +7° over the clip)

x-opus.useFor: Visualising stores and quantities (energy, budget, storage, progress) as glowing jars — a physical alternative to a bar chart in explainers and lessons.

fitness-activity-rings.title: Fitness activity rings — props
fitness-activity-rings.description: A fitness-app daily summary: three thick concentric activity rings close clockwise (a ring above its goal laps a second, lighter turn) while a count-up list shows each value against its goal with a check when closed, and a streak card with a flame and seven weekly mini rings fills in beneath.

subtitle.default: Two of three goals closed, keep the streak alive

rings.description: rings [{label, value, goal, unit?, color?, decimals?}] up to 5, outermost first; value above goal laps twice

week.description: weekly mini rings [{label, value 0-1}] up to 7; 1 = closed day (check mark)

streak.description: streak length shown with the flame (counts up)

centerLabel.description: caption under the closed-goals count in the middle of the rings

colors.description: palette for rings without their own colour

x-opus.useFor: Fitness, wellness and habit apps and promos: daily steps / calories / active minutes, closing-your-rings moments, streak and weekly-consistency stories. Each ring has its own label, value, goal, unit and colour; the week row and streak count are props.

flame-test-colors.title: Flame test colours — props
flame-test-colors.description: A Bunsen-style burner on a lab bench: a wire loop dips into the flame, which turns crimson, yellow, lilac, green, red and orange for Li, Na, K, Cu, Sr and Ca with sparks, a label pill and the matching sample bottle lighting up.

subtitle.default: Each metal burns its own colour

baseFlame.description: flame colour before the first dip

x-opus.useFor: Chemistry lessons on flame tests and emission, "why fireworks have colours", element-by-element reveals, school science channels.

floorplan-draw.title: Floor plan draw — props
floorplan-draw.description: A top-down floor plan draws itself room by room: walls trace on, each room tints and gets its name and a counting area figure, door swings appear, dimension lines measure the whole footprint and a total-area chip counts up.

rooms.description: rooms [{label, x, y, w, h, color?, area?}] in your own units, top-left origin, up to 16; area defaults to w x h

doors.description: doors [{x, y, size?, orient?("h" on a horizontal wall / "v"), swing?(1 or -1)}] placed on walls in the same units

unit.description: length unit for the dimension lines

areaUnit.description: area unit written after the numbers

showDimensions.description: show the overall width / depth dimension lines

colors.description: palette for rooms without their own colour

startAt.description: frame the first room starts drawing

x-opus.useFor: Real-estate listings and new-build promos, interior design and renovation reveals, office or store layouts, venue plans. Describe the layout with a rooms list of {label, x, y, w, h} in your own units (metres, feet); areas are computed or given.

flow-diagram.title: Flow diagram (packets on edges) — props
flow-diagram.description: Rounded boxes with icons joined by arrows that draw on in sequence (14 f each, 5 f stagger); glowing packets or labelled chips travel the edges, each receiving node pulses 1 -> 1.08 -> 1 and a highlight ring follows the active step. Auto-lays out left-to-right (top-to-bottom on portrait) from the edge graph; blueprint / paper / dark themes.

nodes.description: [{id, label, icon?: bolt|shield|chart|chat|globe|spark|lock|cog|user|db|cloud|star|queue|server|mail, x?, y? in % of frame}] (3-7 nodes)

edges.description: [{from, to, label?}] — a label turns the packet into a chip

steps.description: [{at: frame, edge?: 'a>b' | index, node?: id}] — empty = auto: packets fire layer by layer and loop

x-opus.useFor: How-it-works explainers (APIs, AI agents, networks, payments), onboarding and architecture videos: pass `nodes` + `edges`; optionally `steps` to script which edge fires when.

function-plot.title: Function plot (curve, tangent, area) — props
function-plot.description: Maths-explainer plot on dark slate: axes draw on, a curve from a safe expression string traces left to right with a glowing head, a tangent (or a secant that shrinks into the tangent) slides along it with a slope readout, then Riemann bars melt into a filled area with a running integral.

fn.description: expression in x: + - * / ^, sin cos tan exp ln sqrt abs, pi, e, implicit "2x"

points.description: optional [[x,y],...] data instead of fn (linearly interpolated)

range.description: y range [min, max]; null = auto from the curve

tangentFrom.description: x where the tangent starts sliding

fillArea.description: [a, b] integral to fill, or null for none

riemann.description: number of Riemann bars that melt into the area (0 = none)

x-opus.useFor: Maths and physics teaching, finance curves, "explain the formula" and derivative / integral explainers.

funnel-conversion.title: Funnel conversion — props
funnel-conversion.description: A conversion funnel: stage bars narrow in proportion to their value and grow in one after another from the top, labels with colour keys on the left, count-up values on the right, step-to-step "↓ 40%" conversion pills between stages and an overall conversion figure at the bottom.

stages.description: stages top to bottom [{label, value, color?}]; widths are proportional to value

subtitle.description: small line under the headline (empty = none)
subtitle.default: Users at each stage of the journey

showConversion.description: show the "↓ n%" pill between stages

showPercentInside.description: print each stage share of the top inside its bar when wide enough

summaryLabel.description: label of the final overall-conversion line (empty = hide it)

colors.description: palette for stages without their own colour

x-opus.useFor: Sales and signup funnels, hiring pipelines, checkout drop-off, content-to-lead stories, any "how many survive each step" breakdown. Replace stages, colours, prefix / suffix.

gantt-timeline.title: Gantt timeline — props
gantt-timeline.description: A project Gantt chart: a time axis with grid, task rows whose bars grow from their start to their end with a progress fill and duration, diamond milestones dropping in on a lane above, and a red "today" marker sweeping down and bobbing on the timeline; bars coloured by group with a legend.

tasks.description: rows [{label, start, end, group?, color?, progress? 0-1}] in axis units

milestones.description: diamond markers [{label, at}] in axis units (empty array = none)

today.description: axis position of the "today" marker (outside the axis range or negative = hidden)

subtitle.description: small line under the headline (empty = none)
subtitle.default: Fourteen weeks from kick-off to launch

axisMin.description: left end of the axis (with axisMax = 0 both are automatic)

axisMax.description: right end of the axis (0 = automatic)

tickPrefix.description: text before axis numbers, e.g. "W" or "Day "

tickLabels.description: optional names for whole-number ticks, e.g. ["Jan","Feb","Mar"] (index = value)

showDurations.description: print each task length on or after its bar

durationSuffix.description: text after the length, e.g. " wk", "d"

showProgress.description: fill the completed part of each bar from its progress value

colors.description: palette for groups

background.description: page colour, or "transparent" to sit over other content

accent.description: bar colour for tasks without a group or colour

startAt.description: frame the axis starts to appear

x-opus.useFor: Schedules and roadmaps: project plans, launch timelines, sprint plans, production calendars, course or treatment plans. Pass tasks as [{label, start, end, group?, progress?}] and milestones as [{label, at}] in any unit (days, weeks, months); use tickLabels for named periods.

gauge-kpi-dial.title: Gauge KPI dial — props
gauge-kpi-dial.description: A 240-degree dial gauge: coloured zone bands sweep on, tick labels appear, the needle swings to the value with a small overshoot and wobble while a big KPI number counts up in the colour of the zone it is in, with a target marker and zone legend.

value.description: the reading the needle lands on

target.description: target marker position (outside min..max = no marker)

subtitle.description: small line under the headline (empty = none)

decimals.description: decimal places on the big number

zones.description: colour bands [{to, color, label?}] ascending by "to"; empty = one accent arc that fills to the value

accent.description: colour used when there are no zones

ticks.description: number of tick intervals around the dial

x-opus.useFor: One headline KPI with a good / ok / bad reading: NPS, uptime, conversion rate, utilisation, health score, goal progress. Set value, min, max, zones, prefix / suffix.

git-branch-graph.title: Git branch graph — props
git-branch-graph.description: A git history graph from commit data: dots appear in order along a time axis, branches take coloured lanes, edges draw on, a merge commit joins two lanes, tags flag a commit, a HEAD pill travels to the newest commit and a caption shows its message.

commits.description: commits oldest → newest [{id, message, branch, parents?: ids (default: previous commit on the same branch; list 2 ids for a merge), tag?}]

colors.description: lane colours, one per branch in order of first appearance

headLabel.description: text of the pointer on the newest commit

showMessages.description: show the newest commit message as a caption

x-opus.useFor: Explaining branching and merging, release flow, pull-request workflows, version-control tutorials, "how our team ships" and developer-tool promos.

grid-exception.title: Grid exception (the one that breaks out) — props
grid-exception.description: Swiss grid poster where everything moves in exact eased snaps and one red circle hesitates, then breaks out in the only linear move, growing and pausing mid-flight before landing off the grid; a mono readout flips from on grid to red off grid, the other elements re-flow nearest-first and the grid lines extend to fill the frame.

items.description: grid elements: id, col, row, w, h (cells), kind block|bar|ring|text (+ text)

exceptionFrom.description: start cell [col,row] of the red circle

exceptionTo.description: landing position [col,row] — non-integer lands off grid

endDiameter.description: circle diameter in cells at landing

reflowTo.description: ids of elements that move out of the way: id -> [col,row]

flightFrames.description: moving frames of the whole flight

x-opus.useFor: "One product or person that breaks the mould" stories, the outlier in the data, launch films: a system plus one exception.

grid-score.title: Grid score (poster is the score) — props
grid-score.description: A Swiss poster whose modular grid draws on column by column, black note bars step down a diagonal over lighter second-voice bars; the whole sheet rotates 90 degrees, pitch labels and step numbers wipe in and a red playhead sweeps, turning each bar red on the frame it is played and pulsing a ring on the red circle.

notes.description: bars: col, row, len, voice main|second (main bars turn red when played)

pitchLabels.description: label per column, shown after the rotation

circle.description: cell of the red circle that pulses when hit

caption.description: mono caption at the foot of the poster

labelsAt.description: frame the labels start to wipe in

playFrames.description: frames the playhead takes to sweep all rows

signal.description: playhead, played bars and circle colour

x-opus.useFor: Music or audio brand films, event posters, timetables, "your data is the design" reveals, spec sheets; a data-driven Swiss poster instead of a generic bar chart.

ground-plane-ruler.title: Ground-plane ruler — props
ground-plane-ruler.description: A measuring tape is laid on the ground of a photograph in true one-point perspective, its ticks crowding toward the horizon, while a big mono counter runs and lands on the measured distance.

src.description: public/ photo with a visible ground plane (empty = procedural archive beach)
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

horizonY.description: horizon height as a fraction of the frame height (match your photo)

vanishX.description: vanishing point x as a fraction of the width

value.description: measured length in units (the counter lands here)

startDistance.description: ground distance from the camera to the tape start (bigger = flatter perspective)

startX.description: lateral ground position of the tape start (units, negative = left)

endX.description: lateral ground position of the tape end

runFrames.description: frames for the tape to reach its end

mono.description: grade a supplied photo to silver-gelatin greys

x-opus.useFor: Distances, spans and heights on real photos — sports, architecture, travel, history ("the first flight covered 120 ft").

heart-rate-monitor.title: Heart rate monitor — props
heart-rate-monitor.description: A glowing ECG trace sweeps across a gridded monitor with the classic P-QRS-T beat while a large BPM number and a pulsing heart follow the rate as it climbs from rest to a peak and recovers; a zone list (rest / fat burn / cardio / peak) highlights the current zone and the trace colour follows it.

subtitle.default: Warm-up to peak effort and recovery

unit.description: unit text next to the zone name under the number

bpmStart.description: resting beats per minute at the start

bpmPeak.description: highest beats per minute (reached around the middle)

bpmEnd.description: beats per minute after recovery at the end

zones.description: zones [{label, min, max, color?}] low to high; the one containing the live BPM is highlighted and tints the trace

zonesTitle.description: small caption over the zone list (empty = none)

accent.description: colour when a zone has none

speed.description: speed multiplier for the BPM ramp

x-opus.useFor: Fitness trackers, smartwatch and health-app promos, workout recaps, medical or wellness explainers: show a live heart rate with training zones. Set the resting, peak and recovery BPM and your own zone names, ranges and colours.

heatmap-calendar.title: Heatmap calendar — props
heatmap-calendar.description: A GitHub-style contribution calendar: one rounded square per day, shaded in levels of the accent colour, popping in left to right with month and weekday labels, count-up stats and a less / more legend; the best day gets a pulsing ring. Reflows to a grid of mini-month calendars in square and vertical frames.

values.description: one number per day, up to 371 (empty = seeded sample year)

sampleSeed.description: seed for the sample data used when values is empty

startDate.description: date of the first value, "YYYY-MM-DD" (drives month labels and weekday alignment)

weekStart.description: "sun" or "mon": which weekday is the top row

subtitle.description: small line under the headline (empty = none)
subtitle.default: Each square is one day, darker means more

prefix.description: text before total and best-day numbers

suffix.description: text after total and best-day numbers, e.g. " commits"

lessLabel.description: legend text at the light end

moreLabel.description: legend text at the dark end

showWeekdays.description: show Mon / Wed / Fri labels (strip layout)

emptyOpacity.description: opacity of days with a zero value

background.description: page colour, or "transparent" to sit over other content

x-opus.useFor: Activity over a year: commits, workouts, streaks, sales days, habits, support tickets, website traffic by day. Pass values (one number per day) and startDate, set the accent colour and unit; leave values empty to preview with seeded sample data.

iso-bar-chart.title: Isometric bar-chart staircase — props
iso-bar-chart.description: Data-driven clay-isometric bar chart on a tiled floor; a white eyed blob hops down it on the beat painting each cap orange (squash, confetti), the paint cascades, the floor ripples, and it rides a pillar back up — a seamless loop.

values.description: bar heights (any series; loop length = (N-2)*beat + 270 f for N>=6)

showCharacter.description: show the hopping blob (off: caps paint on the same beat)

loop.description: true = seamless loop with return trip; false = bars rise in, blob drops, descends and settles on the floor

maxHeight.description: height of the tallest bar in cells

floorIntro.description: 'none' (default) | 'ring-drop' (floor tiles fall in rings expanding from the centre: 0.3 s fall with a spin that settles flat at contact, squash, two tiny bounces, cyan rim flash)

x-opus-optionLabels.ring-drop: floor tiles fall in rings expanding from the centre: 0.3 s fall with a spin that settles flat at contact, squash, two tiny bounces, cyan rim flash

ringExtent.description: ring-drop: tile margin around the bars in cells

rimColor.description: ring-drop: outline flash colour on landing

x-opus.useFor: Metric stories (declines, rankings, progress through steps) as a friendly looping hero animation.

isotype-count.title: Isotype count — props
isotype-count.description: Isotype statistic: identical flat icons pop in with a back-ease overshoot into a grid, bar, row or heart silhouette, accelerating from quarter notes to 16ths while a big count-up number runs in sync; a highlighted subset turns accent and a legend reads "icon = N".

highlight.description: how many icons (from the first) turn the accent colour

unitValue.description: value of one icon (count-up = icons × this)

highlightLabel.description: legend label for the highlighted subset

bpm.description: beat grid for the pops (accelerates to 16ths and waves)

x-opus.useFor: Stats that feel physical — users, litres, votes, homes — for explainers, reports and pitch decks.

json-tree-expand.title: JSON tree expand — props
json-tree-expand.description: A JSON viewer built from a data prop: objects and arrays expand node by node with a rotating caret and child-count badge, indent guides, syntax-coloured keys and values, a highlighted newest row, auto-scroll, and a path breadcrumb along the bottom.

data.description: any JSON value (object / array) to expand

title.description: file name in the window header

collapseDepth.description: nesting depth from which objects stay collapsed as {…} (3 = three levels expand)

showBreadcrumb.description: show the $.path breadcrumb of the newest row

panel.description: window colour (dark or light — syntax colours adapt)

x-opus.useFor: API-response explainers, "what the data looks like" beats, structured-output / schema stories for AI, developer docs and tutorials, config-file walkthroughs.

live-chart.title: Live chart / ECG traces — props
live-chart.description: Line charts that draw live with a glowing head dot: growth curve + synapse curve + scrolling ECG ('trace'), two heartbeats drifting into sync ('sync'), or a quality line turning red and falling while a gauge needle swings down ('decline').

mode.description: 'trace' (growth + synapses + ECG), 'sync' (dual heartbeat sync), 'decline' (quality chart + gauge), 'threshold' (line steps toward a dashed limit, final point breaks it with shake, ring, readout panel + stamp), 'scope' (phosphor oscilloscope: beat-repainted trace with echoes, graticule, CRT-off exit)

data.description: trace: main curve values (one sample revealed per 0.25 s)

declineValues.description: decline: values of the falling red line

title.description: trace: chart title; decline: monitor title ('QUALITY' also names the gauge REASONING EFFORT)

readout.description: trace: typed mono readout under the chart

label.description: sync: label typed when the traces align

bpm.description: ECG beats per minute (sync uses it for both hearts)

series.description: threshold: 0..1 values of the line ([] = built-in climb that breaks the limit on the last point)

threshold.description: threshold: height of the dashed limit line, 0..1

stamp.description: threshold: stamp text that lands on the readout panel

echoes.description: scope: number of fading previous sweeps kept on screen

graticule.description: scope: draw the glass graticule over the trace

secondaryLabel.description: trace: axis label of the second (synapse) curve

gaugeTitle.description: decline: gauge heading (empty = 'REASONING EFFORT' when title is 'QUALITY', else 'EFFORT')

x-opus.useFor: Growth / vital-sign / metric beats, "in sync" relationship moments, "it got worse" data moments.

map-route.title: Map route — props
map-route.description: Top-down illustrated paper map (fields, river, trees, blossoms) with a marker flying a curved dotted route, a red bearing vector with angle arc and distance ticks, a dashed line to the sun; hop style hops leg by leg leaving popping dots.

waypoints.description: route stops {x, y, label} in map space -1..1 (first = start, last = bearing target)

style.description: flight = smooth curve; hop = straight legs with hop arcs, popping dots and landing rings; range = ticked measuring line A to B over imagery (camera chases the tip, pulls back, reading lands)

showBearing.description: red bearing vector, angle arc and distance ticks from the start

showSun.description: sun icon with dashed tie line to the marker

distanceKm.description: distance shown at the end of the route

from.description: range: start point as frame fractions [x, y]

to.description: range: end point as frame fractions [x, y]

unit.description: range: unit shown after the rolling value

src.description: range: public/ image used as the ground (empty = procedural satellite-style ground)
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

corridor.description: range: light a corridor along the line and dim the rest

chase.description: range: camera follows the line tip then pulls back

labelA.description: range: label of the start marker

labelB.description: range: label of the end marker

x-opus.useFor: Journeys, routes, foraging / delivery paths, travel distances, "from A to B" explainers.

math-equation-solve.title: Math equation solve — props
math-equation-solve.description: A worked algebra solution on a chalkboard: each step is a new line, surviving terms fly down (across the equals sign when they swap sides), cancelled terms are struck through, new terms pop in, notes explain each move and the answer is boxed with a burst.

steps.description: equation lines, one string per step; tokens are separated by spaces, e.g. "2x + 3 = 11" (- * / are shown as − × ÷)

notes.description: optional one-line explanation per step (same order as steps; empty strings are skipped)

accent2.description: moving-term flash, notes and answer box colour

cancelColor.description: strike-through colour for terms that cancel

fontFamily.description: optional CSS font-family for the equations (empty = monospace; keep it monospaced so columns line up)

x-opus.useFor: Maths tutorials, homework-help shorts, algebra explainers, STEM course trailers and "solve it with me" reels — pass any list of equation steps as space-separated tokens and a note per step.

microscope-dive.title: Microscope dive — props
microscope-dive.description: One continuous powers-of-ten zoom from a glass slide on a graphite bench through a procedural stained tissue section and cell field to a single nucleus; focus racks in, breathes at each magnification step and sweeps a focal plane on landing; frosted instrument panel (1-2-5 scale bar, rolling field of view, magnification and turning turret glyph) and a measurement ring with leader to a reading panel.

value.description: the measured number (also sets the nucleus size, and so the final field of view)

method.description: mono method line under the reading

bench.description: bench colour at the dark end of the graphite gradient

title.description: optional small title written on the slide label at the start

src.description: optional public/ image used as the specimen (zoom range is shortened so it stays sharp; give value/unit that match the circled region)
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

fieldLabel.description: small label above the field-of-view readout

x-opus.useFor: Scale reveals from object to cell, "one measured number" beats, science / medical / materials explainers, powers-of-ten transitions.

network-graph.title: Network graph (your nodes and edges) — props
network-graph.description: A labelled node-link diagram built from your own nodes and edges: a seeded force layout (computed once, fully deterministic) is revealed outward from the hub, nodes pop in coloured by group and sized by importance, edges draw between them, and the hub pulses with expanding rings; nodes drift slightly after.

nodes.description: nodes [{id, label?, group?, size?, color?}]; group sets the colour and legend; size (default = number of links) sets the radius; nodes missing here are created from the edges

edges.description: links [{from, to, weight?}] using node ids; weight 0.1-10 thickens and shortens the link

seed.description: layout seed: change it to get a different arrangement of the same graph

subtitle.description: small line under the headline (empty = none)
subtitle.default: Services, clients and data stores around one core

showLabels.description: print node names under the nodes

hub.description: id of the node that reveals first and pulses (empty = the most connected node)

drift.description: gentle post-layout drift in u (0 = still)

colors.description: palette for groups / nodes without their own colour

background.description: page colour, or "transparent" to sit over other content

accent.description: colour of the hub links and pulse

x-opus.useFor: Explicit relationship maps: system architecture, supply chains, org or contact networks, dependency graphs, knowledge graphs, social graphs with named members. Pass nodes [{id, label?, group?, size?}] and edges [{from, to, weight?}]; for a random generated growth effect use node-network instead.

neural-net-layers.title: Neural net layers — props
neural-net-layers.description: Columns of neuron circles joined by weighted connections: an activation wave flows layer by layer as glowing pulses (blue to yellow), line widths show the weights, and an output bar chart (softmax) updates; it repeats with fresh inputs.

layers.description: neurons per layer, e.g. [5,7,7,4] (2-7 layers, up to 14 each); the last is the output

inputs.description: optional input values 0..1 for the first pass (empty = seeded)

subtitle.description: small mono caption under the title

cycle.description: frames per forward pass (a new input is fed each pass)

travel.description: frames the activation takes to cross one layer (8-12)

showWeights.description: line thickness + hue show each weight (false = uniform lines)

outputLabel.description: small caption above the output bars

x-opus.useFor: AI / machine-learning explainers, ML courses, "how the model decides" beats, product AI-feature launch videos.

node-network.title: Node network — props
node-network.description: A force-laid community graph grows: nodes pop in and glow, links draw between them, clusters take their colours, and counters tick as connections outgrow members (network effect); a shortest path then lights up hop by hop.

seed.description: seed for the graph and its layout

growthCurve.description: linear | quadratic | exponential — how quickly nodes arrive over time

x-opus-optionLabels.exponential: how quickly nodes arrive over time

highlightPath.description: light up a shortest path between two members at the end

colors.description: cluster colours (cycled)

linkColor.description: tint of the links inside a cluster

drift.description: strength of the slow positional drift (0 = static)

x-opus.useFor: Network effects, communities, knowledge graphs, AI agents, social-proof and "everything connects" beats.

orbit-system.title: Orbit system — props
orbit-system.description: A glowing star and five bodies (one ringed, one with a moon) on dashed elliptical orbits moving at Kepler-ish speeds with name labels and orbit counters and an elapsed-years readout, then a smooth zoom into one body with a spec card.

starName.description: label under the star ("" for none)

bodies.description: bodies [{name,a (semi-major axis, AU-like),e (eccentricity),period (optional; defaults to a^1.5),r (px at 1080),color,ring?,moon?}]

timeScale.description: simulated years per second of video

focus.description: body name to zoom into ("" = no zoom)

labels.description: show name + period + orbit counter next to each body

focusLabels.description: row labels of the focus card [period, distance, eccentricity, orbits done]

distanceUnit.description: unit after the distance value in the focus card

x-opus.useFor: Astronomy teaching, "ecosystem" metaphors for products (a platform and its satellites), timelines of cycles, a hero background for space or science topics.

order-book-depth.title: Order-book depth chart — props
order-book-depth.description: Stepped cumulative bid (left) and ask (right) depth curves grow out from a dashed mid line, then breathe as levels refill; a ticking mid price, spread readout and trade pings sit on a dark trading-desk panel.

subtitle.description: small caps label above the headline (keep it saying sample data unless you pass real numbers)

pair.description: instrument label shown next to the spread (fictional by default)

midPrice.description: centre price the book drifts around

levels.description: number of price levels per side (6+)

x-opus.useFor: Finance and trading explainers: liquidity, spread, supply vs demand, market depth, fintech product heroes (sample data only).

org-chart-tree.title: Org chart tree — props
org-chart-tree.description: A hierarchy diagram from one nested tree prop: the root card pops in, then elbow connectors draw down (or across, in vertical frames) and each level of cards pops in, with branches colour-coded and an optional highlighted node that spotlights its chain of command.

tree.description: hierarchy {name, role?, color?, children?: [...]} nested to any depth

subtitle.description: small line under the headline (empty = none)

showInitials.description: draw a coloured initials badge in each card

highlight.description: name of a node to spotlight at the end (empty = none); its ancestors and descendants stay lit

colors.description: palette: one colour per top-level branch

background.description: page colour, or "transparent" to sit over other content

x-opus.useFor: Org charts, team structures, decision trees, site maps, product families, taxonomies, family trees. Pass tree as {name, role?, children:[...]} nested to any depth; reflows left-to-right in 9:16.

overhead-trail-mandala.title: Overhead trail mandala — props
overhead-trail-mandala.description: Top-down 8-panel umbrellas dance in counter-rotating rings on grey cobbles, swelling on every downbeat of a waltz, while each drips its colour as dashed dabs along its path; the camera rotates and cranes out until the trails read as a coloured mandala.

count.description: number of umbrellas (spread over the rings)

bpm.description: waltz tempo; rings swell on each bar of three

umbrellaR.description: umbrella radius in px at 1080p (the original is 128–150, fewer umbrellas)

dabEvery.description: trail dab spacing in beats (0.125 = every eighth of a beat)

zoomTo.description: camera zoom at the end (crane out)

x-opus.useFor: Choreography, routes and "many paths make a pattern": delivery networks, community, team dashboards, movement maps.

panel-triptych.title: Panel triptych collide — props
panel-triptych.description: Navy grid backdrop; three coloured panel outlines draw on clockwise, pictures slide into them with numbered labels, the panels slam together with doubled misprint outlines, then prison bars drop.

panels.description: {src, label, color} for each of the three panels (src empty = procedural scene)

caption.description: kinetic caption under the panels (words pop on one by one)

highlight.description: caption word that gets the red highlight box

bars.description: drop prison bars at the end

barCount.description: number of bars across the frame

gridSize.description: backdrop grid spacing in px at 1080p

litAt.description: lit-panel grid: frames at which panel i lights its accent border + label (e.g. on the spoken word); [] = always lit

litRise.description: panels rise this many px at 1080p, staggered (0 = no rise)

x-opus.useFor: "Three things came together" explainers, numbered causes/factors, list reveals that end in a consequence.

periodic-table-lightup.title: Periodic table light-up — props
periodic-table-lightup.description: The 118-element periodic table as rounded tiles; the chosen elements light up one per frame in ink with a pop, a second group lights in the accent colour, a big count-up "N /118" ticks beside the table, and a soft shimmer sweeps the lit tiles. Switch to a custom grid for any category matrix.

cells.description: custom grid cells [{label, row, col}] (col 1-based, row 1-based; fractional rows allowed)

lit.description: space-separated labels that light in ink
lit.default: H Li B C N O F Na Mg Al Si P S Cl K Ca Ti Cr Mn Fe Co Ni Cu Zn Ga Ge As Br Sr Y Zr Nb Mo Ag Sn Sb Te I Ba La Ce Pr Nd Gd Ta W Au Pb Bi

accent.description: space-separated labels that light in the accent colour afterwards
accent.default: Ru Rh Pd Pt Ir Os Re Eu Tb Dy Er

accentAt.description: earliest frame the accent group starts

x-opus.useFor: "How many X of Y" science and finance explainers and data storytelling (elements used in a phone, states served, features in a matrix).

perspective-grid.title: Hand-drawn perspective board — props
perspective-grid.description: Pen strokes draw a perspective trapezoid board, coloured-pencil hatch fills squares, doodle pieces pop in (outline -> blob -> sprite) during a pull-back that reveals margin doodles, then move-hint rings and "your move".

lightColors.description: [body, shade, ink] of the light pieces

darkColors.description: [body, shade, ink] of the dark pieces

caption.description: handwritten line under the board at the end

pieces.description: pop in doodle pieces on the first/last two ranks

doodles.description: draw margin doodles during the pull-back

hints.description: select a piece and show move-hint rings + cursor

pullback.description: starting zoom of the camera pull-back (1 = none)

x-opus.useFor: Game boards, calendars / schedules drawn by hand, planning grids, playful "your move" decision beats.

progress-rings-stats.title: Progress rings stats — props
progress-rings-stats.description: Activity-style progress rings with round caps that sweep clockwise to their value one after another while the numbers count up; either a row / grid of separate rings with the number inside and a label below, or concentric rings with a live legend and an overall percentage in the middle.

rings.description: rings [{label, value, max?(default 100), color?, prefix?, suffix?, decimals?}]; the fill is value / max

layout.description: "row" = separate rings in a row / grid, "concentric" = nested rings with a legend

subtitle.description: small line under the headline (empty = none)

suffix.description: default text after numbers (a ring can override)

showPercent.description: row layout: print the percentage under the number inside each ring

showLegend.description: concentric layout: legend with count-up values

centerLabel.description: concentric layout: caption under the overall percentage

thickness.description: ring thickness as a fraction of the ring diameter (row) or slot (concentric) 0.05-0.4

colors.description: palette for rings without their own colour

x-opus.useFor: Goal progress and KPI sets: completion rates, daily targets, quota attainment, fitness-style stats, survey scores. Each ring has its own value, max, colour, prefix and suffix.

pros-cons-columns.title: Pros and cons columns — props
pros-cons-columns.description: Two cards (PROS in green, CONS in red) with coloured headers; items slide in alternately, each marked by a drawn tick or cross, and a verdict pill pops at the end.

verdict.default: Great if you plan for the downsides

x-opus.useFor: Decision videos, review / comparison summaries, "should you…?" explainers, tech / money / lifestyle trade-offs — pass `pros`, `cons` and an optional `verdict`.

pythagoras-rearrange.title: Pythagoras proof by rearrangement — props
pythagoras-rearrange.description: A square of side a+b draws on; four right triangles pop in around a tilted c-square, then three of them slide into two rectangles, uncovering the a-square and the b-square, and a² + b² = c² writes itself below.

showLabels.description: side and area labels (a, b, c, a², b², c²)

triangleColor.description: fill of the four right triangles

x-opus.useFor: Maths lessons, geometry explainers, "the proof in 7 seconds" shorts, and any "same pieces, new arrangement" idea.

radar-compare.title: Radar compare — props
radar-compare.description: A radar (spider) chart: concentric rings and spokes fade in with axis labels, then each series polygon grows out from the centre in turn with vertex dots and count-up value labels; a legend lists every series with its average.

axes.description: axis labels around the chart (3 or more)

max.description: value at the outer ring (0 = largest value in the data)

subtitle.description: small line under the headline (empty = none)
subtitle.default: Scores out of 100 on six criteria

showValues.description: value labels at every vertex (best with 1-2 series)

showAverage.description: show each series average (count-up) in the legend

showLegend.description: legend beside (16:9, 1:1) or below (9:16) the chart

colors.description: palette for series without their own colour

x-opus.useFor: Comparing two or three things across the same criteria: products, plans, candidates, teams, skill profiles, before / after. Replace axes, series, max and colours.

ride-dimension-line.title: Ride the dimension line — props
ride-dimension-line.description: Quantities drawn as real lengths to one scale on a whiteboard: blue dimension arrows shoot from a shared start line while the camera rides their tips, arrowheads tap on landing, items short of the red limit line get struck through with a dashed shortfall, then the camera pulls back to the whole judgement frame and a verdict lands.

items.description: [{label, value}] one dimension line each, drawn to one shared scale

limit.description: limit / requirement value (dashed red line); items below it fail

limitLabel.description: marker label at the limit line

verdict.description: red marker verdict after the pull-back (empty = none)

rideCamera.description: camera rides the arrow tips (false = whole frame from the start)

x-opus.useFor: Comparisons in real units — spans, ranges, distances, prices against a budget — that read better than bar charts.

sankey-flow.title: Sankey flow — props
sankey-flow.description: A Sankey diagram built from a list of weighted links: node bars grow column by column and curved ribbons, sized by value and coloured source-to-target, sweep across between them with labels and values; an optional highlighted node dims everything not connected to it.

links.description: weighted links [{from, to, value, color?}]; nodes are created from the names, columns follow the flow direction

nodeColors.description: optional node name -> colour overrides, e.g. {"Paid":"#E5487F"}

subtitle.description: small line under the headline (empty = none)
subtitle.default: Monthly sessions from first touch to paying customer

suffix.description: text after every number, e.g. "K", " users"

showValues.description: print each node total (tall nodes: under the name, short nodes: next to it)

nodePad.description: vertical gap between nodes of a column in u

align.description: "justify" pushes end nodes to the last column, "left" keeps them where they land

highlight.description: node name to spotlight at the end (empty = none); unrelated nodes and links dim

colors.description: palette used for nodes without an override

background.description: page colour, or "transparent" to sit over other content

x-opus.useFor: Where things go: traffic to conversions, budget to departments, energy or cash flows, funnels with leaks, user journeys. Pass links as [{from, to, value}], set prefix / suffix and brand colours; works on a transparent background over footage.

savings-goal-jar.title: Savings goal jar — props
savings-goal-jar.description: A glass savings jar fills with a wavy liquid as coins drop in, a big saved-amount counter runs up beside it, tick marks on the glass and a milestone checklist light up as each milestone is passed, and a "to go" line turns into a sparkle "goal reached" celebration when the target is hit.

goal.description: target amount (the jar is full at this value)

saved.description: amount saved; if it reaches the goal the jar celebrates

milestones.description: milestones [{label, value}] up to 6; ticks on the jar and a checklist light up when passed

coins.description: number of coins that drop into the jar (0 = none)

glass.description: colour of the jar glass and rim

accent.description: coins, ticks, checks and highlight colour

x-opus.useFor: Savings, fundraising and crowdfunding progress, goal-tracker and fintech app promos, "save for X" explainers. Set the goal, the amount saved, your own milestones, currency and colours.

science-reticle.title: Science HUD reticle — props
science-reticle.description: Instrument overlay (rings, spokes, tick ring, axis, scale bar) builds around a procedural cell or planet that is drawn by a clockwise comet sweep; typed mono labels on leader lines, comet laps the outlines.

subject.description: 'cell' (egg with corona cells, honeycomb and pronuclei) or 'planet' (banded planet with a ring)

labels.description: [upper label, lower label] typed on leader lines

axisAngle.description: angle of the long tick axis in degrees

spokes.description: number of spoke segments between the outer rings

mode.description: 'reticle' (instrument overlay around a cell / planet) | 'lock' (four corner brackets wander over an image, snap onto a target with overshoot + ping, label leader, then open out to frame a title)

x-opus-optionLabels.reticle: instrument overlay around a cell / planet
x-opus-optionLabels.lock: four corner brackets wander over an image, snap onto a target with overshoot + ping, label leader, then open out to frame a title

src.description: lock: public/ image behind the brackets (empty = procedural plate)
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

target.description: lock: target point as frame fractions [x, y]

lockAt.description: lock: frame the brackets snap onto the target

searchFrames.description: lock: informational; the snap happens at lockAt

lockLabel.description: lock: label on the leader line after the lock

openTo.description: lock: [x, y, w, h] frame fractions the brackets open out to

openAt.description: lock: frame the brackets open out (-1 = never)

openTitle.description: lock: title shown inside the opened frame

x-opus.useFor: Scientific / microscopic / astronomical subjects, "under the microscope" beats, measured close-ups.

section-profile-chart.title: Section profile chart — props
section-profile-chart.description: A vertical plane slices one feature of a raking-lit survey surface; its profile glows on the ground while a dimensioned 2D chart of the real returns (scattered points, a fitted line, height and width dimension lines) appears in the right third, joined by a dashed leader, and the measured reading pops in the accent colour.

profile.description: optional measured profile as [[x, z], …] in metres (default: sampled from the surface)

reading.description: text of the popped reading (default: measured height + units)

anchor3d.description: plan position [x, y] of the section and its feature

accent.description: glow, fit line and reading colour

surface.description: low-ground colour of the lit surface

x-opus.useFor: Engineering clearances, product dimensions, terrain cross-sections and evidence-style explainers.

server-rack-status.title: Server rack status — props
server-rack-status.description: A server rack cabinet: units slide in, status LEDs blink, drive bays flicker and each load meter wobbles while summary tiles update; at a set moment one unit spikes, its LED goes red, it shakes and pulses and an alert card connects to it.

servers.description: rack units top → bottom [{name, load (baseline %), sub? (small text under the name)}] (1–12)

subtitle.description: small line under the heading (empty = none)

alertIndex.description: which unit raises the alert (-1 = none)

alertLoad.description: load % the alerting unit spikes to

alertText.description: alert message (empty = built from the unit name and load)

x-opus.useFor: Infrastructure, hosting, cloud, uptime-monitoring and incident stories; "your servers, at a glance" product beats; DevOps explainers.

stacked-area-flow.title: Stacked area flow — props
stacked-area-flow.description: A smooth stacked area chart (or centred streamgraph) revealed left to right by a wipe: layers swell over the timeline, a dashed scrubber follows the reveal edge with a running total, the legend values count with it, and the axis and gridlines sit quietly behind.

xLabels.description: labels along the x axis (years, months, ...)

series.description: layers bottom to top [{name, values[] (one per x label), color?}]

baseline.description: "zero" = stacked area from the axis, "center" = streamgraph centred on the middle

subtitle.description: small line under the headline (empty = none)

showGrid.description: horizontal gridlines with value labels (zero baseline only)

showLegend.description: legend with live values, beside (16:9) or below (1:1, 9:16)

showScrubber.description: dashed line and running total that follow the reveal edge

totalLabel.description: word before the running total (empty = number only)

colors.description: palette for series without their own colour

x-opus.useFor: Composition over time: revenue by product line, traffic by source, energy mix, users by plan, time spent by activity. Replace xLabels and series; set baseline "center" for a streamgraph look.

star-chart-reward.title: Star chart reward — props
star-chart-reward.description: A kids' reward chart: gold stars slam into a tasks-by-days grid one after another (squash, ring and sparks) while a progress bar and counter climb and a locked medal fills with gold; on the last star the medal unlocks with a shine, confetti and a reward message.

pattern.description: one string per task row, a character per day: 1 = star earned, 0 = no star (e.g. "11011")

goal.description: stars needed to unlock the reward (0 = every star in the pattern)

rewardText.description: message under the headline; {n} = stars earned

accent2.description: header stripe, progress bar and ribbon colour

fontFamily.description: optional CSS font-family for the title and reward headline (empty = display)

x-opus.useFor: Kids' habit and chore trackers, classroom behaviour and reading charts, parenting and school app promos, gamified learning progress and "you earned it" reward beats — pass your tasks, days, which cells earn stars and the reward text.

star-fusion-shells.title: Star fusion shells — props
star-fusion-shells.description: A glowing orange star grows on a purple starfield, a pie wedge opens onto labelled concentric fusion shells (H to Fe), the iron core swells, the star collapses and bursts as a supernova of coloured dashes that settles into a nebula.

shells.description: shell labels from outer to core (the last one is the growing core)

shellColors.description: fill per shell, outer to core

wedgeCenterDeg.description: direction of the cut-away wedge in degrees (0 = right, -90 = up)

starSize.description: star diameter as a fraction of the short side

seed.description: random seed for stars and dashes

x-opus.useFor: Explaining stellar nucleosynthesis, layered structures with a growing core, or any build-up then collapse-and-burst reveal.

step-process-numbered.title: Numbered step process — props
step-process-numbered.description: A winding path draws through numbered icon nodes; each node pops as the path reaches it, with a number badge and a title + description that fade in beside it.

steps.description: array of {title, text, icon} (3-6). icon is a name from the built-in set

default.title: Sign up
default.text: Create a free account in under a minute.

default.title: Set your goal
default.text: Pick what you want to achieve.

default.title: Build the plan
default.text: We turn it into small daily steps.

accent2.description: last-step colour (colours blend along the path)

fontFamily.description: optional CSS font-family for step titles (empty = grotesk)

x-opus.useFor: How-it-works, onboarding, recipes, tutorials and "3 steps to…" explainers — pass `steps` as {title, text, icon} (icons: check, bulb, gear, target, chart, user, doc, bolt, star, flag, search, clock, heart, globe, lock, book, rocket).

thumbnail-mosaic.title: Thumbnail mosaic (disc / grid / recap) — props
thumbnail-mosaic.description: Dozens of thumbnails as a tilted glowing disc of rings, a gapless wall you zoom out into, or a recap grid springing onto a monitor; all end in a staggered pop-out to a single dot.

layout.description: 'disc' (video4 ring disc), 'grid' (video2 mosaic wall), 'recap' (video14 monitor grid), 'spiral-count' (3x3 windows light in spiral order while the centre counter climbs; the centre lights last in red)

images.description: public/ image paths cycled through the thumbnails (empty = all procedural scenes)
images.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

procedural.description: 0..1 share of thumbnails drawn as procedural mini scenes instead of images

rings.description: disc: items per ring, first = centre dot

tilt.description: disc: vertical squash of the plate (0.82 = slight tilt)

tileSize.description: grid: tile size in px at 1080p

duotone.description: disc: [shadow, highlight] of the duotone recolour before the pop-out

lastColor.description: spiral-count: colour of the last cell / final counter

x-opus.useFor: "…and hundreds more" endings, recaps of everything shown, portfolio walls, collapsing many items into one idea.

timeline-ruler.title: Timeline ruler with event cards — props
timeline-ruler.description: A ruler of years glides under a fixed playhead dot; every event pins a card (date, image or gradient, title, one line) with a spring pop while the camera pans between events and the big odometer year counter rolls through the years in between. Horizontal on 16:9/1:1, vertical on 9:16.

events.description: [{date: "1998" (a 4-digit year is parsed), title, body?, image?: public path, icon?: name}]

default.title: The first sketch
default.body: Two people, one whiteboard, a very large idea.

default.title: First product ships
default.body: The beta goes out to a hundred early users.

default.title: Rebuilt from scratch
default.body: A new platform for the next decade.

default.title: Today
default.body: Still sketching on the same whiteboard.

scale.description: 'linear' = gaps proportional to years (clamped) · 'even' = equal gaps

holdFrames.description: hold on each event (45-75)

x-opus.useFor: Company history, product roadmaps, "history of X" videos and about-us sections: pass `events` (date, title, body, optional image).

token-pipeline.title: Token pipeline — props
token-pipeline.description: A glass-lab pipeline: glowing cubes swirl in a source bulb, stream one by one through an arched tube, spiral down a gold-ringed glass coil and reach a dropper that swells a drop, glints and drips it into a labelled flask, while the camera follows the flow and pulls back to reveal the whole lab.

gap.description: frames between cubes leaving the bulb

speed.description: cube speed along the tubes (world units per second)

sourceLabel.description: paper tag on the source bulb

dropAt.description: frame the drop releases (it swells for 15 frames before)

x-opus.useFor: Training / build / pipeline explainers ("your data goes in…"), product origin stories, "tokens in, model out" moments.

transfer-arc.title: Transfer arc — props
transfer-arc.description: A thick gradient tube arches out of one glowing ink-line jar and draws itself into the next; the target fills as the arc lands, the source drops a little, and chained arcs carry the energy purple → blue → orange → pink with light flowing along them.

jars.description: jars on the shelf, left to right: {label, color, value (shown when full), unit}

startJar.description: index of the jar that is full at the start

chain.description: transfer steps {from, to, at (frame the arc starts drawing)}

drawFrames.description: frames for an arc to draw (easeInOutCubic; source 0.3 s)

fillFrames.description: frames for the target fill (starts at 80 % of the draw)

sourceDrop.description: fraction of its level the source loses per transfer

resetAt.description: frame where arcs fade and all jars drain (0 = never)

arcHeight.description: arc apex above the rims, in jar spacings

flow.description: light pulses flow along drawn arcs

caption.description: italic figure caption ("" hides)
caption.default: Fig. 2  Each arc carries energy on to the next store.

labels.description: show label cards with handwritten values

x-opus.useFor: Showing flows and transfers between containers — energy between stores, money between accounts, data between services — in explainers and lessons.

treemap-split.title: Treemap split — props
treemap-split.description: A squarified treemap: one block fills the chart area, splits into strips and then into value-sized rectangles, each labelled with its name, a count-up value and share; colour by palette or by value, with an optional highlighted tile.

data.description: tiles [{label, value, color?}]; any count, values are relative, sorted largest first

subtitle.description: small line under the headline (empty = none)
subtitle.default: Area shows share of total revenue

suffix.description: text after every number, e.g. "M", " GB"

showValue.description: print the (counting-up) value in each tile

showShare.description: print the percentage share in each tile

lowColor.description: colour of the smallest tile when colorMode is "value"

highColor.description: colour of the largest tile when colorMode is "value"

highlight.description: label of a tile to outline and spotlight at the end (empty = none)

colors.description: palette for tiles without their own colour

background.description: page colour, or "transparent" to sit over other content

x-opus.useFor: Part-to-whole with many items: portfolio or budget breakdowns, disk usage, market caps, revenue by product, survey categories, file sizes. Pass data as [{label, value, color?}], set prefix / suffix and colours; works on a transparent background.

venn-diagram-overlap.title: Venn diagram overlap — props
venn-diagram-overlap.description: Two or three translucent circles pop in one by one with labels and example words, then the overlap region lights up and its label lands in the middle.

items.description: array (one per set) of up to 3 short example words in that set

x-opus.useFor: Explaining overlaps and intersections — skills vs interests, audience segments, ikigai-style frameworks, compare-and-contrast lessons — pass `sets`, `items` and the `overlap` label.

waterfall-bridge.title: Waterfall bridge — props
waterfall-bridge.description: A waterfall / bridge chart: an opening total, then floating increase and decrease bars that grow one after another from the running level, joined by dashed connectors, with signed count-up values and a closing total; vertical on 16:9 and 1:1, horizontal on 9:16.

steps.description: bars in order [{label, value, total?}]; total:true sets the running level (usually the first), otherwise value is a +/- change

autoTotal.description: append a closing total bar computed from the steps

endLabel.description: label of the closing total bar

subtitle.description: small line under the headline (empty = none)
subtitle.default: What moved the number, in thousands

showConnectors.description: dashed lines joining bars at the running level

showGrid.description: value gridlines (with axis labels on 16:9 and 1:1)

increaseLabel.description: legend text for increases (empty = hide entry)

x-opus.useFor: Explaining how one number became another: revenue bridge, profit walk, budget variance, headcount change, price-volume-mix. Give the opening total, the deltas and let the end total compute itself.

weather-forecast-strip.title: Weather forecast strip — props
weather-forecast-strip.description: A week-ahead forecast: a row of cards (a stacked list in 1:1 and 9:16) rises in one after another, each with the day, a live animated weather icon (spinning sun, drifting cloud, falling rain / snow, flashing storm, fog bands), a chance-of-rain figure, counting high and low temperatures and a warm-to-cool range bar; today is highlighted.

days.description: days [{day, icon(sun|moon|partly|cloud|rain|storm|snow|fog|wind), hi, lo, label?, precip?(0-100)}] up to 8

highlightIndex.description: index of the highlighted card (-1 = none)

showPrecip.description: show chance of rain when a day has precip

ink.description: text colour (icon clouds are tinted from it)

accent.description: warm end of the temperature bar and highlight colour

accent2.description: cool end of the temperature bar, rain and precipitation colour

the old bridge was designed for, and pilots report that the
clearance at high water leaves almost no margin for error.
The measured clear span required for safe passage is 1,208 metres,
more than twice the distance the present structure can offer.
A cable-stayed design meets this figure with room to spare and
can be built while the existing crossing remains in service.
Costs and timings are set out in the tables that follow, with
every figure traced to its original source document.

fireworks.description: Staggered fireworks over a night city: a faint launch streak climbs, a white flash ball holds for a few frames, then a peony of sparks expands with an ease-out-cubic, droops under gravity, fades from the core out and twinkles away, while a warm global light pulse briefly lifts the whole scene.

fish-school.title: Fish school + jellyfish — props
fish-school.description: Underwater scene: a loose school of fish sweeps across the frame along an eased Bézier S-curve, each fish trailing at its own lag with tail wobble, depth-faded colour and gentle wander, past pulsing glowing jellyfish, swaying kelp, god-rays and drifting particles.

flock.description: A V-formation of red-crowned cranes flies right-to-left over snowy peaks: birds shrink with depth along each arm, flap on twos with offset phases (white down-strokes, grey-blue up-strokes) and bob against their wings, while a lone paper crane swoops in from the lower right and takes the last slot.

forest-parallax-mist.title: Forest parallax mist — props
forest-parallax-mist.description: A misty pine forest in depth: 3-7 layers of conifer silhouettes swaying in parallax, drifting fog banks between them, breathing god rays from a low sun and floating pollen motes; loops seamlessly in dawn / day / dusk / night palettes.

insect-flight.description: Red dragonflies zig-zag over a sunny lotus pond in fast expo-eased darts separated by jittery hovers, their translucent wings flickering every frame, and one lands on a lotus bud and folds its wings; firefly mode fills a night meadow with glowing, blinking fireflies drifting between waypoints.

segmented-worm-breach.title: Segmented worm breach — props
segmented-worm-breach.description: A giant panelled mechanical worm with a toothed circular mouth bursts out of a cream line-art desert in a dust plume, arcs toward camera and dives back; optional translucent cyan x-ray pass.

seed.description: seed for panels, dunes and dust

snow-mountain-dawn.title: Snow mountain dawn — props
snow-mountain-dawn.description: Three ridged mountain ranges with soft snow lines at first light: an alpine glow breathing on the sun-facing slopes, drifting mist between the ranges, slow clouds, falling snow and pine silhouettes; loops seamlessly in dawn / day / dusk / night palettes.

skyBottom.description: override the horizon sky colour (hex); empty = from timeOfDay

snowfall.title: Snowfall — props
snowfall.description: Layered snow drifting diagonally over a dusk snowy landscape; blizzard mode streams pixel snow and streaks sideways through a blue-grey white-out. Overlay-capable.

starfield-night.title: Starfield night — props
starfield-night.description: Dark teal night sky with twinkling cream stars, a grainy crescent moon that fades in, swaying teal grass and a shooting star. Overlay-capable.

background.description: CSS background; "transparent" = overlay (stars, moon, shooting star only)

grass.description: swaying teal grass silhouette along the bottom

grain.description: static print speckle over the frame

starfield-warp.title: Starfield warp — props
starfield-warp.description: Hyperspace flight: stars burst from a vanishing point and accelerate outward as growing light streaks over a soft nebula and bright core glow; the warp amount stretches dots into light-speed lines, with optional gentle swirl; loops seamlessly and can be a transparent star overlay.

density.description: multiplier for how many particles / elements are drawn

studio-sweep.title: Studio sweep (graphite seamless backdrop) — props
studio-sweep.description: A dark graphite photographic seamless: a soft radial gradient with the floor implied only by a blurred contact shadow beneath a glossy subject, and a slow narrow softbox light sweep gliding across the set.

sweepFrames.description: length of the sweep in frames (4.2 s default)
