sun-rise-set.title: Sun rise / sun set — props
sun-rise-set.description: Sunrise: a huge orange gradient disc rises from behind teal grass with an ease-out, grows a ring of spike rays and golden leaves pop up over a starry night. Sunset mode: stepped purple-to-peach sky bands, a cream sun with rotating dashed rays sinks behind the horizon and the sky darkens to dusk.

rayCount.description: number of rays (70 rise, try 36 for set)

rayLength.description: ray length in u (rise) / ray length scale (set)

golden.description: golden leaves pop up after the rise

moon.description: crescent moon that sinks and fades as the sun rises

bands.description: sunset sky band colours, top to horizon (set)

duskBands.description: the same bands at full dusk (set)

bandStyle.description: set mode: 'wobble' (default soft wobbly band tops) | 'thinning' (flat colour stepping into the next via thinning stripes — instant screen-print sky, no gradients)

land.description: land layer colours far to near (set)

x-opus.useFor: Openers, "a new day" beats, endings and time-passing; a giant backlight disc behind a hero.

time-of-day-grade.title: Time-of-day grade (day to night) — props
time-of-day-grade.description: A simple procedural hillside village whose sky gradient and colour grade keyframe from day through golden hour, dusk pink and mauve to night: the sun arcs down and sets behind the hills, clouds pick up the sunset, a multiply night grade cools everything, the moon and stars come out and the house windows switch on one by one.

stops.description: grade keyframes [{t 0..1, skyTop, skyBottom, sun, grade}] (grade = multiply wash colour)

holdStart.description: frames held at the first stop

holdEnd.description: frames held at the last stop

lights.description: house windows switch on as it gets dark

topdown-terrain.title: Top-down terrain scroll — props
topdown-terrain.description: Bird’s-eye view: a fixed paper crane (with hatched cast shadow and streaming dashed trail) flies over seeded top-down terrain — fields, river and town roofs, ocean with a whale breach, desert dunes, snowy peaks, night city, autumn forest — that scrolls diagonally with a speed ramp and hard-cuts between biomes.

trail.description: dashed flight trail behind the hero

x-opus.useFor: Journeys and "around the world" montages, travel/progress beats, map-like transitions under a hero.

toy-town-traffic.title: Toy-town traffic — props
toy-town-traffic.description: A seeded miniature city seen from a high oblique angle: blocks of low-rise buildings with coloured roofs and blue shadows, parks with round bright trees and ponds, crosswalks, and dozens of little cars that flow, queue at red lights and surge on green (IDM car-following simulated deterministically), pedestrians gathering at corners. Actors step at 8 / 12 Hz under the time-lapse while the camera rotates smoothly, a tilt-shift focus band follows the red hero car, and a time-lapse clock ramps from ×6 down to ×1 real time.

blocks.description: [columns, rows] of city blocks (swapped automatically in portrait)

x-opus.useFor: Mobility / logistics / smart-city / real-estate explainers, "rush hour" metaphors for queues and load, satisfying looping backgrounds; nothing else in the library animates a traffic system.

window-glow-sequence.title: Window glow sequence — props
window-glow-sequence.description: A storybook brick workshop powers up: its arched windows turn golden one after another with a warm bloom and one flicker, action ticks flicker over the roof hopper, the tower cog speeds up and smoke puffs rise as a giant hand withdraws.

backlit-cutout.title: Backlit paper cut-out (holes are light) — props
backlit-cutout.description: In a dark paper night scene a hanging cut-out — a rosette window flower, a lantern or a word — lights up from behind: the paper glows deep red, every cut hole burns warm white with a two-level bloom and soft rays, and the hole pattern is projected across the ground as squashed light, with a candle flicker.

beam-clash.title: Beam clash — props
beam-clash.description: Two fighters fire white-core energy beams in their own colours that meet mid-frame in a jittering four-point star flare spraying spark streaks, with a blurred reflection on the glossy neon floor, a "DEAD EVEN!" pop and a white-out bloom at the end.

beat-punch-zoom.description: Music-synced camera kick: the whole frame punches a few percent toward a chosen point on every accent (ticks, hits, slams at different amplitudes, summed and capped) and relaxes in ~5 frames. Demo: a candy sunburst stage where a toy star squashes on each slam with a star-ring-lines burst; or feed any image with src.

confetti-burst.title: Confetti burst — props
confetti-burst.description: Flat circles, rings, squares and capsules explode radially from a point with drag, gravity, spin and 3D flutter; fill mode tiles the whole frame (video17). Overlay-ready: background "transparent".

copper-proof-pull.title: Copper proof pull — props
copper-proof-pull.description: ECU of polished warm copper with hairline scratches and a blurred four-pane window reflection: a burin cuts glinting grooves (dark trough, bright burr) with a curling swarf ribbon while the camera pulls back over the mirrored plate; then a paper sheet sweeps across with a curled edge and the image is revealed printed true, with an engraved title.

crayon-wax-shader.title: Crayon wax shader — props
crayon-wax-shader.description: Wax-crayon-on-toothy-paper look as a layer: a picture-book garden (sun, cloud, flowers, grass) is outlined, coloured lightly so the wax only catches the paper tooth, then coloured over hard until near-solid; embossed paper, fibre grooves, 12 fps boil. With src, any picture is coloured in by big zig-zag strokes through the same filter.

cyanotype-water-bloom.description: Water drops fall onto a cyanotype blueprint and bloom into deeper, more saturated blue stains with pale tide-line rims; the white line work inside each stain goes soft, and a drop on the signature makes the ink bleed.

data-view-flash.title: Data view flash — props
data-view-flash.description: Beat-synced 1–5-frame "data" flashes: the painterly army close-up cuts to the same units as flat glyphs on near-black noise (with an occasional RGB-split frame) and straight back, hiding each faction change inside a flash.

drop-splash-crown.title: Drop splash crown — props
drop-splash-crown.description: A glossy drop falls stretched onto a polished floor, squashes into a lens and throws a crown of tapered tendrils; the tips bead up and pinch off as secondary droplets that fly and land as small beads or melt into the puddle while the stubs recoil, all mirrored in the floor; a second smaller drop lands in the puddle.

eraser-rewind.title: Eraser rewind (undo wipe) — props
eraser-rewind.description: A charcoal felt eraser slides along a zig-zag path at constant speed and wipes a wide band of hand-drawn ink, leaving a faint ghost; then a corrected line is written in. Reads as "undo / rewind time" or a clean whiteboard wipe.

explosion-burst.title: Explosion burst — props

frame-blend-timelapse.title: Frame-blend time-lapse — props
frame-blend-timelapse.description: A keyed speed ramp (1x to 70x and a hard brake to 0.3x) integrated to source time, each frame an average of blended sub-frames: headlights become continuous lines, clouds turn to water, the sky runs through the day, then everything snaps sharp.

speedKeys.description: speed keyframes [[seconds, multiplier], ...] — smoothstep (log-space) between keys; 0.3 - 75

blend.description: cap on sub-frames averaged per output frame (8 - 30)

shutter.description: fraction of the frame interval that is sampled (1 = 360 degrees; ~0.4 for noon clouds)

lanes.description: road lanes (even number, half each way)

hourStart.description: clock hour at source time zero (the sky and window lights follow it)

src.description: optional still image (public/) used as the sky + skyline plate behind the road

seed.description: seed for buildings, clouds and cars

speedLine.description: HUD line; {n} = sub-frames blended, {s} = "S" when more than one

clockLabel.description: caption under the source clock readout

x-opus.useFor: Hyperlapse and time-lapse looks, "time flies" beats, light-trail backgrounds; the same speed-integration + sub-frame-average recipe applies to any procedural child.

frame-breakout.title: Frame breakout — props
frame-breakout.description: A framed woodblock-style print sits on a tan mount; the red koi inside grows, leaps and pushes out past the top border while the rest of the picture stays clipped to the frame — the camera tilts up into the mount and widens to follow, holds the almost-frozen crest outside the frame, then falls toward the lens with a camera push and small roll, bursts into foam that fills the screen and fades to bare paper. Clip is bound left/right/bottom but open on the break edge.

src.description: optional subject image in public/ (transparent PNG) instead of the built-in koi
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

breakEdge.description: which border the subject escapes: top or right

growAt.description: frame when the subject starts growing

riseAt.description: frame when it starts to rise and the camera tilts

hangAt.description: frame the crest hangs outside the frame (near frozen)

fallAt.description: frame it falls toward the lens

endWash.description: fade the foam to bare paper at the end

x-opus.useFor: Thumbnail-style "pop out of the frame" moments for any framed media: a product leaving a phone screen, a character leaping from a comic panel, a chart line breaking its axis box; dramatic climaxes.

freeze-frame-brackets.title: Freeze-frame brackets — props
freeze-frame-brackets.description: The footage stops dead with a white flash, a small punch-in and colour draining to 45 %; yellow corner brackets close in on the subject and a timecode chip with a red pause mark slides in top-right.

src.description: public/ photo (empty = procedural footage with a crossing bird)
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

subject.description: draw the moving subject on procedural footage

x-opus.useFor: "Wait — look at this" moments in reaction videos, tutorials, sports, news and explainers.

giant-eye-reveal.title: Giant eye reveal — props
giant-eye-reveal.description: In darkness a huge reptilian eye opens from a cyan slit through an almond lid mask, with a glowing fibrous iris, contracting slit pupil and lit scales; ends with an exponential push into the pupil (or an eyelid close). Overlay-ready: background "transparent".

size.description: eye size multiplier (1 = ~72 % of frame width in landscape)

holdFrames.description: frames the open eye holds (pupil contracts, iris sparkles)

ending.description: push (exponential zoom into the pupil -> endColor) | close (lids squash shut) | hold

x-opus-optionLabels.push: exponential zoom into the pupil -> endColor

endColor.description: colour the push lands on (match-cut into the next scene)

src.description: optional public/ image shown inside the lids instead of the procedural iris
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

scales.description: draw lit scales around the eye

glass-crack-mend.title: Glass crack and mend (re-leading) — props
glass-crack-mend.description: A leaded stained-glass pane takes a blow: nine white-hot jagged cracks race out from the impact in a quarter second with a flash and a 2-frame shake, then groups of glass slide along the leads into a new arrangement, one group per beat with a weld spark, and the cracks turn into dark mending lead lines.

impact.description: impact point as 0..1 of the window

groupAt.description: start frame of each re-lead group (one slide per entry)

mend.description: turn the cracks into lead lines

colors.description: jewel glass colours

src.description: optional image shown through the glass (public path); empty = coloured glass
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

x-opus.useFor: Turning points: reinvention, injury and recovery, a restored building, a before/after pivot; works over any image via `src`.

grease-pencil-mark.title: Grease pencil marks — props
grease-pencil-mark.description: Hand-made telestration: a warm-white grease pencil draws a wobbly overshooting ring around a detail, quick arrows with barbs, crosses and soft-lead underlines — each stroke doubled by a thinner offset pass so it reads waxy; optionally freezes an image with a short jolt first. Transparent overlay by default.

marks.description: annotations [{type: ring|arrow|underline|cross, at: [x,y] 0..1, to? (arrow), rx/ry (size), rot, start (frame), dur?, label?}]

color.description: pencil colour (warm white; use a dark tone on paper)

freezeSrc.description: optional image to freeze and jolt under the marks

x-opus.useFor: "Look here" evidence circles for documentaries, sports telestration on stills, tutorial screenshots, annotated archive photos.

impact-frame.title: Impact frame (flash, shake, punch) — props
impact-frame.description: On each hit: one inverted frame, one white frame, a decaying camera shake, a 1.06 to 1 zoom punch, a chromatic RGB split and a burst of speed lines with a shock ring; the default scene slams one giant word per hit (READY / SET / GO) on a new colour with an anticipation ring closing before every beat.

scene.description: draw the built-in word scene (false = effect layers only, for overlaying)

colors.description: background colour per impact (cycled)

strength.description: overall hit strength (1 = shake 2% of the frame, flash, 1.06 punch)

ramp.description: extra strength added per successive hit

lines.description: draw the speed-line burst

chroma.description: chromatic RGB split on the hit

background.description: backdrop when `scene` is off ("transparent" to overlay)

x-opus.useFor: Beat drops, fight and comedy shorts, stat slams, game trailers. Set `scene: false` and `background: "transparent"` to lay the flash + speed lines over other layers; pairs with comic-burst and speed-lines.

ink-blot-stop.title: Ink blot (pen stop) — props
ink-blot-stop.description: Where the pen stops, ink soaks into the paper as a growing teardrop: the tip stays at the nib, the belly sags downward, the rim is irregular with a darker tide line; several blots with their own timing and optional handwritten words. Transparent overlay by default.

blots.description: blots [{x, y (0..1), start (frame), dur?, size? (1 = small), label?}]

lineWidth.description: the stopped line's width in u (sets the initial dot)

x-opus.useFor: A hesitation / loss / signature beat in ink, pencil, ink-wash or woodcut styles; punctuation in hand-drawn explainers.

ink-brush-boil.title: Ink brush boil — props
ink-brush-boil.description: A doodle (light bulb, mug, star, heart or your own strokes) inks itself on warm paper with real brush lines — tapered ends, pressure wobble, heavier on the shadow side — then flat fills drop in off-register, a hatched shadow scratches in, a hand-lettered caption writes on, and every line keeps breathing (re-drawn each exposure).

strokes.description: custom: list of strokes, each a list of [x,y] in 0..1; a stroke whose last point equals its first is a filled loop

caption.description: hand-lettered caption under the drawing ("" to hide)

fillColors.description: flat fill colours (subject parts pick by index; first is also the underline)

inkWidth.description: brush width multiplier (6 px base at 1080p)

boilScale.description: boil noise scale multiplier (70 px base; bigger = smoother wobble)

boilEvery.description: frames per drawing (2 = on twos, 3 = on threes)

taper.description: taper length multiplier (14 px in / 26 px out)

heavySide.description: extra weight on the lower-right shadow side (0–1)

drawDuration.description: frames to ink the whole drawing

x-opus.useFor: Hand-made, craft or "drawn for you" moments: ideas (bulb), coffee breaks, ratings, love/likes, or any line art you feed as strokes; the kit upgrades any doodle to brush ink.

long-exposure-trails.title: Long-exposure trails — props
long-exposure-trails.description: Dusk city with a road bending to the horizon: moving lights leave long glowing streaks like a long-exposure photograph — warm white headlights streaming toward the viewer and red tail-lights streaming away, each trail a tapered additive-glow line that fades toward its tail and grows with perspective, plus a brighter hero car. Overlay-capable: set background transparent (or give a src plate) and your own light paths.

paths.description: light paths: {pts:[[x,y]…] (0-1 of the frame), color, count, speed (path fractions/s), offset (px), delay, perspective, reverse, hero}

trail.description: trail length in seconds of world time (1–4)

width.description: light core width in px at 1080p

glow.description: additive glow radius in px at 1080p

background.description: plate colour, or "transparent" to overlay on a host scene

src.description: optional plate image in public/ (replaces the procedural dusk city)
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

x-opus.useFor: Night-city intros, logistics / delivery routes, "data packets" metaphors, festive lantern scenes, traffic and motion energy over any dark plate.

loupe-magnify.title: Loupe magnify (light table) — props
loupe-magnify.description: A black-rimmed magnifier with a bevel highlight and clear acrylic skirt drops onto a document on a backlit light table, reads a line at 2.5× with colour fringing at the rim, glides to the key figure (underlined and ringed in the signal colour), then the camera pushes through the lens.

src.description: optional public/ image to inspect instead of the procedural document (fills the page area)
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

meta.description: reference / date line under the title
meta.default: Ref. NH-2041 · Filed 14 March · Page 3 of 12

lines.description: body lines of the document (one string per printed line)
default: The survey team walked the full length of the channel on four
separate mornings and recorded every reading by hand before
it was checked against the harbour charts held in the archive.
Ships now entering the port are wider and taller than any that
the old bridge was designed for, and pilots report that the
clearance at high water leaves almost no margin for error.
The measured clear span required for safe passage is 1,208 metres,
more than twice the distance the present structure can offer.
A cable-stayed design meets this figure with room to spare and
can be built while the existing crossing remains in service.
Costs and timings are set out in the tables that follow, with
every figure traced to its original source document.

keyLine.description: index of the line that holds the key figure (underlined after the glide)

keyNumber.description: text inside the key line that gets ringed (e.g. "1,208")

focus.description: lens stops as [[x,y],[x,y]] in 0..1 page coordinates; empty = meta line then the key figure

fringe.description: lateral colour fringe strength (0 = none, 1 = ±1.1 % per channel)

landAt.description: frame the loupe lands (0.4 s drop, scale 1.35 → 1)

glideAt.description: frame it lifts and glides to the second stop

pushAt.description: frame the camera starts pushing through the lens

pushThrough.description: end by pushing through the lens until the rim leaves frame

accent.description: signal colour for the underline and ring (use sparingly)

x-opus.useFor: The "look closer" beat in an explainer or evidence film: a contract clause, a receipt, a product detail, a screenshot or a map.

magnifier-loupe.title: Magnifier reading loupe — props
magnifier-loupe.description: A thin round glass lens wanders across textbook text like a reading cursor, magnifying it 1.6× with a slight barrel bulge, a prismatic orange/magenta rim fringe with tinted ghost text, a white edge highlight and a small magnifier icon; it follows its path with a soft critically damped lag. Works over any `src` image, or as glass only over host content (backdrop "none").

src.description: image to read over (public/ path or URL); empty = procedural textbook page
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

x-opus-optionLabels.none: transparent overlay: only the glass is drawn (no magnified copy)

path.description: lens path as [x, y, travelFrames] in 0..1 of the reading area (left page, or the whole frame with src)

bulge.description: barrel bulge: extra magnification at the centre (0 = flat)

icon.description: show the small magnifier icon at the centre

drift.description: slow camera push on the backdrop over the clip

background.description: colour behind the glass in overlay mode ("transparent")

x-opus.useFor: Drawing attention to fine print, a definition, a UI detail or a chart value; "look closer" and "read along" beats in explainers and product tours.

marker-ring-arrow.title: Marker ring and arrow — props
marker-ring-arrow.description: Broadcast-telestrator annotations drawn live without a freeze: glowing fluorescent marker arrows (solid for what happened, dashed with an open chevron for what was intended), a perspective ring with rotating dashes, a translucent dashed area, and a comet with a fading tapered trail behind a moving point — every stroke has a dark outline, colour glow, colour core and white highlight. Overlay-capable: set background to transparent and scene to none.

items.description: annotations: {type:"arrow"|"ring"|"comet"|"area", pts:[[x,y]…] (0-1 of the frame) or x,y,r, color (role name or hex), at (s), dur (s), dash, wobble}

palette-reink.title: Palette re-ink (squeegee recolour) — props
palette-reink.description: A finished screen-print poster of a lake under mountains is pulled again: a wide tilted squeegee crosses the sheet in about a third of a second and behind it every ink has changed (noon, golden hour, dusk), geometry identical; the big number swaps with the palette.

palettes.description: palette names (dawn, noon, golden, dusk, harbour, winter) or inline objects; one per re-ink + the first

header.description: tracked line at the top of the poster

physics-pile.title: Physics pile (falling, stacking shapes) — props
physics-pile.description: Colourful circles, rounded boxes and triangles (or letter tiles from a word) drop in one after another, bounce, tumble, stack and settle in a box, bowl or on the floor; a deterministic pre-simulated 2D rigid-body sim at 120 Hz sampled per frame, with small impact marks and exported collision frames for sound effects.

text.description: letters that fall as tiles instead of shapes (e.g. a brand name)

size.description: body size in u (1u = 1px at 1080 on the short side)

x-opus.useFor: Playful product demos, logos or words that fall into a heap, music-from-collisions, data drops (one body per item), toy / game stories.

portal-glow.title: Portal glow — props
portal-glow.description: A golden ring between paper-stone ruins with a four-point star at its centre, slowly rotating light rays, a pulsing glow, a shimmering basin pool, winking glints and rising motes, ending in a warm white-out bloom.

practical-light-shadow-jump.title: Practical light shadow jump — props
practical-light-shadow-jump.description: A cold, dim room with two figures beside an unlit lantern. On the switch-on beat the light ignites (0 to 1 in ~.3 s with a flicker overshoot), the glow blooms, the figures turn toward it and their shadows swing out across the floor from their feet while the mood flips from cold blue to warm. Source can be lantern, lamp or screen.

cold.description: colour of the unlit room darkness

x-opus.useFor: "Switching on" moments: product power-on, store opening, an idea lighting up, a story turning from dark to hopeful.

registration-snap.title: Registration snap (loose print layers clamp) — props
registration-snap.description: A crane down a screen-print: the ink layers hang loose as separate paper sheets with paper-white gaps, thickness shadows and depth parallax, then clamp into perfect register on one loud hit (2-frame shake and flash) before the key facts print in.

scribble-ball.title: Scribble ball — props
scribble-ball.description: A boiling tangle of open ink loops, regenerated every 2 frames, floats over an upset box-bot linked by a red steam squiggle; storm variant swaps in a boiling doodle cloud with a lightning scribble and rain. Overlay-ready: background "transparent".

sdf-liquid-shade.title: SDF liquid shade — props
sdf-liquid-shade.description: Coloured metaballs orbit and fuse into thick glossy jelly: smooth necks that blend their colours, dome-shaped diffuse shading from a key light, a hard specular highlight, a broad softbox sheen, a saturated translucent rim and a fading floor reflection.

smear-frame.title: Smear frame — props
smear-frame.description: Hand-animation smears: a red ink ball (or the flame mascot, or a star) holds on twos, anticipates, then whips to its next spot in one stretched dry-brush smear drawing followed by one "multiples" drawing of overlapping copies, landing with squash, trailing speed lines and an impact star on the slam.

holdFrames.description: frames held (on twos) at each station before the next whip

ground.description: ink ground line and contact shadow

smoke-puffs.title: Smoke puffs — props
smoke-puffs.description: Clusters of open doodle ink circles (or soft blurred circles) rise from a vent, grow and fade, then shrink away when fixed; flash mode fires a 2-frame muzzle flash and a forward-drifting smoke puff. Overlay-ready: background "transparent".

sparkle-burst.title: Sparkle burst — props
sparkle-burst.description: Four-point doodle sparkles burst from a contact point and twinkle out (tool-tap repair), or gold stars fly out of a jittering scuffle cloud, or twinkle around a cheering character. Overlay-ready: background "transparent".

star-glint.title: Star glint flare — props
star-glint.description: A six-spike specular "ting" with soft bloom flashes on a blade tip, shimmers through a hold and slowly decays; can slide along an edge, or fire as a quick 4-point twinkle. Overlay-ready: background "transparent".

sticker-cutout.title: Sticker cut-out (die-cut border) — props
sticker-cutout.description: Paper-sticker finish for any subject: a thick rounded off-white die-cut border, a thin grey cardboard edge peeking out below, paper grain and a soft cut-out-shaped shadow; icons, words and transparent images slap down one by one with a back-ease and sway gently.

swirl-portal.title: Swirl portal (goo-rim toon hole) — props
swirl-portal.description: A vertical oval hole in the world with a lumpy thickly outlined goo rim, five spiral arms in two alternating tints rotating inside, a pale hot core, orbiting sparks, drips off the bottom and flat rings of glow; pops open with an overshoot and boils on threes.

tape-stutter.title: Tape stutter — props
tape-stutter.description: The picture behaves like worn tape: it steps down to 15 fps while tracking, jolts two or three frames backwards, drags at 15 fps into the drop and winds down at half speed; a cassette demo with a source-time curve and OSD makes each skipped frame visible.

showGraph.description: show the source-time curve and playhead

graphLabel.description: caption under the time graph (showGraph: true)
