theatre-gate.title: Theatre gate (framed film print) — props
theatre-gate.description: Frames any picture or motion as a film being shown: a 4:3 print in a rounded aperture with a soft dark rim, flanked by deep red-brown velvet drapes lit by the screen spill and footlights, with curtains that part at the start and close at the end.

layers.description: motions to show inside the aperture [{motion, props, from, duration, ...}] (rendered full-frame and clipped)

src.description: image for the print (public path or URL); empty + no layers = procedural plate
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

openAt.description: frame the curtains start to part

closeAt.description: frame the curtains start to close (-1 = stay open)

footlights.description: warm footlight glow along the bottom

x-opus.useFor: Frames any motion as "a film being shown": retro launches, the-story-so-far, nostalgia pieces; solves 4:3 content inside 16:9 frames; wraps other motions via `layers`.

vhs-crt-pass.title: VHS CRT pass — props
vhs-crt-pass.description: Soft VHS-on-CRT playback over a night scene: smeared chroma with the red shifted right, scanlines, RGB grille, phosphor glow, dark corners, noise, a power-on opening and tracking-noise tears.

src.description: optional image path (public/) to put through the tape pass instead of the demo scene
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

subtitle.description: cream-yellow subtitle composited inside the pass (empty = none)

bleed.description: chroma horizontal smear width in px (at 1080)

rshift.description: red-chroma shift to the right in px

powerOn.description: [startFrame, endFrame] of the CRT power-on opening (equal = off)

overlay.description: true = transparent finish only (grille, scanlines, corners, noise, bursts) to layer over other motions

seed.description: seed for the demo scene and tear offsets

x-opus.useFor: Retro, 80s, found-footage and synthwave looks over any picture; use overlay:true for a scanline/grille/corner/noise finish over other layers; the power-on and tracking bursts double as a tape transition.

wash-bloom-colour.title: Wash bloom colour — props
wash-bloom-colour.description: A copperplate print of a pear is cut in black line, then transparent watercolour blooms region by region from where the brush touched — ragged wet front, spill past the line, off-register, darker tide-line, backruns and granulation — multiplied under the ink, with an engraved title and a script note.

note.description: copperplate script note, written left to right after the colour
note.default: Coloured by hand, after the print.

printDuration.description: seconds for the black line print to cut itself

colourAt.description: second the first region starts to bloom

x-opus.useFor: "Colour arrives" climax for line art: botanical / natural-history plates, maps, product sketches, heritage brands.

wax-resist-reveal.title: Wax resist reveal — props
wax-resist-reveal.description: Crayon picture-book page (hills, lighthouse, moon) drawn on toothy paper; a broad ultramarine watercolour wash sweeps across with bristle streaks and a dark wet front, and hundreds of white-wax stars plus a hidden hand-lettered message appear exactly where it passes, each uncovered star glinting.

message.description: the hidden message written in white wax (short)

washColor.description: watercolour colour (ultramarine default; try rose #9B3B5A or sap green #2F5A3A)

direction.description: wash sweep direction: right or down

hillColors.description: two crayon colours for the hills

scene.description: draw the picture-book scene (false = only paper, wax and wash)

beam.description: the lighthouse beam is coloured in after the wash

x-opus.useFor: Reveal a hidden message, thank-you names or a feature: greeting cards, kids brands, bedtime stories, education.

achievement-unlock.title: Achievement unlock toast — props
achievement-unlock.description: A round badge pops with a drawn rim and spark burst, the toast unrolls from it with ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED, the title, a description and a points chip, a shine sweeps across, then it rolls back up; several achievements play in turn.

items.description: up to 5 of {title, description?, points?, icon? (trophy|star|crown|bolt|shield|flame|heart), iconSrc? (own image), color?}

default.title: Sharpshooter
default.description: Land 100 precision hits in a single season

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay gameplay

accent.description: default badge / highlight colour (an item can override with color)

x-opus.useFor: Game and gamified-app reward pop-ups, trophy / badge unlocks in tutorials and courses, milestone "you earned" toasts, stream alerts. Replace the items (title, description, points, icon or your own iconSrc) and colours; use background "transparent" over gameplay.

army-formation.title: Army formation — props
army-formation.description: A painterly isometric battlefield with four faction armies of tiny unit sprites around banner shields: they spawn as white placeholders, flood with faction colour, bob, march inwards and trade arcing arrow volleys, with a selection ring on one army and a centre-out "initialised" title in red brackets.

factions.description: up to 4 armies {name, color, unit, chip, glyph}: unit = sprite colour, color = banner tint, glyph = star | ring | diamond | bolt

spawnAt.description: frame the units pop in as white placeholders (colour floods ~15 frames later)

march.description: ground units per second the blocks advance towards the centre

select.description: index of the army that gets the selection ring (-1 = none)

selectLabel.description: label on the selection leader line

title.description: centre title in red corner brackets ("" = none)

titleAt.description: frame the title reveals centre-out (holds ~2 s)

push.description: camera push-in in %/s

ringColor.description: selection ring and status text colour

statusLabel.description: small status text next to the selection label

x-opus.useFor: "AI models / teams / products compete" stories, strategy explainers, market-share battles, game trailers.

bracket-advance.title: Bracket advance — props
bracket-advance.description: Single-elimination tournament bracket from your entrants and results: winners light up, connector lines draw on in the accent colour, names advance round by round, losers dim, and a champion card lands. Left-to-right in landscape, top-to-bottom in portrait.

teams.description: entrants in bracket order (2-16; padded to a power of two with byes)

results.description: per round, per match: 0 = the upper entrant won, 1 = the lower one (ignored where a bye decides)

roundNames.description: column labels, first round first; empty = automatic (Quarterfinals, Semifinals, Final...)

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay content

x-opus.useFor: Esports and sports tournament announcements, playoff recaps, "road to the final" posts, quiz or pitch-competition brackets. Give `teams` (2-16) and `results` (0 = upper side won, 1 = lower side won per match, per round).

candy-set-backdrop.title: Candy set backdrop — props
candy-set-backdrop.description: Full-bleed game-show set: one saturated candy hue with a same-hue lighter pattern — slowly scrolling diagonal stripes, offset polka dots or a rotating sunburst — plus a darker floor band with an ink line, a hopping "GAME 1" pill, star bursts and beat punches; the hue hard-cuts with a white flash every two bars.

variant.description: pattern: stripes | dots | rays

hues.description: one hue per section (hard cut every 2 bars)

sections.description: how many hue sections the duration is cut into (informational)

bpm.description: tempo for scroll, hops and punches (150 = source)

floor.description: darker floor band with the 8 px ink line

punch.description: beat-punch camera + star bursts on downbeats

rays.description: ray count for the sunburst variant

patternLift.description: how much lighter the pattern is than the hue (0..1)

background.description: behind the set (visible only if the set were transparent)

x-opus.useFor: Instant loud backdrop for quizzes, kids content, sales promos, chapter cards; pairs with kinetic-captions, comic-burst and bean mascots.

countdown-to-kickoff.title: Countdown to kick-off — props
countdown-to-kickoff.description: Two team crests flank four rolling countdown tiles (days, hours, minutes, seconds) that tick down with a roll and a pulse on the seconds tile, under stadium light beams in the team colours, with competition, date and venue lines; at zero the headline switches to a final message.

finalText.description: headline once the clock hits zero inside the clip

competition.description: small line at the top (competition, round)

tagA.description: short tag for team A (logo fallback)

logoA.description: team A logo image (public/ path or URL); empty = coloured tag badge

logoB.description: team B logo image; empty = coloured tag badge

colorA.description: team A colour (crest, glow, light beam)

days.description: days left at the start of the clip

rate.description: clock speed: 1 = real time, 60 = a minute per second, 3600 = an hour per second

labels.description: four labels under the tiles (Days, Hours, Min, Sec)

date.description: date / time line; empty hides it

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay footage

x-opus.useFor: Match-day teasers, "kick-off in" promos, tip-off, race-start, tournament and event countdowns. Set the starting days / hours / minutes / seconds, the two teams (names, colours, optional logos), the date and venue.

fuse-beat-timer.title: Fuse beat timer — props
fuse-beat-timer.description: A rope fuse along the bottom with one knot per beat; a sparkling spark spawning star particles travels along it so it passes every knot exactly on the beat, charring the rope, toward a rocket (that launches) or a bomb (that bursts). A big beats-left numeral pops on every beat over a violet sunburst stage.

beats.description: number of beats = number of knots (4-8 typical)

bpm.description: tempo; the spark travels one knot per beat

freezeBeat.description: freeze the spark at this beat (replays); -1 = run to the end

stage.description: paint the violet sunburst stage; false = transparent overlay (fuse + numeral only)

readyText.description: word shown before the spark is lit

doneText.description: word shown when the fuse reaches the icon

ink.description: outline colour of the fuse and numerals

accent.description: numeral colour for the last 2 beats, GO! fill and beat pulse bar

accent2.description: hard-shadow colour of READY? and the numeral

alert.description: hard-shadow colour of GO! and the last-2-beats numeral

x-opus.useFor: Countdowns for quizzes, challenges and limited-time offers; on-beat timers; game-show / microgame formats; set stage=false to overlay the fuse on any scene.

kill-streak-banner.title: Streak banner (double / triple / ...) — props
kill-streak-banner.description: A slanted full-width banner slams in with shake, flash and speed lines: multiplier badge, tier word (DOUBLE, TRIPLE, QUAD...), lit pips and a counting points reward; each next tier hits harder and shifts colour.

labels.description: tier words in order (Double, Triple, Quad, Mega...)

count.description: how many tiers to play (1-6, at most the number of labels)

suffix.description: word after the tier (Streak, Combo, Kill, Win...)

startAt.description: multiplier shown on the first tier (x2 by default)

player.description: name on the line under the band

detail.description: small caption next to the name; empty hides it

points.description: reward per tier step (counts up, grows with each tier); 0 hides it

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay gameplay

x-opus.useFor: Multi-kill and combo callouts in gaming highlights, win streaks, quiz or sales streaks, "combo x3" moments in app demos. Rename labels, suffix, player and points; background "transparent" overlays gameplay footage.

level-up-burst.title: Level-up burst — props
level-up-burst.description: An XP bar fills with a counting reward and overflows in a flash: rays, shockwave rings and sparks burst from a hex level badge whose number ticks up, LEVEL UP slams in, the bar drains to the carry-over and perk chips pop.

title.description: big word on the burst (LEVEL UP, RANK UP, NEW TIER...)

level.description: the new level shown on the badge (the old one is level - 1)

xp.description: xp reward counted up on the bar

xpLabel.description: unit after the number (XP, PTS, STARS)

carry.description: fraction of the bar left filled after the level-up (0-1)

perks.description: up to 3 chips shown under the bar

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay content

x-opus.useFor: Game progression and reward moments, gamified apps and courses ("you reached level 12"), streak or rank-up celebrations, creator milestone cards. Replace title, level, xp and perks; works as an overlay with background "transparent".

lit-pixel-sprite.title: Lit pixel sprites — props
lit-pixel-sprite.description: Flat low-res pixel characters with 1-px selout outlines step through 4-frame walk cycles and 2-frame idles on a dusk plaza. Two practical lamps and a drifting lantern tint their colours as they pass, posterised light pools band across the floor, and each sprite casts sheared shadows away from every nearby light while the camera drifts smoothly.

pixel.description: screen px per sprite pixel at 1080p (5–10)

ambient.description: cool ambient light colour (the unlit tint)

chars.description: number of characters 1–4 (the last one idles)

camera.description: smooth camera sway in px (0 = locked)

x-opus.useFor: Retro-game storytelling, pixel mascots in a lit set, HD-2D mood; pairs with pixel-dither.

lives-counter.title: Lives counter — props
lives-counter.description: A dark rounded toon panel (ink outline, hard shadow) with hero-head icons: on a loss one icon cracks in five frames, shards fly, it shakes and greys while a slam caption announces it; the last life blinks at 2 Hz under a top-spot light; a gain re-lights an icon with a pop.

events.description: array of {t seconds, delta} (-1 = lose a life, +1 = gain one)

spotlight.description: top-spot light on the last remaining life

stage.description: paint the violet sunburst stage; false = transparent overlay

lastText.description: slam caption when one life remains

ink.description: outline colour of the panel, icons, tab label

iconColor.description: icon body colour ('' = the icon's own colour: heart red, star gold, pilot cream)

lossColor.description: caption hard-shadow colour on a loss

lastColor.description: caption hard-shadow colour when one life remains

gainColor.description: caption hard-shadow colour on a gain

x-opus.useFor: Battery / retries / chances metaphors, gamified explainers, quiz shows, "you only get three tries" beats.

loot-reveal.title: Loot reveal — props
loot-reveal.description: Mobile-game reward moment: a wooden chest (or sealed card / medallion) drops in, shakes in three escalating beats while rarity-coloured light leaks out, bursts with a 2-frame flash, shockwave, god rays and particles, then an item card rises, flips to a faceted gem (or your image), stars pop in and a title banner stamps on.

image.description: optional public/ path or URL for the item art (falls back to a faceted gem)
image.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

rarityLabel.description: override the rarity word on the card ("" = from rarity)

accent.description: override the rarity colour (hex, "" = from rarity)

background.description: dark base colour (tinted by the rarity colour)

shakeBeats.description: number of escalating shake beats before the burst

x-opus.useFor: Achievements, onboarding rewards, "you unlocked X" moments in apps, giveaway reveals and promo hooks. Set rarity for the colour set, image for the item art and title for the banner.

match-scoreboard.title: Match scoreboard — props
match-scoreboard.description: Slanted two-team scoreboard with crests, score boxes that roll up point by point with a flash, a centre match clock, a stage label and a subtitle chip.

teamA.description: left team name (shown at wide frames)

tagA.description: left team short tag (3 letters; used in narrow frames and as the logo fallback)

logoA.description: left logo image (public/ path or URL); empty = coloured tag badge

logoB.description: right logo image; empty = coloured tag badge

scoreA.description: final score of the left team (points tick up one at a time)

scoreB.description: final score of the right team

stage.description: label above the bar (e.g. Grand Final, Map 2)

subtitle.description: chip under the clock (e.g. Best of 5); empty hides it

clockFrom.description: match clock at the start, in seconds (counts down if larger than clockTo)

clockTo.description: match clock at the end, in seconds

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay footage

x-opus.useFor: Esports and sports match overlays, tournament recaps, "score so far" cards and stream scenes. Give your team names, tags, logos and colours; use background "transparent" to lay it over footage.

match-stats-compare.title: Match stats comparison — props
match-stats-compare.description: Two team crests and names over a stack of comparison rows: each stat has a centred label, two values that count up and a bar that opens from the middle to the split (share or mirrored); the leading side lights up in its colour, the other dims; optional score in the middle.

subtitle.description: small line at the top (e.g. Full time, Half time)

logoA.description: left logo image (public/ path or URL); empty = coloured tag badge

logoB.description: right logo image; empty = coloured tag badge

scoreA.description: left score; set either score to "" to show VS instead

stats.description: array of {label, a, b, suffix?, decimals?, lowerBetter?} (8 max); lowerBetter lights the side with the smaller value (e.g. fouls)

barMode.description: split = one bar split by share of the pair | mirror = both bars measured against the larger value

x-opus-optionLabels.split: one bar split by share of the pair
x-opus-optionLabels.mirror: both bars measured against the larger value

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay footage

x-opus.useFor: Post-match and half-time stats (possession, shots, corners), head-to-head previews, player-vs-player or product-vs-product comparisons. Give the two team names, colours (and logos) and the stats as {label, a, b}.

medal-podium.title: Medal podium — props
medal-podium.description: A 2-1-3 podium whose blocks rise in turn (bronze, silver, gold); each winner drops on top with a photo or initials badge, name, a flag-style colour chip and a result line, then a spotlight, a sheen on the gold block and a confetti burst.

subtitle.description: small line above the heading (e.g. category)

winners.description: up to 3 entries in order 1st, 2nd, 3rd: {name, detail (time / score), colors[] (flag-style colour chip: 1-4 stripes), src (optional photo, public/ path or URL)}

medalLabels.description: words on the blocks, e.g. ["Gold","Silver","Bronze"] or ["1st","2nd","3rd"]

confetti.description: confetti burst when the winner lands

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay footage

x-opus.useFor: Results and winners reveals: Olympic-style medal ceremonies, tournament top three, race and contest podiums, quiz or sales leaderboards, "top 3 of the year" slides. Give the winners as {name, detail, colors[], src}, in order 1st, 2nd, 3rd.

palette-lut-grade.title: Palette LUT grade — props
palette-lut-grade.description: A pixel lakeside scene changes time of day by swapping palette slots, not by fading: day, afternoon, golden, sunset, dusk, night, each in two 1/3 steps; a dithered night front rolls in toward a lantern and a dithered light pool re-lights the nearby cabin and ground; water slots colour-cycle and stars twinkle.

stagesAt.description: five frames: when afternoon, golden, sunset, dusk and night start

nightWave.description: night arrives as a dithered ring rolling in toward the lantern (false = plain 1/3-step change)

lightPool.description: after night, the lantern re-lights nearby materials with a dithered falloff

label.description: show the current stage name in pixel text

palette.description: optional hex overrides for the daylight slot colours (38 slots, see SLOT order in r2-mg2b-kit)

seed.description: seed for clouds, trees and ground texture

x-opus.useFor: Honest pixel-art day/night, mood shifts and spotlight effects that never leave the palette; the grading model for any pixel scene (slot-indexed art + per-stage colour table).

pixel-platformer-scene.title: Pixel platformer scene — props
pixel-platformer-scene.description: Attract-mode pixel platformer in crisp 180p index colour: parallax mountains, clouds, forest hills with a colour-cycling waterfall, a scrolling ground with a river and sagging plank bridge, a chibi hero running, jumping, grabbing coins and stomping slimes, with +100 / +500 popups and a SCORE / COIN HUD.

events.description: list of {t (frame the hero meets it), kind: coin | stomp | jump | stop}; stop = decelerate and stand

scrollSpeed.description: world scroll in pixels per frame (180p picture)

heroColor.description: hero suit colour (hex); empty = default red

palette.description: optional hex overrides for the 38 palette slots (see SLOT order in r2-mg2b-kit); empty = daylight palette

stagesAt.description: frames at which the day shifts to afternoon, golden, sunset, dusk, night (empty = stay daytime)

crt.description: scanlines + vignette over the upscaled pixels

seed.description: seed for clouds, trees and ground texture

x-opus.useFor: Gaming channels, indie-game trailers, "level up" beats in explainers and nostalgic brand ads; set `events` to land coins and stomps on the music.

pixel-reward-burst.title: Pixel reward burst — props
pixel-reward-burst.description: A pixel treasure chest shakes while the view steps in by whole-number zooms (x6, x8, x10, x12) with "?" and "!" bubbles and two lid hops, then bursts open: palette flash, a rotating fan of dithered light rays that grows and collapses in stepped drops, a ballistic coin fountain and a gem that rises and glows.

rayColors.description: two ray colours, outer and inner

zoomSteps.description: four whole-number zoom levels before the burst

x-opus.useFor: Unlock / reward / reveal beats in gamified product videos, giveaways and "new feature" reveals.

pixel-sprite-scene.title: Pixel sprite scene (state machine) — props
pixel-sprite-scene.description: A native ~160x90 pixel night scene with dithered sky bands, twinkling stars, a pixel moon, stepped mountains and a ground line; a procedural wizard / knight / cat sprite loops idle, charge, cast, recover with palette-stepped particles, a 1 px moon rim light, 10 fps character timing and 1-2 px screen shake on the cast.

customArt.description: rows of characters for a custom sprite, e.g. ["..oo..","ohhho."] (.=transparent)

customPalette.description: map char -> hex colour for customArt

palette.description: scene palette: sky[] bands (top->horizon), star, moon, far/near mountains, ground, hero colours, magic, rim

pixelFactor.description: screen px per logical pixel at 1080 (12 = 160x90)

spriteScale.description: integer scale of the sprite (2 = chunky 2x2 pixels)

x-opus.useFor: Retro game promos, indie-dev trailers, nostalgic social posts and loading loops. Pass `sprite`, `palette` and `states` to retheme; for a lit-set storytelling look use lit-pixel-sprite instead.

player-stat-card.title: Player stat card — props
player-stat-card.description: Profile card with an avatar panel, name, handle, role and team chips, an overall-rating hex badge and segmented stat bars that fill and count up in turn. Side-by-side in landscape, stacked in portrait.

src.description: avatar image (public/ path or URL); empty = neutral silhouette with initials
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

stats.description: array of {label, value, max?, suffix?} (up to 6); bars fill to value / max (max defaults to 100)

overall.description: number for the badge, or "auto" to average the stats

badgeLabel.description: tiny label in the badge (OVR, LVL, RTG)

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay content

x-opus.useFor: Esports roster and player-of-the-match cards, character or hero select, fantasy picks, athlete or team-member intros, product-spec "stat" cards. Set `src` to the avatar and `stats` to your own labelled numbers.

race-leaderboard-live.title: Race leaderboard (live) — props
race-leaderboard-live.description: A slanted timing tower: the field is re-ranked at every lap / split, rows glide into place, overtakers flash with a green arrow and places gained, the leader shows the race time and the rest the gap behind, with an optional last-lap column and a lap counter.

checkpointLabel.description: word beside the counter (Lap, Split, Heat, Stage)

entries.description: array of {name, color, tag?, laps: number[]}: laps = time for each lap / split in seconds (cumulative times are worked out; the field is ranked after each checkpoint; 12 entries max, shortest laps array sets the checkpoint count)

showLapTimes.description: show each competitor's last lap time (hidden automatically on narrow frames)

decimals.description: decimals in gaps and times (1 to 3)

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay footage

x-opus.useFor: Race and heat coverage (motor racing, cycling, swimming, athletics, rowing, esports races), "who is ahead" timing towers, live-results recaps and standings changes. Give each competitor a name, a colour and their lap/split times in seconds.

rocket-to-moon.title: Rocket to moon — props
rocket-to-moon.description: A launch end card: the hero shoots up off a lantern-lit stage on a light trail, a one-frame flash cuts to space, it streaks to a big halftoned crescent moon and plants as a shrinking four-spike flare while the moon glows blue and the product name and "NOW LAUNCHED" pop in.

title.description: product name that pops in at the lower left

subtitle.description: small tracked line under the title

src.description: optional public/ image for the hero (default an original slime orb)
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

cutAt.description: frame of the cut from the stage to space

moonGlow.description: colour the moon's dark side lights up with

x-opus.useFor: "Launched / shipped / now live" end cards for product launches and release videos.

rpg-menu-ui.title: RPG menu UI — props
rpg-menu-ui.description: Game systems as narration at native 320x180: FIGHT/ITEM/MAGIC/RUN with a bobbing hand cursor that hesitates, a party window with HP ticking down (red when low, greyed member, blinking KO), a level-up stat roll, a save-file list choosing NEW FILE and an item-get box, on a dithered blue window skin.

screens.description: sequence of {type: battle|levelup|save|item, t0 start frame, dur frames}

party.description: battle party rows {name, hp, hpTo (hp after the hit, first member only), maxHp, dim}

item.description: name shown in the item-get box

showCues.description: show tiny SFX cue tags (cursor, select, HP tick, fanfare, item get) for sound design

x-opus.useFor: "Level up" product or skill announcements, comparison as a stat screen, career or version histories as save files, playful UI for game studios and dev content.

shot-map-heat.title: Shot map with heat — props
shot-map-heat.description: A half pitch or half court draws on and shots land one by one (goals as bold discs, saves as hollow dots, misses as crosses) while a smooth heat map of shot locations builds underneath; counters for shots, goals and conversion run in a side panel or header.

shots.description: array of {x, y, result, value}: x 0..1 across the drawn area (1 = goal / basket line), y 0..1 across the width, result goal|made | saved|hit | miss, value 0..1 shot quality (sizes the dot and the heat). Empty = built-in sample

half.description: true = attacking half only (bigger), false = whole pitch / court (x then runs along the whole length)

showTrails.description: draw a short dashed line from each shot towards goal

goalLabel.description: name for scored shots (Goals, Baskets, Made)

heatColors.description: heat ramp from cold to hot, 2-5 hex colours

field.description: surface colour, or "auto" for the sport default (darkened)

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay footage

accent.description: goal dot and heading highlight colour

x-opus.useFor: Match and player shot maps, xG explainers, basketball shot charts, scouting reports and "where do they score from" stories. Give the shots as {x, y, result, value} (x 0 = far edge .. 1 = goal line, y 0..1 across, result goal | saved | miss).

stopwatch-split-times.title: Stopwatch with split times — props
stopwatch-split-times.description: A large stopwatch (sweep hand, lap-progress ring, digital readout) counts up while each lap freezes the readout and drops a row into a splits list with a bar, the time and the +/- against the previous lap; at the finish the best lap turns green, the slowest red and a total bar locks in.

laps.description: lap / split durations in seconds, in order (up to 12); the total and the cumulative clock are worked out

lapLabel.description: word before the lap number (Lap, Split, Round, Set)

showDial.description: show the stopwatch dial (false = list only, bigger)

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay footage

accent.description: sweep hand, lap ring and total bar colour

good.description: colour of faster laps / best lap

bad.description: colour of slower laps / slowest lap

x-opus.useFor: Lap and split reveals for running, swimming, cycling and motorsport, speed-run segments, workout intervals, cooking or study timers and any "how the time was made up" story. Pass the lap durations in seconds; real time is compressed to fit the clip.

stream-starting-soon.title: Stream starting soon — props
stream-starting-soon.description: Looping "starting soon" screen: drifting stripes and orbs, a big layered title, a ring of ticks sweeping around a live mm:ss countdown, a message line and a ticker that rotates your social handles.

title.description: big title (STARTING SOON, BE RIGHT BACK, WE ARE LIVE...)

streamer.description: channel / host name shown beside the logo

logoSrc.description: logo image (public/ path or URL); empty = coloured initials badge

message.default: Grab a drink, we go live in a moment

countdownFrom.description: countdown start in seconds (ticks down once per second through the clip)

socials.description: up to 5 of {label, handle} that rotate in the bottom ticker

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay content

accent2.description: second colour for glow and stripes

x-opus.useFor: Live-stream, premiere and webinar waiting screens, "be right back" and pre-roll loops. Set title, streamer, logoSrc, countdownFrom (seconds) and socials; loop it under the real countdown or render it as the idle scene.

tactical-map.title: Tactical map — props
tactical-map.description: A "HUD OFF" symbolic battle view: coloured glyph clusters (circles, triangles, hexagons) drift on a near-black isometric grid with stepped white selection rectangles, dashed command links, a floating command box and horizontal glitch bands on entry.

factions.description: up to 4 armies (chip colour is used for the glyphs)

march.description: ground units per second the clusters drift inwards

links.description: dashed command links between cluster leads

selections.description: number of stepped white selection rectangles

glitchAt.description: frames with a horizontal glitch-band burst

commandBox.description: text of the floating command box ("" = none)

seed.description: layout seed (match army-formation for an exact HUD-ON/OFF pair)

x-opus.useFor: Abstract strategy diagrams, "simulation view" of any system, a data-overlay twin of a scene (pairs with army-formation).

team-lineup-pitch.title: Team line-up on pitch — props
team-lineup-pitch.description: A pitch or court draws on, then each player drops onto his position as a numbered disc with a name tag; dashed links join each line of the formation and one player can be spotlighted. Title and formation label sit beside (wide) or above (square / tall).

formation.description: big formation label (e.g. "4-3-3", "2-1-2"); empty hides it

players.description: array of {name, number, x, y}: x 0..1 from own goal to the opposing goal, y 0..1 across the pitch (up to 15). Empty = built-in sample line-up for the sport

highlight.description: player number or name to spotlight (pulsing ring); empty = none

showNames.description: show the name tag under each disc

links.description: dashed lines joining the players of each line of the formation

field.description: surface colour, or "auto" for the sport default (green pitch / wood court)

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay footage

x-opus.useFor: Starting-XI graphics, team sheets, tactics explainers, five-a-side or basketball starting fives, fantasy picks and match-day previews. Give the players as {name, number, x, y} (x = 0 own goal to 1 opposing goal, y = 0 to 1 across), your team colour and a title.

transfer-announcement.title: Transfer announcement — props
transfer-announcement.description: Club-colour panels wipe in, the player photo slides onto a slanted panel, the name reveals line by line, then FROM club to TO club crest chips with a travelling arrow, a fee and date chip, a contract note and an OFFICIAL stamp that slams on.

label.description: chip above the name (Transfer news, Here we go, Signed)

playerName.description: full name; the last word is shown large, the rest on a smaller line above

src.description: player photo (public/ path or URL); empty = neutral silhouette
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

fromTag.description: short tag on the from crest (3 letters)

toTag.description: short tag on the to crest

fromLogo.description: from-club logo image; empty = coloured tag badge

toLogo.description: to-club logo image; empty = coloured tag badge

fee.description: fee text (any format); empty hides the chip

date.description: date text; empty hides the chip

note.description: extra line under the chips (contract length, shirt number); empty hides it

stampText.description: text of the final stamp; empty hides it

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay footage

x-opus.useFor: Signing, transfer and trade announcements, new-hire or new-member reveals, "joins" and "moves to" news cards. Pass the player name, photo (src), the two clubs with colours and tags (or logos), the fee, the date and a note.

vs-splash.title: VS splash — props
vs-splash.description: A fighting-game versus card: blue and red striped panels slam shut along a steep diagonal with a white divider, a dark VS badge with a gold crescent springs in, a brush word pops above, judge mascots wobble below, and "FIGHT!" slams in over radial speed lines while the card dims.

left.description: left fighter {name, color, color2 (stripe tones), src? (portrait image; default an original critter)}

right.description: right fighter (default an original slime orb)

badgeText.description: text in the round centre badge

slamText.description: word slammed over everything at slamAt ("" with slamAt 0 = never)

badgeGradient.description: VS text gradient, 3 hex colours top to bottom

topColor.description: word above the badge, fill colour

slamGradient.description: slam word gradient, 3 hex colours top to bottom

x-opus.useFor: Any A-vs-B comparison (products, models, plans, teams), sports / esports promos and battle intros.

agent-roster.title: Agent roster — props
agent-roster.description: A 2×2 block of agent status cards (portrait, name, points, coloured status chip with animated dots, a 7-digit token counter ticking up, a thin progress bar) that slides in from the left, plus a bottom-right row of line-icon controls.

agents.description: up to 4 agents {name, color, status, points, tokens, rate (tokens/s)}; status ending in "..." animates its dots

chipText.description: chip text colour per agent (default dark)

hudLabel.description: label under the eye icon ('HUD ON' / 'HUD OFF')

demoScene.description: paint the painterly battlefield behind (preview only; turn off as an overlay)

x-opus.useFor: Multi-agent dashboards, leaderboards and AI benchmark videos; overlay-capable with background "transparent".

alert-reink-wave.title: Alert re-ink wave — props
alert-reink-wave.description: A cyan radar HUD scans while a contact closes in; at the climax a ring expands from the target and everything inside it is re-inked from cyan to orange (a feathered mask edge, a thin white-hot front and a soft orange annulus ride the wave), the readouts flip to the alert copy and true reds (the REC dot) keep their colour.

fromPalette.description: palette before the wave {main, hot, dim, bg}

toPalette.description: palette after the wave {main, hot, dim, bg}

at.description: frame the wave leaves the target

duration.description: frames for the wave to cross the frame (~0.45 s to 1300 px)

originX.description: wave origin x as fraction of width

originY.description: wave origin y as fraction of height

keepRed.description: true reds (REC dot) are exempt from the re-ink

recLabel.description: label next to the red record dot

panelTitles.description: titles of the left / right side panels (prefixed with "01 // ")

calmNames.description: left-panel gauge names before the alert (5)

alertNames.description: left-panel gauge names after the alert (5)

x-opus.useFor: The climax beat of any HUD, alert or "status changed" moment; generalises to any palette swap (day to night, calm to alarm, brand A to brand B).

blur-redact-region.title: Blur / pixelate redact region — props
blur-redact-region.description: Tutorial / privacy overlay: boxes over regions of the footage frost what is underneath (backdrop blur), pop in a scattered pixel mosaic or slide a solid censor bar across, each with corner ticks and a lock badge label; a region can drift to follow a moving element.

regions.description: array of {x, y, w, h (0-1, x/y = top-left), mode?: blur|pixelate|bar, label?, toX?, toY? (drift to this top-left), at?}

blurPx.description: backdrop blur radius in u (blur and pixelate modes)

outline.description: dashed outline and corner tick colour

showLabels.description: show the lock badge label above each region

exitAt.description: frame everything fades at (0 = just before the end)

demoBackground.description: true paints a neutral mock screen behind (previews); false = transparent overlay

x-opus.useFor: Hide names, emails, keys or faces in a screen recording or screenshot walkthrough: pass `regions` (0-1 rects) with a `mode` and a label like "Hidden".
x-opus.avoid: Replace the sample labels (Blurred / Pixelated / Hidden).

breaking-news-takeover.title: Breaking news takeover — props
breaking-news-takeover.description: A full-screen "BREAKING NEWS" slam: white flash, an accent panel wipes across and the label crashes in with a shake, then contracts to a top band while the headline wipes in line by line, a sub-line fades up and a ticker scrolls along the bottom. Generic channel name; set background to "transparent" to lay it over footage.

label.description: the slam word(s), e.g. "BREAKING NEWS", "JUST IN", "ALERT"

channel.description: channel / programme name shown in the band (generic sample, replace)

headline.description: main headline (wraps to 3 lines in 16:9, 5 in portrait)
headline.default: City council approves new harbour crossing after overnight vote

subhead.description: one or two supporting sentences under the headline (empty = none)
subhead.default: Construction is expected to begin next spring, officials said.

ticker.description: ticker items scrolling along the bottom
default: Markets open higher after a quiet start
Heavy rain expected across the coast tonight
Regional rail service resumes after maintenance
Library extends opening hours for exam season

tickerTag.description: text of the accent tab at the left of the ticker

accent.description: slam panel / band / ticker tab colour

background.description: backdrop colour behind the headline; "transparent" = overlay on other footage

slamHold.description: extra frames the full-screen label holds before it contracts to the band

startAt.description: frame the flash fires (shift the whole beat)

live.description: show the pulsing LIVE pill in the band

x-opus.useFor: Urgent news beats, alert announcements, "just in" updates, product-incident or outage notices, news-style explainers and parody bulletins.

callout-labels.title: Callout labels — props
callout-labels.description: Staggered annotation callouts — dot, leader line and typed mono label — over a procedural subject; variants: room callout with crosshair and T-rules, translucent tags riding scrolling objects, and circular medallions popping on a blueprint plan.

variant.description: leader | room | tag | medallion | dimension (engineering dimension lines measuring a moving part) | magnifier (paper-ring magnifier disc showing a zoomed copy of the subject, dashed leader, star tag)

x-opus-optionLabels.dimension: engineering dimension lines measuring a moving part
x-opus-optionLabels.magnifier: paper-ring magnifier disc showing a zoomed copy of the subject, dashed leader, star tag

items.description: callouts {x, y, label, sublabel?, ex?, ey?, icon?}: x,y anchor as frame fractions (0..1); ex,ey label offset in px@1080 (leader) or plan-anchor offset (medallion); room titles split lines with "/"; [] = built-in demo

src.description: optional public/ image used as the subject instead of the procedural one
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

medallionReveal.description: pop (scale from a preview dot) or pie (clockwise wipe + tangent leaders)

ink.description: line / text colour for leader and room callouts

measure.description: dimension variant: [{p1:[x,y], p2:[x,y], p2To?:[x,y] (part moves over the clip), offset?: px@1080, label?: 'text with {v} = measured value'}], [] = built-in demo

measureScale.description: dimension variant: value units per px@1080 for {v} (0.25 = mm)

zoom.description: magnifier variant: zoom of the disc content (items[].zoom overrides); items {x,y target, label, sublabel, ex,ey disc offset px, r}

x-opus.useFor: Label the parts of a product, diagram, room or scene; attach facts to moving objects; link vignettes to a central diagram.

cam-chip-sync-badge.title: Cam chip + sync badge — props
cam-chip-sync-badge.description: Per-feed labelling for split screens: a chip top-left (square sync dot, CAM code, name, mono sub) wipes in, a badge top-right pops — ● LIVE SYNC, ○ SAME WINDOW (hatched grey) or RETIMED — with a running timecode; mid-way one feed re-syncs and flashes. Transparent background = overlay.

cams.description: [{code, name, sub, sync: live|window|retimed}] one per feed (up to 4 in the grid)

layout.description: 'grid' = up to 4 cells, 'single' = one big chip + badge for a full-frame shot

images.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

background.description: 'demo' = procedural/demo feeds under the chrome, 'transparent' = overlay only, or a colour

resyncAt.description: frame of the re-sync (dot + badge turn accent, border flash)

timecode.description: show a running timecode with a REC dot per feed

x-opus.useFor: Honest multi-source footage labelling over any split screen, multicam recap, surveillance / CCTV look or UGC wall.

click-ripple-markers.title: Click ripple markers — props
click-ripple-markers.description: Tutorial overlay on a transparent background: concentric rings ripple out of each click point, a dot stays behind and a chip names the click (click, double click, right click) with its timestamp; earlier clicks dim and an optional dotted trail links them.

clicks.description: array of {x, y (0-1 point), at? (frame), kind?: click|double|right, label?, time?}

timestamps.description: append the timestamp (m:ss.d from the video start) to each chip

keep.description: all = earlier clicks stay dimmed | last = only the latest | none = rings only

cursor.description: draw a small pointer arrow at each click

startAt.description: default frame of the first click

exitAt.description: frame everything fades at (0 = just before the end)

demoBackground.description: true paints a neutral mock screen behind (previews); false = transparent overlay

x-opus.useFor: Show exactly where and when something was clicked in a screen recording, UX test replay or bug report: pass `clicks` with x/y, the frame `at` and the `kind`.

day-ring-dial.title: Day ring dial — props
day-ring-dial.description: A small thin 24-hour ring in the corner with an orange hand and a 3-hour arc that runs with the day of a time-lapse city (sky, sun and lit windows follow it), freezes and dims on a slow passage, then spins backwards on a rewind.

hourKeys.description: [[frame, hour], ...] linearly interpolated; decreasing hours spin the hand backwards (rewind); hours may exceed 24

dimRanges.description: [[fromFrame, toFrame], ...] where the dial dims to ~40 % (slow passage / brake)

size.description: ring radius in u (62 ≈ 11 % H diameter)

subtitle.description: small tracked line under the title

background.description: 'plate' = procedural time-lapse city that follows the dial, 'transparent' = overlay, or any CSS colour

x-opus.useFor: A "day in the life" clock for time-lapse films, shift / operations timelines or any time-of-day structure; overlay it (background transparent) on footage.

era-dial.title: Era dial counter — props
era-dial.description: Gear-ringed blueprint dial that turns a notch per era while the date plate rolls and the centre line-art illustration swaps (plan, press, book, computer, monitor, network).

eras.description: list of {label, year, icon?}; icon one of plan|press|book|computer|monitor|network|scroll|build|inspect|ask|teach (defaults cycle)

stepAngle.description: degrees the dial turns per step

showLabels.description: show the era label above the window

x-opus.useFor: History / timeline beats: step through years or versions with a mechanical, technical feel.

event-feed.title: Event feed — props
event-feed.description: A kill-feed style stack of one-line event chips in a corner: each actor name sits in its coloured chip with the verb in white mono; new lines flash in at the top, older ones slide down and fade out after a few seconds.

background.description: backdrop colour; 'transparent' (default) overlays the host content

events.description: explicit events [{t: frame, a, verb, b}] (empty = a generated demo feed)

colors.description: chip colour per actor name

chipText.description: chip text colour per actor (default dark)

ttlFrames.description: frames a line lives before fading

demoScene.description: paint the painterly battlefield behind (preview only; turn off as an overlay)

x-opus.useFor: Live-event tickers (deploys, sales, alerts, game kills) over dashboards, gameplay or product demos; overlay-capable with background "transparent".

fact-check-meter.title: Fact-check meter — props
fact-check-meter.description: A fact-check graphic: the claim appears in a quote card, a segmented true-to-false gauge draws in, the needle sweeps and wobbles to the score while the matching zone label lights up, then a tilted verdict stamp and a one-line explanation land.

claimLabel.description: small label on the claim card (empty = none)

claim.default: Commute times in the city have been cut in half since 2020.

claimSource.description: who said it / where / when (empty = none)
claimSource.default: Said by a local official · 3 March

scaleLabels.description: labels of the gauge zones from true to false (2-7 entries = that many segments)

explanation.description: one-line reason shown under the verdict
explanation.default: Transport figures show average commutes fell by about 9 percent, not 50.

accent.description: tag chip and claim bar colour

sweepAt.description: frame the needle starts to sweep

x-opus.useFor: Rating a claim in news, explainers, debunk and myth-busting videos; any "how true is it" or 0-to-1 rating with a verdict.

fight-hud.title: Fight HUD — props
fight-hud.description: A two-player fighting-game HUD: slanted red and blue health bars with a crescent-moon (or countdown) emblem between them and italic caps names, draining with a delayed white damage-ghost; the default preview stages two original fighters trading a hit on a neon arcade floor.

background.description: backdrop when demoScene is off ('transparent' = overlay)

players.description: two players {name, color, color2, hpKeys: [[frame, hp 0..1], …]} — hp eases 6 f, ghost follows 8 f later

demoScene.description: stage the neon floor and two original fighters behind the HUD (preview; turn off as an overlay)

x-opus.useFor: Any head-to-head comparison staged as a game: benchmark battles, A/B tests, product duels; overlay-capable with background "transparent" and demoScene off.

game-hud.title: Game HUD (bars, score, combo, minimap) — props
game-hud.description: A video-game overlay: health, mana and xp bars that drain in eased steps with a lagging white damage ghost and a red screen pulse, a level badge, a score that counts up in pops, a combo counter that slams from 1.4x with shake, a sweeping radar minimap with blips, a kill feed that slides in and out and a LEVEL UP banner; three skins (arcade, modern, pixel).

bars.description: [{label, color, from, to, steps:[frames]}] each step moves the bar an equal share from `from` to `to` (drain = white ghost lags behind)

score.description: final score (counts up on every combo tick)

comboAt.description: frames of the combo ticks (the counter shows from the 2nd)

feedAt.description: frame the first feed line appears (26 frames between lines)

level.description: level shown on the badge before the level-up

background.description: backdrop colour ("transparent" to overlay on footage)

levelLabel.description: word before the level number in the level-up banner

x-opus.useFor: Game trailers, gamified product demos and esports-style highlights; `background: "transparent"` overlays it on footage. Rename the labels and feed text for your own story.

hand-drawn-arrow-callout.title: Hand-drawn arrow callout — props
hand-drawn-arrow-callout.description: Tutorial annotation overlay on a transparent background: a handwritten label pops, a sketchy double-pass pen arrow draws from it to a target point with a scribbled head and impact ticks. Several callouts run in sequence; positions are 0-1 fractions of the frame.

callouts.description: array of {x, y, label, sublabel?, lx?, ly?, curve?, color?, at?}: x/y = target (0-1), lx/ly = label centre (0-1), at = start frame

labelBg.description: sticker fill (or text colour for plain/underline)

boil.description: redraw the wobble on threes (hand-drawn boil)

exitAt.description: frame everything fades at (0 = just before the end)

demoBackground.description: true paints a neutral mock screen behind (previews); false = transparent overlay

x-opus.useFor: Point at a button, field or number in any screen recording or tutorial ("click here", "watch this"): pass `callouts` with the target x/y and your own label text.
x-opus.avoid: Replace the sample labels (Click here / Watch this bar / Then save).

hud-chrome.title: HUD chrome overlay — props
hud-chrome.description: Overlay HUD: corner crop marks, header with red counter, live timecode, typed code line with red block cursor, BPM beat squares, chapter progress bar and a right-side ruler with "0N / 07" counter.

backdrop.description: background colour; "transparent" to use as an overlay

previewSubject.description: draw a bouncing red ball on the backdrop (preview only)

theme.description: dark = light text (for dark scenes), light = ink text

counterLabel.description: grey label before the red counter

chapters.description: list of {label, code}; chapters split the duration evenly; code is typed in the footer

default.label: Squash & stretch
default.code: sx = 1 / sy;  // area π·r² is conserved

bpm.description: beat indicator tempo

rulerAccent.description: orange indicator on the right ruler

showProgress.description: bottom hairline progress bar with chapter ticks

rulerUnit.description: word after the ruler counter, e.g. "ROOMS"

variant.description: chrome (default) | reel (crop marks, "NN — LABEL alt", timecode with beat dot, footer, segmented progress; chapters may carry labelAlt) | camcorder (bitmap OSD: REC, battery, clock, date, title) | survey (quiet top-left mono block) | subtitle (diagonal brackets + voice bars plate) | dev (only the counter / phase badge slots)

x-opus-optionLabels.reel: crop marks, "NN — LABEL alt", timecode with beat dot, footer, segmented progress; chapters may carry labelAlt
x-opus-optionLabels.camcorder: bitmap OSD: REC, battery, clock, date, title
x-opus-optionLabels.subtitle: diagonal brackets + voice bars plate
x-opus-optionLabels.dev: only the counter / phase badge slots

rec.description: camcorder: blinking REC dot at 1 Hz

clock.description: camcorder: start time "HH:MM" (24 h) shown as "PM 11:58"

titleText.description: camcorder: title-generator caption over the first shot ("" = none)

jumps.description: camcorder: [{at, toTime}] - the clock jumps to toTime at that frame (time-jump evidence)

subtitle2.default: Signal acquired. Stand by for descent.

hudCounter.description: dev slot (any variant): {value,total,unit,pad,sub} top-left zero-padded counter "0817 / 1200 VOXELS"; null = off

phases.description: dev slot: [{from, label, color?}] top-right phase badge that swaps instantly (READY = black, others accent)

frameCounter.description: dev slot: "029 / 720" frame counter under the badge

progressSegments.description: reel: number of progress segments (0 = one per chapter)

x-opus.useFor: Technical / "made with code" framing over any scene; chaptered explainers. Set backdrop to "transparent" to overlay.

interview-name-super.title: Interview name super — props
interview-name-super.description: A two-line interview super - name and title - in four layouts: "bar" (accent bar + dark panel), "tag" (solid name block over an offset title strip), "rule" (a thin accent line draws over bare type on a soft scrim) and "center" (centred serif name with a diamond divider). Left, right or centre; set backdrop to "transparent" to lay it over footage.

kicker.description: small label above or beside the name, e.g. "Interview", "Witness" (empty = none)

accent.description: bar / name block / rule / divider colour

scrim.description: soft bottom gradient behind "rule" and "center" layouts so bare type stays legible

backdrop.description: "footage" = procedural plate, "transparent" = overlay, or any CSS colour

x-opus.useFor: Naming and titling anyone on screen: interviewees, speakers, experts, hosts, witnesses - in news, documentary, podcast, webinar and corporate video.

location-time-stamp.title: Location + time chyron — props
location-time-stamp.description: A lower-left location chyron: an accent bar grows, the place strip opens and the place name types on with a block cursor, then a dark strip types region | date | time with an optional running clock and a LIVE / FILE tag chip above. Set backdrop to "transparent" to lay it over footage.

region.description: city / region / country shown first on the dark strip (empty = skip)

timezone.description: short zone label after the time (e.g. "GMT", "local"; empty = none)

tag.description: chip above the strip, e.g. "Live", "File footage", "Recorded" (empty = none)

ticking.description: run the clock forward in real time (shows seconds)

typeSpeed.description: characters per second for the place name

accent.description: bar, cursor, tag and time colour

backdrop.description: "footage" = procedural plate, "transparent" = overlay, or any CSS colour

x-opus.useFor: Establishing where and when a shot was filmed: news reports, documentaries, travel and true-crime videos, field recordings, dated archive clips.

magnification-roundel.title: Magnification roundel — props
magnification-roundel.description: Over an engraved figure, a double-ruled ring is scribed around a detail, the inside re-draws magnified on a ruled-line ground, then the roundel flies on an eased arc to a margin slot trailing a hairline leader back to a dot on the part; FIG numbers, italic terms and script notes are cut on landing.

default.label: The stem
default.note: Woody, set in a shallow basin.

default.label: The blush
default.note: Where the sun has touched it.

anchors.description: per roundel [x, y] on the figure, as fractions of its bounding box

startAt.description: second the first ring is scribed

flight.description: seconds of the arc flight to the margin

x-opus.useFor: Detail insets for any explainer: product feature zooms, anatomy, map insets, museum plates; style-agnostic loupe callouts.

mission-clock.title: Mission clock — props
mission-clock.description: A T−00:04.0 countdown in fixed condensed slots: accent T−, grey tenths, a ten-segment bar draining every second, new seconds dropping in; at zero it flips to an accent block with dark T+ and an "elapsed" header and a warm flash, while a control strip of named segments fills on each hand-over.

startSeconds.description: clock value at frame 0 in seconds (negative = T−, zero is where it inverts)

rate.description: clock seconds per real second (1 = real time)

segments.description: control strip [{label, at: frame}] — the active segment fills on its hand-over with a warm flash

caption.description: mono line under the clock (empty = none)
caption.default: NORTHWIND-1 · PAD 2 · SAME CLOCK FOR EVERY FEED

x-opus.useFor: Launches, deadlines, sales ending, live events, sports and "go time" beats; a reusable countdown HUD (background transparent to overlay).

news-bug-source-tag.title: News bug + source tag — props
news-bug-source-tag.description: Attribution overlay: a top-left channel bug (accent square, channel, topic), a "SOURCE · publisher · date" chip that slides in under it while a figure is on screen, and a small "Video: author · licence" credit chip top-right. Set backdrop to "transparent" to layer it over any motion.

source.description: publisher · date shown in the SOURCE chip

sourceAt.description: frame the source chip slides in (0.2 s)

backdrop.description: "footage" = procedural preview plate, "transparent" = overlay, or any CSS colour

x-opus.useFor: Attribution agents can always attach — data sources, CC BY credits, channel branding — over news, explainer and documentary shots.

numbered-step-badges.title: Numbered step badges — props
numbered-step-badges.description: Tutorial overlay on a transparent background: numbered badges (1, 2, 3 ...) pop onto points of the footage one after another with a pulse ring and a caption chip, linked by a dotted path that draws on between them. Circle, map-pin or rounded-square badges.

steps.description: array of {x, y (0-1 point), label?, n? (badge text), side?: auto|left|right|top|bottom, at?}

connect.description: draw a dotted path between consecutive badges

fontFamily.description: CSS font-family for numbers and captions

exitAt.description: frame everything fades at (0 = just before the end)

demoBackground.description: true paints a neutral mock screen behind (previews); false = transparent overlay

x-opus.useFor: Number the steps of a how-to on top of a screen recording or screenshot ("1 pick a file, 2 choose a format, 3 export"): pass `steps` with x/y points and your own captions.
x-opus.avoid: Replace the sample captions (Search for a file / Pick a chart ...).

poll-numbers-split.title: Poll numbers split — props
poll-numbers-split.description: Head-to-head poll result: two colour panels count their percentages up, a proportional bar below shows the split with an undecided remainder, a hatched band marks the margin of error, and a verdict chip reads "X leads by N" - or "within the margin of error" when the gap is inside it.

question.default: Which option do residents prefer for the new park?

pollster.description: who ran the poll, shown next to the POLL tag

subA.description: small line under name A (party, site, version; empty = none)

valueB.description: percentage for B (A + B <= 100; the rest shows as undecided)

marginOfError.description: margin of error in percentage points (0 = hide the band)

note.description: method footnote (sample size, dates; empty = none)
note.default: Sample of 1,200 adults · margin of error ±3 points · fieldwork 3-9 March

leadLabel.description: verdict when one side leads; {name} and {n} are filled in

tieLabel.description: verdict when the gap is within twice the margin of error (each share is +/- the margin)
tieLabel.default: Too close to call · within the margin of error

startAt.description: frame the graphic starts (shift the beat)

x-opus.useFor: Election and survey coverage, A/B test results, "which do you prefer" splits, two-option vote outcomes - anything with two shares and an honest margin of error.

powers-of-ten.title: Powers-of-ten zoom — props
powers-of-ten.description: Continuous exponential pull-back (or push-in) through nested blueprint drawings — word, badge, radar, library plan, dial, network — with level-of-detail fading and a scale readout; snap mode jumps level to level.

levels.description: innermost first: {label, kind?}; kind word|badge|radar|plan|dial|network (defaults cycle in that order; level 1 shows its label as a big word)

direction.description: out = pull back from the first level, in = dive from the last

mode.description: continuous log-scale move, or snap (hold, then easeOutExpo snap per level)

easing.description: continuous mode move curve: sine | linear (constant log-zoom, orbit-dive) | inOut | expo

camRoll.description: degrees the whole camera rolls while zooming (e.g. 90 for an orbit dive, 0 = none)

holdStart.description: fraction of the clip (0..0.4) the first level holds before the move starts

scaleLabel.description: small caps label before the scale readout (hud: true)

x-opus.useFor: Show how a small thing sits inside ever bigger systems (or dive the other way), in one continuous move.

prompt-wall.title: Prompt wall — props
prompt-wall.description: A saturated Klein-blue terminal backdrop filled with faint wireframe boxes of prompt-template fragments in three depth tiers that type in, live a few seconds and fade, with corner brackets, scanlines and an optional scramble-decoded blackletter title.

background.description: screen colour ('transparent' for an overlay over another motion)

snippets.description: text fragments; 'HEADER|body' puts a small header line on top (empty = built-in neutral prompt templates)

title.description: optional centred title, shown as [ TITLE ] in pixel blackletter, scramble-decoded in

x-opus.useFor: "The AI is thinking / system prompt" backdrops behind titles, techy section backgrounds on websites, agent and simulation promos.

radial-blueprint.title: Radial blueprint plan — props
radial-blueprint.description: Dark blueprint: a blue dot pings, the camera snaps back to a seeded circular library plan with a glowing hub, blue paths and flowing nodes, then spokes shoot out to category labels.

categories.description: labels the blue spokes shoot out to (first fires alone, then in pairs)

centerLabel.description: small tracked label under the hub ("" to hide)

accentPaths.description: thick blue paths entering from outside

networkSpokes.description: thin blue spokes with flowing nodes

x-opus.useFor: Hero background for systems / knowledge / network stories; reveal 3-8 categories around a hub.

scribble-circle-highlight.title: Scribble circle highlight — props
scribble-circle-highlight.description: Tutorial annotation overlay on a transparent background: a marker pen draws a looping circle, a scribbled underline, a sketchy box or a translucent highlighter swath around chosen regions of the footage, each with an optional handwritten label.

social-post-embed.title: Social post embed — props
social-post-embed.description: A generic social-post card - avatar (initials or image), name, verified tick, handle, text with *highlighted* words, optional picture, time and reply / repost / like counts. It pops in, reveals its words one by one, counts the numbers up and "likes" itself with a heart pop. No real platform branding.

verified.description: show the round tick next to the name

accent.description: highlight words, tick and glow colour

x-opus.useFor: Showing what someone posted in a news piece, explainer or reaction video: a quote, a viral claim, a customer comment, a screenshot-style callout.

spec-chip-rail.title: Spec chip rail — props
spec-chip-rail.description: Hologram spec sheet: each value rolls from garbage glyphs into the real number on a big card (locks right-to-left, turns amber with a 1-frame flash), then the card shrinks into a compact chip that slides into a side rail and stays; chips accumulate, then a weight/price block and CTA box lock up. A cyan drone wireframe turns on a projector pad behind.

showModel.description: show the hologram drone wireframe behind

background.description: stage colour, or "transparent" for an overlay

x-opus.useFor: Spec sheets, feature checklists, pricing summaries — keeps every fact on screen long enough to read.

spotlight-dim-focus.title: Spotlight dim focus — props
spotlight-dim-focus.description: Tutorial overlay: the frame dims except a soft-edged cut-out (rounded rectangle, ellipse or circle) that closes in on a region, glides to the next one with a caption chip on each, then opens back up. Everything outside the cut-out is just a dark veil, so it sits on any footage.

sync-grid.title: Sync grid (evidence on one clock) — props
sync-grid.description: Three evidence columns (report log / dashcam / CCTV) side by side under one huge monospaced stopwatch; each column cuts in with a flash only when its source starts on the event clock, so the grid fills as time runs. At the sync point everything freezes, the key column gets a red border and a word, a red dashed line runs across the pictures and the stopwatch becomes a big red verdict.

default.text:
unit 4 dispatched
caller confirms location
alarm silenced remotely
second call received
unit 4 on scene

syncAt.description: event second at which everything freezes

syncColumn.description: index of the column that gets the red border and word

verdict.description: big red text that replaces the stopwatch

startClock.description: wall clock at event second 0 (format hh:mm:ss)

camLabel.description: on-screen label inside the dashcam-style panel

x-opus.useFor: Dashcam + CCTV + log comparisons, "which happened first", sports replays, launch/telemetry reconstructions, A/B latency demos (three apps responding to one tap), product race comparisons.

target-lock-box.title: Target lock box — props
target-lock-box.description: Sci-fi target lock: an oversized faint square rotated 45° snaps onto a part in .22 s, flashes white for 3 frames, drops an anchor ring and a "TGT 01 · LOCK" mono tag; the camera whips to the next target. Default subject is a cyan hologram drone wireframe on a projector pad; works over images or as a transparent overlay.

whip.description: 0..0.6 how far the camera whips toward each target

target-lock.title: Target lock — props
target-lock.description: Candidate boxes with ids and rising MATCH % appear over a scene half a second apart; four L-brackets fly in from the frame corners, close in and snap onto the target (1.4 to 1.0 scale), a lock ratchet ring fills, then a "TARGET LOCKED" banner opens from the centre with coordinates typing below. Works over a built-in crate scene, your image, or transparent as an overlay.

tooltip-pointer.title: Tooltip pointer — props
tooltip-pointer.description: Tutorial overlay on a transparent background: a tooltip bubble with a title and wrapped text and a pointer touching a target point pops out of the pointer tip, with a pulsing beacon on the target. ascii-image-grid.title: ASCII image grid (phosphor CRT) — props

autofocus-hunt.title: Autofocus hunt — props
autofocus-hunt.description: Camcorder autofocus hunting on a liminal office corridor (or any image): blur → snaps sharp → slips → locks, then a zoom from 52° to 27° and a second hunt; a far figure is visible only inside the first sharp window. REC / AF / zoom OSD and focus brackets.

brush-stroke-reveal.title: Brush-stroke reveal — props

crayon-pressure-pass.title: Crayon pressure pass — props

knife-colour-relay.title: Knife colour relay — props
knife-colour-relay.description: A cool-grey, wet-looking palette-knife painting is re-laid in colour stroke by stroke by a wave spreading from a point: each stroke sweeps from grey to colour along its own length. Strokes in exceptionMask (default: the red umbrella) stay in colour from the start, the one-colour exception. Set revealSpeed 0 for exception-only, exceptionMask [] for a pure wave.

Default plate is a procedural river landscape; with src the picture is knife-filtered with ridge texture.

wash-arrival.title: Wash arrival — props
wash-arrival.description: A hillside village by a lake sits as a pure ink sketch on cream paper; colour then floods outward from a little walker along the path and from the sunrise like watercolour on wet paper — an irregular cauliflower front with a darker pooled tide line just behind it, granulation, a brief wet sheen and a wash slightly off-register from the line. Whatever the sources touch becomes painted; the rest stays line until colour arrives (everything is flooded by floodAt). Give lineSrc / colorSrc to reveal your own picture.

lineSrc.description: optional line-art image in public/ (dark lines on white) — used as the ink layer

colorSrc.description: optional colour image in public/ — the paint layer (an ink layer is derived from its edges when lineSrc is empty)

sources.description: colour sources in a 1000×620 design space: {x,y,t (s), v (units/s), R (reach), sy (vertical stretch), path:[[x,y]…] + t1 for a moving source}

amp.description: front irregularity (noise offset in design units)

creep.description: seconds per unit beyond the reach radius

floodAt.description: seconds by which any unpainted area is flooded

walker.description: draw the little walker that rides the path source

x-opus.useFor: "Colour follows the product / runner / sunrise" storytelling, sketch → finished-render reveals for architecture and real estate, onboarding illustrations that come alive.

woodblock-print-reveal.title: Woodblock print reveal — props
woodblock-print-reveal.description: On a blank washi sheet an original ukiyo-e harbour print is "printed": the black key-line block lands first, then each colour block (blues, sea bands, green, ochre, vermilion) is revealed by a ragged diagonal baren-sweep in 12 quantised steps, sliding a few pixels into slightly imperfect register, with woodgrain, baren unevenness and goma-zuri specks in every block; a double border draws, the title cartouche drops in and a chipped red seal stamps. Nature moves on eights. With src the photo is posterised into luminance blocks and printed the same way.

src.description: optional image in public/ — posterised into 5 luminance blocks and printed instead of the built-in harbour
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

start.description: seconds before the first block prints

speed.description: print pace multiplier (1 = ~0.35 s per block)

misregister.description: block registration offset multiplier (0 = perfect register)

push.description: slow camera push over the clip (0.04 = 4 %)

x-opus.useFor: "Printing" a logo, illustration, map or product shot into existence; heritage / craft / Japanese-themed openers; any multi-layer reveal (riso, screen-print).

woodcut-carve.title: Woodcut carve (form-following knife cuts) — props
woodcut-carve.description: A picture turns into a white-line woodcut: thousands of separate knife cuts that wrap around forms (along the isophotes), wide where the image is bright and absent where it is dark, carved in live from highlights to shadows, then printed on paper with a ragged block edge, ink speckle and an optional copper colour plate glowing out of the brightest cuts. Default is a procedural moonlit-hills picture; pass `src` for any image.

src.description: image path (public/ or URL); empty = built-in moonlit-hills picture
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

sp.description: spacing between cuts in px at 1080 (5 = fine, 10 = bold)

black.description: tone below which nothing is cut (0-1)

white.description: tone at which cuts reach full width (0-1)

a0.description: fallback cut angle in radians where the picture has no direction

paper.description: paper colour (also the colour of the cuts)

plateColor.description: colour plate printed in the brightest cuts ("" = none)

plateAbove.description: tone above which cuts take the colour plate (0-1)

plateFrames.description: [from, to] frames the colour plate fades in

margin.description: paper margin as a fraction of the short side

maxCuts.description: cap on the number of cuts (performance)

x-opus.useFor: A very crafted treatment for book trailers, folk / heritage brands, history explainers and editorial portraits: give it any still and it carves it live. Pairs with ken-burns for a push.

xray-scan.title: X-ray scan reveal — props
xray-scan.description: A glowing vertical scan beam (or an inky organic blob / hatched hole) sweeps across an image, revealing a glowing x-ray / blueprint line-art version in its wake.

src.description: public/ image path (edge-detected into an x-ray); empty = procedural plate drawn as line art
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

palette.description: procedural plate palette: dusk | night | dawn

mode.description: beam | blob | hole | cutaway (half-section drawing of an object: hatched cut walls around a glowing core)

x-opus-optionLabels.cutaway: half-section drawing of an object: hatched cut walls around a glowing core

look.description: blueprint (lavender on navy) | xray (cyan on deep blue)

speed.description: beam speed in frame-widths per second (0.75 measured)

passes.description: beam passes: 1 = reveal only, 2 = reveal then sweep back to colour

glowWidth.description: beam glow half-width in px at 1080p (40–60)

reticle.description: draw construction circles / reticle over the x-ray

push.description: slow push-in in %/s

words.description: beam mode karaoke cursor: [{text, at}] words laid across the frame; the beam's leading edge advances on each word's `at` frame, revealing the word cut into the x-ray layer

orbitDeg.description: cutaway: slow camera drift in degrees over the shot

cutAngle.description: cutaway: cut extent in degrees (180 = half section)

x-opus.useFor: Showing what is inside / how it works, scanning or analysing beats, tech and science explainers.

choropleth-fill.title: Choropleth fill (tile map + legend) — props
choropleth-fill.description: An abstract hex/square tile territory fills region by region with a colour ramp driven by values, with labels, count-ups, a gradient legend and a highest-region callout. Regions are generic tiles, not real borders.

values.description: one number per region (also sets how many tiles there are)

labels.description: one short label per region (same order as values)

colors.description: colour ramp low -> high (2+ hex colours)

order.description: fill order: "wave" (left to right), "value" (low to high), "index"

showValues.description: print the value on every tile

highlight.description: outline + legend marker for the highest region at the end

x-opus.useFor: Regional comparisons (sales by state, scores by team, adoption by country) when you just need the pattern, not exact geography. Name tiles with `labels`; for real borders use painted-choropleth or a map image.

city-zoom-label.title: City zoom + label card — props
city-zoom-label.description: A world map zooms (expo ease, graticule re-scaling) down to a lat/lon, a pin pings, and a label card with name, subtitle and coordinates slides in.

tag.description: small caps line above the name

zoom.description: final zoom in px per degree at 1080 scale (world view is ~5; 110 = a region; the baked coastline is simplified, so above ~250 it looks faceted)

showCoords.description: print the lat/lon on the card

landStroke.description: coastline, grid and card border colour

monoFamily.description: CSS font-family for the coordinates line

x-opus.useFor: "We are here" / location reveals, store or event locators, travel and news establishing shots, any beat that goes from the world to one place. Set `lat`, `lon`, `label`.

coverage-route.title: Coverage route (floor plan) — props
coverage-route.description: Top-down mid-century floor plan: a robot route draws itself region by region — a wall-follow loop, then back-and-forth lanes that flow around furniture without crossing, curls at every U-turn, stars and dots popping between lanes, a dotted return to the dock — while the camera pulls back and counter-rotates to reveal a patterned whole.

zones.description: regions drawn one per beat [{x0, x1 (0..1 of room width), color, label}]

items.description: furniture obstacles [{shape: round|sofa|plant|rect, x, y (0..1), rx, ry (fraction of room), color}]

dock.description: dock position [x, y] 0..1 of the room

curl.description: curl radius at U-turns in u (0 = none)

returnFrames.description: frames for the dotted return home

routeEdge.description: darker off-register edge under the route

decor.description: stars and dots revealed between lanes

caption.description: caption card after the return ("" to hide)

x-opus.useFor: Robot vacuums / mowers, delivery rounds, sprinkler or cleaning coverage, "how the algorithm covers the space" payoffs.

elevation-profile.title: Elevation profile — props
elevation-profile.description: A route elevation line draws left to right, coloured by steepness, with a moving marker and live distance / total gain / grade readouts and a peak flag.

data.description: elevation samples along the route (any unit, evenly spaced, 2+ numbers)

distance.description: total route length, shown on the x axis and distance readout
