accent.description: steep climbs, area glow, gain readout

x-opus.useFor: Hike, ride, run and race route explainers, stage profiles, any height-versus-distance story. Pass `data` (heights, evenly spaced along the route) and `distance`.

flight-arcs.title: Flight arcs (great-circle routes) — props
flight-arcs.description: Great-circle arcs fly between lat/lon cities on a flat map: planes (or dots) travel with a glowing trail, cities ping on arrival, a distance counter adds up.

routes.description: array of {from:{lat,lon,label?}, to:{lat,lon,label?}}; the camera fits them all

subtitle.default: Hub to hub, around the map

lift.description: arc height as a fraction of the route length on screen (0 = flat)

trail.description: glowing trail length as a fraction of the route

x-opus.useFor: Global reach, shipping and travel routes, network/hub-and-spoke stories, "from here to there" beats; swap `routes` for any lat/lon pairs.

hairline-feature-trace.title: Hairline feature trace — props
hairline-feature-trace.description: On a dark raking-lit survey surface, 1-px amber hairlines light up along traced features in order (compound walls, a sinuous road, a pipe run, a boundary loop). Each line has a bright head glow at the drawing front and a faint halo behind, stays crisp at any distance, and is draped on the terrain while the camera drifts.

speed.description: draw speed in plan units per frame (200-unit plot)

caption.description: small caption at the bottom-left of the frame

surface.description: low-ground colour of the lit surface

x-opus.useFor: Route, network and boundary reveals on terrains and maps; complements map-route and topdown-terrain.

iso-diorama-board.title: Iso diorama board — props
iso-diorama-board.description: A floating flat-isometric diorama board (cream top, soil strata and a blue water corner on its front edges) builds up: stations drop in with a squash — farm, plant, port, city — trees pop, then a dashed ink route draws far-to-near with a red subject cube riding it; label pins with values pop at each stop and a legend card locks the total. Flat three-tone shading, no outlines.

title.description: board title (top-left and on the legend)

stations.description: route stops in order: {pos [x,y] 0..1 on the board, label, value, unit, kind farm|plant|port|city|shop}

bpm.description: pace of the route (one leg ≈ 2.2 beats)

palette.description: ground, boardTop, sea and subject (accent) colours

zoomOut.description: pull back to the legend card at the end

footnote.description: small caps footnote under the total ("" hides)

map-mask-reveal.title: Map mask reveal — props
map-mask-reveal.description: A choropleth map fills in west to east; one region is outlined in the accent with a leader label, the camera pushes into it, then a photo of the place grows out of the region's own outline until it fills the frame.

regionIndex.description: index of the highlighted region (-1 = an inland default)

label.description: region name (leader label and final caption)

src.description: public/ photo of the place (empty = procedural plate)
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

maskAt.description: frame the photo starts growing out of the outline

painted-choropleth.title: Painted choropleth map — props
painted-choropleth.description: A painted island map: the coastline is brushed in, then regions fill with quantised watercolour bands (wobbly wash edges, three-pass look) driven by station data; the field can morph through time (e.g. 50 Ma to today) with a radial fill reveal, a huge serif year label and a band legend.

bands.description: ascending thresholds; band k starts at bands[k]

colors.description: band colours (same length as bands)

yearFrom.description: label number at the first time key

yearTo.description: label number at the last time key

finalLabel.description: label shown once the morph ends ("" = keep number)

pin-drop-cluster.title: Pin drop + clustering map — props
pin-drop-cluster.description: Map pins drop onto a map region, merge into numbered cluster bubbles, split into single pins as the camera zooms in, then merge again.

zoom.description: camera zoom-in factor for the split beat

onAccent.description: text/dot colour drawn on accent shapes

time-rings.title: Time rings (dated scan passes) — props
time-rings.description: A locked top-down view where soft scan passes sweep down the frame, each swapping in an older or newer dated plate and leaving that date's outline as a thin white ring with a year label; the lost band flashes, a light runs the newest outline, the rest dims, and an amber reading rolls in and lands.

beat-dance.title: Beat dance (Nib + crew) — props
beat-dance.description: Nib dances on the music under a pulsing spotlight — bounce, hop, raise-the-roof, sway, a drawn spin through its key views on beat 4, wave, walk, run, stomp, shimmy or a mix that changes every two bars — with an optional back-up crew offset so nobody twins.

chomp-lid.title: Chomp on the beat (Nib muncher) — props
chomp-lid.description: Nib opens its mouth into a huge toothy D (teeth always sized to the gap) and snaps it shut on the beat, munching labelled blocks that arc in from the side one per bite, with a squash on each chomp and a spray of crumbs.

items.description: labels on the blocks it eats (cycles)

emotion.description: eyes/brows/body mood while chomping (determined, furious, excited, mischief…)

emotion-idle-beat.title: Emotion idles on the beat (Nib line-up) — props
emotion-idle-beat.description: A line-up of Nib mascots, each in a different mood, each moving with its own body language (bounce, sob per beat, cool nod, furious tremble, slow sleepy breath) locked to one tempo, over beat-pulsing floor spots and a four-dot metronome.

emotion-sheet.title: Mascot emotion sheet (Nib) — props
emotion-sheet.description: A model sheet of the ink-drop mascot Nib: all 31 named emotions in a labelled grid, every one alive on the beat (idle body language, blinks, emotes); also a views, dances or hats sheet.

emotion-timeline.title: Acted emotion timeline (Nib) — props
emotion-timeline.description: Nib acts a chain of moods without ever snapping: eyes squint shut before each key, the face swaps under them, a squash-and-stretch take sized to the new mood fires, the pose overshoots into its new idle, colour and blush cross-fade and the new emote pops; an optional key strip shows the keys and playhead.

mascot-nib.title: Mascot Nib (31 emotions) — props
mascot-nib.description: Nib, the library’s hand-inked ink-drop mascot with a springy curl, round eyes, brows and noodle arms, drops in and stays alive in any of 31 named emotions (face, colour shift, emote mark and its own beat-locked body language); can follow an action script (walk, run, hop, jump, feel, turn, dance, take, wave, look, emote).

mascot-thinking.title: Mascot Pip thinking to idea — props
mascot-thinking.description: Pip ponders with a hand by its head while a thought bubble of pulsing dots grows, then the dots flip to a glowing light bulb, the antenna lights and Pip hops.

mascot-thumbs-up.title: Mascot Pip thumbs up + confetti — props
mascot-thumbs-up.description: Pip crouches, jumps and lands with a thumbs-up while confetti cannons fire and a "nice work" bubble pops.

mascot-wave-hello.title: Mascot Pip waves hello — props
mascot-wave-hello.description: An original capsule-robot mascot (Pip) pops in, waves, blinks and says a typed line in a speech bubble.

pixel-mascot-on-ui.title: Pixel mascot on UI — props
pixel-mascot-on-ui.description: A chunky pixel-art mascot lives inside a crisp redrawn task-app window: it hops onto the top edges of the heading, input box, list rows and button with wind-up squash, parabolic arc, air stretch and damped landing squash plus dust, walks with a 9 Hz leg swap, blinks, breathes on the beat, and every action changes the real UI (typing with a pencil, checkboxes tick with sparkles, the button presses and hearts float). smear-trail.title: Smear trail dash (Nib) — props
smear-trail.description: Nib dashes in so fast the drawing smears: the body stretches wide, dry-brush streaks of its own colour and thin ink speed lines trail behind, the eyes collapse to dashes; it skids to a stop in a dust puff, does a take, then zips off the other side.

mix.title: Mix (layer motions together) — props
mix.description: Stacks any motions in one frame: backdrop + subject + text + accent, each with its own timing, opacity and blend mode. Per-layer extras: knock-out halo, beat breathe (squash/stretch on the beat) and stop-motion stepping / boil.

audio-spectrum.title: Audio spectrum (bars / circle / wave / scope) — props
audio-spectrum.description: Audio-reactive visualiser: rounded gradient bars with peak-hold caps, a circular spectrum around a pulsing disc, a layered mirrored wave, or a green-phosphor oscilloscope, driven by the real soundtrack (64-128 log-spaced bins, release smoothing, peak hold) or by a synthetic beat when no file is given. beat-camera.title: Beat camera (snap reframes) — props
beat-camera.description: The camera never floats: on every beat (or downbeat) it snaps to a new framing — punch-in, roll, whip, orbit, push — each move caught by a damped spring, with a +4 % punch on the kicks and a hair of shake that dies before the next cut; demoed over an engraved plinth table and a heavy title, and usable as a wrapper around any motion in a mix.

beat-grid.title: Beat grid (music clock HUD) — props
beat-grid.description: A deadpan music clock: a huge BPM readout, four bar squares that flash on each beat, a beat/bar phase dial, and a scrolling ruler of beats and eighths with section blocks and kick/snare/hat lanes lighting as they cross the playhead — the beat grid every music motion in the library syncs to.

beat-pulse-rings.description: Concentric rings pulse out of a centre disc on every beat of a bpm grid: circles, polygons or squares in two colours, bigger echoing rings on every downbeat, the disc kicking with each hit and optionally printing the tempo. Rings are already in flight at frame 0, so a whole number of bars loops seamlessly.

engraving-hatch.title: Engraving hatch (white-line plate) — props
engraving-hatch.description: A white-line scratchboard engraving cuts itself on near-black: contour lines follow the form of a slowly turning sphere (or a ridge terrain), each line swelling where the light hits and thinning to a hair in shadow, a ground plate with a cast shadow, a hot orange rim light (or spark path) as the only glowing thing, deadpan figure labels.

equalizer-bars-loop.title: Equalizer bars (seamless loop) — props
equalizer-bars-loop.description: A seamlessly looping equalizer: rounded bars, LED segments, dot stacks or a mirrored centre-line spectrum, bar count, colours, bass profile and glow all adjustable. Heights are beat-locked sine harmonics with whole cycles per loop, so the last frame flows into the first. Text-free, transparent-capable.

guilloche-note.description: A banknote engraves itself on bone paper: lathe-work waves and a woven border band draw on, interlaced guilloché rosettes (r = R + a·sin(nθ + φ)) slowly turn, a portrait oval fills with line-relief engraving (horizontal lines lifted and thickened by the picture), serial numbers type in hazard orange and a seal stamps on.

grid-beat-construct.title: Grid beat construct — props
grid-beat-construct.description: A cream sheet rules its module grid from the centre outward; Bauhaus primitives (disc, bar, triangle, square, semicircle, quarter-disc) land, slide, flip, scale and rotate in one per beat, each preceded by a crosshair target; the finished composition then turns upright in a clock-escapement of 7.5 degree ticks and locks into a poster with title, subtitle and folio.

sprout-grow.title: Sprout grow row — props
sprout-grow.description: Pencil-sketch planters on a park lawn: stems rise one after another, leaf pairs pop and flower heads (sunflower, blossom, tulip) scale in with overshoot, then sway with twinkling sparkles inside a torn-paper frame.

swimmers-converge.title: Swimmers converge + shockwave + fusion — props
swimmers-converge.description: Small glowing agents with wavy sine tails swim in along dotted S-curves and stop around a glowing cell; one gets through with a flash and an expo shockwave ring, the rest fade, then two aster dots drift together and fuse in a starburst.

toon-cel-shape.title: Toon cel shapes (mid-century print) — props

agenda-list-slide.title: Agenda list slide — props

alphabet-letter-trace.title: Alphabet letter trace — props
alphabet-letter-trace.description: A handwriting lesson on ruled paper: a dotted letter track, numbered stroke-order dots with arrows, a pen dot tracing each stroke, a pop and sparkle, then a drawn picture and "A is for Apple" example word slide in.

anniversary-years-badge.title: Anniversary years badge (ribbons & laurel) — props
anniversary-years-badge.description: A gold milestone seal pops in over a slow sunburst, ribbons drop behind it, laurel branches draw around it, the year count climbs to N and lands with a shine and sparkle burst, then a headline and thank-you line write on.

atomic-orbit-title.title: Atomic orbit title (retro toon) — props
atomic-orbit-title.description: A 1950s atomic-age TV title in fat cream block caps with a thick ink outline and a hard magenta offset shadow, wrapped by a tilted cyan orbit that threads behind the top of the letters and in front of the bottom, a small object flying round it and twinkling four-point stars; pops in on twos.

big-stat-slide.title: Big stat slide — props
big-stat-slide.description: Keynote one-number slide: an eyebrow tag, a huge number counting up with accent prefix/suffix, an accent rule drawing under it, a one-line label and a source footnote.

birthday-cake-candles.title: Birthday cake, candles & blow-out — props
birthday-cake-candles.description: A tiered cake drops in, candles are lit one by one with a warm glow and a wish line, then a puff of breath blows them out (leaning flames, smoke wisps) and confetti bursts as the name is revealed.

blob-to-wordmark.title: Blob to wordmark — props

diagonal-assemble-title.title: Diagonal assemble title (shatter into title) — props
diagonal-assemble-title.description: The previous scene slices into 23 strips along a 30-degree cut that slide off alternately; the title letters then fly in along the same diagonal from alternating sides, spinning and landing one per sixteenth note, the title sitting split along the cut until the halves close with a click.

title.description: title lines (one or two short lines)

strips.description: number of strips the outgoing scene is cut into

splitGap.description: gap between the two title halves in u

closeAt.description: frame the halves close with a click

scene.description: show the outgoing scene (false = start straight on the title)

diagonal-band-title.title: Diagonal band title — props
diagonal-band-title.description: Constructivist title package on warm paper: an archive-footage window slams down, a red girder band slams in along a −18° axis with a decaying shake, a huge Oswald number stamps digit by digit (one per eighth note) with its unit in red, and a caps line rides on the band; everything printed in one ink, one red.

unit.description: unit word in red beside it

tag.description: Space Mono source tag on the footage window

src.description: optional photo/still in public/ for the footage window (print-graded to ink/paper)
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

footage.description: procedural archive scene when no src: 'tower' | 'girder' | 'crowd' | 'street' | 'works'

bpm.description: beat grid: digits land on eighth notes

x-opus.useFor: Bold documentary, anniversary and report openers; launch numbers with real photos (pass src).

end-card-credits.title: End card credits — props
end-card-credits.description: Bottom scrim fades in over a drifting landscape; headline, mono stat lines and a credit stagger in with a blur fade-up, then fade to black.

headline.default: every pixel you just saw is math.

default: 0 images · 0 footage · 0 video models · 0 audio samples
terrain · erosion · light · sky · clouds · lens · music — 1,135 lines of code

backdrop.description: peaks (sunrise over mountains) | dunes | dusk | ocean | … scene behind

end-screen-cards.title: End screen with video cards — props
end-screen-cards.description: Outro screen: headline, two video-card slots (thumbnail or placeholder, label, running timer bar) and a round subscribe circle with a rotating ring of text and pulsing halos; everything rises in staggered, then a supporting line fades in. Lays out 3-across on 16:9 and stacks on 1:1 and 9:16.

circleLabel.description: text inside the circle when no circleSrc is given

circleSrc.description: channel avatar / logo picture for the circle

ringText.description: text that rotates around the circle (repeat it to fill the ring)

accent.description: brand colour of the circle, halos and timer bars

timerBars.description: show the running timer bar along the bottom of each card

event-ticket-reveal.title: Event ticket reveal & stub tear — props
event-ticket-reveal.description: An admission ticket slides in and settles, its event name, venue and details write on, a QR-style code scans in, then the stub tears off along the perforation while a shine sweeps the ticket and an "admit one" stamp lands.

eyebrow.description: small line above the title (e.g. "Live in concert")

eventName.description: event title (wraps to two lines, three in 9:16)

details.description: up to four {label, value} pairs shown in a grid (date, time, gate, seat…)

tear.description: tear the stub off at the end

background.description: frame colour (hex), or "transparent" to overlay content

fill-in-the-blank.title: Fill in the blank — props
fill-in-the-blank.description: A cloze exercise: a sentence with a pulsing blank, answer chips that pop in below, a wrong chip that is tried and bounces back with a shake and a cross, then the right chip arcs into the blank, turns green with a tick and sparkles and the feedback appears.

sentence.description: the sentence; write ___ (3 underscores) where the blank goes
sentence.default: The cat sat on the ___ all day.

options.description: answer chips shown below the sentence

tryWrongFirst.description: try a wrong option first (shake + cross) before the correct one lands

wrongText.description: message while the wrong option is in the blank

explanation.description: optional one-line explanation under the success banner (empty hides it)
explanation.default: A cat can sit on a mat, but not on the sky.

fontFamily.description: optional CSS font-family for the sentence and chips (empty = grotesk)

x-opus.useFor: Grammar and vocabulary exercises, language-learning reels, classroom quiz clips, ESL practice posts and "can you spot the right word?" engagement videos — pass the sentence with ___ for the blank, the options and the answer.

flashcard-flip-deck.title: Flashcard flip deck — props
flashcard-flip-deck.description: A study deck of flashcards: each card slides in showing the term, flips over in 3D to reveal its definition, then flies off as the next arrives, with a deck stack, progress dots, a counter and a deck-complete finish.

cards.description: array of {term, definition} cards, shown in order

default.definition: How plants turn sunlight, water and air into food.
The natural home where an animal or plant lives.
When liquid water warms up and rises as vapour.
The force that pulls objects toward each other.

termLabel.description: small label on the term side

definitionLabel.description: small label on the definition side

flipHint.description: hint line at the bottom of the term side (empty hides it)

accent.description: term-side card colour, progress dots, check mark

accent2.description: definition-side top stripe and label colour

x-opus.useFor: Vocabulary, revision and quiz-prep videos, language-learning reels, course trailers and "test yourself" social posts — pass your own cards (term + definition), labels and brand colours.

flipbook-riffle-outro.title: Flipbook riffle outro — props
flipbook-riffle-outro.description: A hand-drawn end card (scalloped red title plate, flame mascot, sparkles) pulls back in three drawings to become the top sheet of an animation-paper stack on a peg bar on a desk; a red pencil writes and circles the drawing count, a cartoon thumb lifts the corner and riffles back through earlier drawings on ones, then settles on the top sheet and the mascot winks.

subtitle.description: small caps line inside the plate

tagline.default: drawn one sheet at a time

countLabel.description: red-pencil drawing count that gets circled

sceneLabel.description: slate text top-left of every sheet

showFlame.description: flame mascot peeking over the plate

follower-milestone.title: Follower milestone — props
follower-milestone.description: A counter climbs to a milestone while a progress bar fills and little hearts float up; it lands with a shockwave, rays and a confetti burst, then a thank-you line pops in word by word.

glyph-fractal-push.title: Glyph fractal push — props
glyph-fractal-push.description: A big word on a phosphor terminal holds, then the camera pushes on an exponential curve into one glyph until you see it is made of lines of smaller text (names, logs, headlines); outside the glyph the text is barely visible.

innerText.description: strings that make up the small text (names, log lines, headlines); empty = 24 neutral placeholder names

glyph-orbit-logo.title: Glyph-orbit logo build — props

graduation-cap-toss.title: Graduation caps tossed in the air — props
graduation-cap-toss.description: Mortarboard caps are thrown up from below the frame, tumble with swinging tassels and fall away while confetti pops from both corners; Congratulations, the graduate name, a class pill and a tagline pop onto the frame, with a second smaller toss as finale.

halftone-exhibit-numeral.description: A giant rounded numeral bleeds off the right edge in flat yellow overprinted with an orange Ben-Day halftone clipped to the glyph, rising in with a back-ease behind a boiling evidence tag, while a misregistered slab headline drops letter by letter and a navy caption pill pops — all on mottled archive paper.

handwrite-on.title: Handwrite-on title — props

intertitle-card.description: A full-frame black painted silent-film card with an Art-Deco border whose ornament follows the emotion (narration, shout, tender, title), set in small-caps and italic serifs, with weave, flicker, scratches, dust and a hair of print damage.

iso-ground-title.description: A bold extruded wordmark that belongs to an isometric world: letters drop one by one onto the iso floor plane (16th-note stagger) with a contact shadow, a small bounce and a lean, a hairline rule draws under them, a tagline and a mono stats line type on flat on the plane, and a cyan floor ping closes it.

kinetic-captions.title: Kinetic word captions — props

knife-cut.title: Knife cut (strike a row out) — props

mask-rise-title.title: Mask-rise title — props
mask-rise-title.description: Editorial title whose letters rise out of baseline masks with motion blur; chapter variant rolls a red italic numeral and types a subtitle, stack variant builds an end-card headline.

variant.description: chapter (numeral + title + typed subtitle) | stack (end-card lines + side column) | water (caps rise from a thin waterline, damped overshoot + splash dots) | numeral (giant numeral climbing into a clip window in eased steps) | vertical (vertical word lockup + side line) | breathing (end card: dot drops, headline rises, rule, typed eyebrow, breathing dot with rings)

x-opus-optionLabels.water: caps rise from a thin waterline, damped overshoot + splash dots
x-opus-optionLabels.numeral: giant numeral climbing into a clip window in eased steps
x-opus-optionLabels.breathing: end card: dot drops, headline rises, rule, typed eyebrow, breathing dot with rings

chapter.description: {number, title, kicker?, subtitle?} shown (after the swap if fromChapter is set)

fromChapter.description: previous chapter shown first and swapped out at swapAt (null = enter fresh, numeral rolls from 00)

swapAt.description: frame the previous title exits upward

lines.description: stack: [{numeral?, word}] headline lines

sideCopy.description: stack: body lines in the right column

sideMono.description: stack: mono lines typed under the rule (last one in accent colour)

letterFrames.description: frames each letter takes to rise

progressRule.description: chapter: global progress rule + timecode at the bottom

exit.description: compress (chapter) or skew-slide (stack) out over the last 12 frames

backdrop.description: cream | ink | dunes | … (plain background colour for cream)

src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

text.description: variants water / numeral / vertical / breathing: the headline ('' = a built-in sample word per variant)

eyebrow.description: breathing: mono eyebrow typed above the headline behind a block cursor

sideLine.description: vertical: small tracked caps line running alongside the vertical word

dotColor.description: breathing: accent dot colour (also its rings and the rule tick)

breathPeriod.description: breathing: seconds per breath (dot swells, ring emitted)

steps.description: numeral: number of eased climb steps

exitAt.description: water / numeral / vertical / breathing: frame to exit (0 = the last 12 frames when exit is true)

font.description: water / numeral / vertical / breathing: display | sans | serif | instrument | rounded | grotesk

x-opus.useFor: Chapter titles, principle/step headers, end-card headlines and list reveals.
x-opus.avoid: Change chapter / lines / sideCopy / sideMono (defaults like STAGING, 12 PRINCIPLES are sample text).

myth-vs-fact.title: Myth vs fact — props
myth-vs-fact.description: A MYTH card drops in, a red FALSE stamp slams across it and shakes the card, then the card flips in 3D to a FACT card with a green tick.

myth.description: the false claim (shown in quotes on the front card)
myth.default: We only use 10% of our brains.

fact.description: the correct statement (back of the card)
fact.default: Brain scans show that nearly every region is active over the course of a day.

stampText.description: word stamped across the myth (FALSE, BUSTED, WRONG...)

factStamp.description: small caption at the bottom of the fact card

fontFamily.description: optional CSS font-family for the statements (empty = grotesk)

startAt.description: frame the card starts dropping in

hold.description: frames the myth is read before the stamp lands

x-opus.useFor: Myth-busting beats, misconception explainers, health / science / finance "common belief vs reality" shorts, quiz answers — pass your own myth and fact.

neon-sign.title: Neon sign ignite — props
neon-sign.description: Dark plum plate on a brick wall; rounded neon lettering strikes on letter by letter with flicker, then hums, with one faulty letter stuttering and glow spilling onto the wall.

lines.description: [{text, color?, glow?, font?, size?}] neon lines stacked on the plate (size is relative to the first line)

igniteSpread.description: frames over which the letters strike in random order

faultyLetter.description: index (across all lines) of a letter that keeps stuttering; -1 = none

font.description: font role for lines without their own (neon = Tilt Neon)

tracking.description: letter spacing in em for the main font

pullBack.description: start tight on the plate and pull back after ignition

seed.description: changes the ignition order and stutters

script.description: script mode: a cursive neon word is traced on as unlit glass with a hot head, then the tube strikes on with a ballast flicker (uses the first line; default lines render "Midnight")

scriptFont.description: script: font role of the cursive word (hand = Caveat)

traceFrames.description: script: frames the trace takes (≈0.8 s in the source)

strikeEnvelope.description: script: per-frame brightness levels after the trace, then hum

glassColor.description: script: colour of the unlit glass tube

rotation.description: script: tilt in degrees (−8 italic placement)

noPlate.description: script: transparent background so the neon floats over another scene

x-opus.useFor: Shop/venue names, nightlife or retro beats, "open" moments and glowing titles.
x-opus.avoid: Change lines (default NOODLES / open late is sample text).

news-strap.title: News strap (broadcast lower third) — props
news-strap.description: Persistent broadcast lower third: lemon category tab on a paper strap with a lemon left bar, ink headline + olive caps sub-line, ink end block with the channel name, offset drop shadow and a mono source line; content changes flip vertically and the tab flashes on a new category. Overlay-capable (backdrop "none").

items.description: strap states [{at (frame), tab, tab2?, headline, sub, source?, tag?}] — tag shows the top-left ILLUSTRATION-style corner tag

default.headline: Lumen opens its first research lab

channel.description: channel name in the end block

outAt.description: frame it wipes out (0 = never; straps hold for the programme)

backdrop.description: "studio" (ink studio with glow, fins and dot grid) or "none" (overlay)

disclaimer.description: small caps disclaimer under the strap

x-opus.useFor: News / market / update videos, podcast name straps (PROFILE tab), changelog bulletins — one strap that holds the headline for the whole programme.

newsreel-ident.title: Newsreel ident (searchlights & globe) — props
newsreel-ident.description: Late-1920s newsreel opener: searchlight beams snap on with a flash and sweep from the bottom corners, a 36-wedge sunburst turns slowly, a shaded wireframe globe grows and spins, the channel name lands in Art-Deco silver lettering with a big overshoot over a spaced subtitle, and an iris closes on the globe.

subtitle.description: spaced caps line under the title

tagline.description: small line above the globe ("" to hide)

irisOut.description: iris to black at the end

silver.description: four stops of the silver lettering gradient

x-opus.useFor: Vintage intros and outros for history channels, anniversaries, retro launches, "this week in…" shows; reprise it as the end card.

number-counter.title: Number counter — props
number-counter.description: Huge thin-mono counter that ticks or odometer-rolls through dwell keyframes, with unit, label and derived readouts (pressure, light, temperature, percent).

keyframes.description: [[frame, value], …] monotone-cubic; put two close keys to dwell (slow down) near a landmark

mode.description: roll (odometer digit strips with motion blur) | tick (re-typeset each frame) | lock (digits spin, lock one by one) | scramble (glyph noise + trail + drop) | flap (split-flap tiles) | clock (time-lapse clock)

x-opus-optionLabels.roll: odometer digit strips with motion blur
x-opus-optionLabels.lock: digits spin, lock one by one

label.description: small tracked label above the number

decimals.description: decimal places (tick mode; roll mode uses integers)

readouts.description: derived stats under the number: pressure | light | temp | percent | rate

layout.description: center (big, standalone) | hud (top-left overlay block like video23)

gauge.description: semicircle gauge above the number (video17 anticipation meter); centre layout only

size.description: number size in px at 1080p (auto-shrinks to fit)

labelSize.description: label size in px at 1080p (centre layout)

backdrop.description: ocean | ink | dunes | … scene behind

linkBackdrop.description: ocean backdrop darkens with the value (log scale) like a dive

src.description: optional public/ image behind
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

lockStart.description: lock / scramble / flap modes: frame the first character locks (or flips)

lockStep.description: lock mode: frames between one character locking and the next (a sixteenth note at your tempo)

lockOrder.description: lock / scramble: ltr | rtl character lock order

glyphs.description: scramble: glyph set the unlocked digits flicker through (empty = digits)

accentOnLock.description: locked characters flash in the accent colour for 6 frames

flashFrame.description: one-frame brightness flash when a character locks

progressBar.description: thin accent progress bar under the number while it locks

flapFrom.description: flap mode: starting value (default = first keyframe value); ends on the max keyframe

flapStagger.description: flap mode: frames between tiles starting to flip

flipFrames.description: flap mode: frames one tile flip takes (0.26 s = 8)

callout.description: flap mode: text that pops under the number after the last flip (e.g. "×2")

clockStart.description: clock mode: start time in seconds since midnight (25200 = 07:00)

clockRate.description: clock mode: [[frame, rate]] time-lapse speed; the clock integrates it

speedTag.description: clock mode: show ×N TIME-LAPSE / ×1 REAL TIME tag

block.description: block background colour behind the number (hook look, e.g. #FFD60A); "" = none

kicker.description: hook line slamming in above the number

rollDuration.description: block hook: seconds of the scale slam

x-opus.useFor: Depth/altitude/speed meters, growing stats, countdowns, progress percentages and scoreboards.
x-opus.avoid: Set label, unit ('' to hide 'm'), readouts [] and keyframes — defaults are the DEPTH dive sample.

outline-to-fill-text.title: Outline to fill text — props
outline-to-fill-text.description: A headline appears as hollow outlined letters, then each letter floods with solid colour one after another — rising like liquid with a wavy surface or wiping up, down, left or right (optional top-to-bottom gradient) — and can drain back to an outline; long text wraps and shrinks to fit.

text.description: the headline (\n = forced break; wraps and shrinks to fit)

subtitle.description: optional small line under the headline

font.description: font role (heavy display faces read best)

size.description: max font size in u; shrinks to fit

direction.description: wipe direction: up | down | left | right (liquid always rises)

surface.description: liquid (wavy rising surface) | wipe (hard straight edge)

fillDelay.description: frames after the outline appears before the first fill starts

stagger.description: frames between neighbouring letters starting to fill

fillFrames.description: frames one letter takes to fill

cycle.description: fill (stay filled) | fill-unfill (drain back to outline at the end)

x-opus-optionLabels.fill-unfill: drain back to outline at the end

holdFilled.description: frames the filled text holds before it drains

stroke.description: outline weight as a fraction of the font size

fill2.description: optional second colour: fill becomes a top-to-bottom gradient per letter ("" = solid)

x-opus.useFor: Bold website hero words, section titles, poster-style stat words, title cards and reel openers; works as a looping brand headline.

paper-strip-title.title: Paper strip title (scroll unroll + seal) — props
paper-strip-title.description: Vertical columns of brush calligraphy on cut gold-paper strips unroll from their anchor edge one per beat — the strip is uncovered, glyphs never squash — each casting a soft shadow, then a small red seal stamps beside the last column; a horizontal serif mode unrolls lines the same way.

columns.description: vertical: one string per column (right to left); horizontal: one per line

vertical.description: vertical CJK columns (true) or horizontal serif lines

columnFrames.description: frames each column takes to unroll

stagger.description: frames between columns (or land them on spoken words)

backdrop.description: backdrop colour behind the strips

background.description: "backdrop" or "transparent" (overlay over any scene, e.g. lightbox-stack)

x-opus.useFor: East-Asian festival titles, poems, recipes, letters, wedding / anniversary cards; any "unrolling scroll" title over a dark scene.

per-letter-wave.title: Per-letter wave — props
per-letter-wave.description: Every letter rides a travelling wave: it lifts, scales, rocks or all three, so a crest runs through the words — smooth sine, bouncing hops, a single ripple or a swing — with crest letters shifting to the accent colour; letters pop in on a stagger, long text wraps, and the clip loops seamlessly.

text.description: the text (\n = forced break; wraps and shrinks to fit)

shape.description: sine | bounce | ripple | swing — wave profile

effect.description: lift | scale | rotate | lift-scale — what the wave moves

amplitude.description: wave height as a fraction of the font size

speed.description: wave cycles per second (integer values loop seamlessly on the default 5 s)

colorWave.description: letters shift towards the accent colour on the crest

entrance.description: pop | rise | none — how letters first appear

size.description: max font size in u; shrinks to fit

shadow.description: soft drop shadow that follows each letter

x-opus.useFor: Playful titles, loading and waiting states, "hello" greetings, party / music / kids content, website hero words, looping caption accents; replace the text.

pixel-logo-drop.title: Pixel logo drop — props
pixel-logo-drop.description: A chunky gold pixel-glyph logo falls with gravity, lands on a white flash frame, squashes and rebounds in 2-frame steps with a screen shake, puffs dithered dust and sparks, gets a diagonal shine sweep and corner glints; a red ribbon unfolds under it, types a subtitle and PRESS START blinks.

title.description: logo text (caps, 5x7 pixel glyphs; wraps per word in portrait)

subtitle.description: text typed on the ribbon (empty = no ribbon)

pressStart.description: blinking line at the bottom (empty = none)

fillRamp.description: four gold colours, light (top rows) to dark (bottom rows)

seed.description: seed for stars, dust and sparks

x-opus.useFor: Retro title cards, game-jam and stream intros, "achievement unlocked" end cards.

qa-slide.title: Q&A slide — props
qa-slide.description: Keynote Q&A slide: a question lands beside an accent "Q" badge, three thinking dots pulse in the answer card, then the answer reveals word by word; several pairs play in turn with a counter.

items.description: array of {question, answer} — each pair plays for holdFrames (up to 8)

default.question: How long does it take to get started?
default.answer: Most teams are up and running in under an hour. Import your data, invite your colleagues and you are done.

default.question: What happens to our data if we leave?
default.answer: You can export everything in open formats at any time, and we delete your copy within thirty days on request.

holdFrames.description: frames each question/answer pair stays on screen

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay content

fontFamily.description: question font: sans | serif | display | grotesk | rounded | instrument | mono

x-opus.useFor: FAQ and Q&A segments in decks, webinars and explainer videos, "common questions" slides, interview-style answers and objection handling beats.

quiz-question-reveal.title: Quiz question reveal — props
quiz-question-reveal.description: A QUIZ tag and question, lettered option cards dealing in, a draining timer ring with a countdown, then the correct option lights up with a tick and a pulse while the rest dim.

question.default: Which planet in our solar system has the most moons?

correct.description: zero-based index of the correct option

timerSeconds.description: length of the countdown ring in seconds

accent2.description: colour of the timer in its last third

x-opus.useFor: Quiz shorts, "can you guess" engagement beats, classroom / course videos, trivia — pass the question, options and the correct index.

quote-slide.title: Quote slide — props
quote-slide.description: Keynote quote slide: giant accent quote mark pops in, the quote reveals word by word / typed / line by line, then name and role slide in beside an optional round portrait.

quote.description: the quote text (wraps and shrinks to fit; no quote marks needed)
quote.default: Good design is mostly about removing everything that gets in the way of the idea.

src.description: optional portrait image (public/ path or URL); empty = type only
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

reveal.description: words | type | fade — how the quote appears

fontFamily.description: quote font: serif | sans | display | grotesk | rounded | instrument

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay content

accent.description: quote mark, bar and rule colour

revealFrames.description: frames the quote takes to reveal

x-opus.useFor: Testimonial and pull-quote slides, customer or founder quotes in pitch decks, interview highlights, quote cards for social and videos.

ransom-note-type.title: Ransom-note type — props
ransom-note-type.description: Each letter sits on its own scrap of paper (newsprint, red, black, white) with a different typeface, slightly rotated and jittered, slapped onto kraft one by one; then a diagonal black band with condensed caps, a torn masthead strip and a speech scrap slap in.

text.description: the headline; every letter gets its own scrap

tiles.description: scrap styles cycled over letters: red | black | paper | news

band.description: text of the diagonal band (empty to hide)

masthead.description: torn strip masthead (shown at the top)

stepFrames.description: frames between letters (5 = one per 16th at 90 bpm)

x-opus.useFor: Punk and editorial titles, music promos, meme captions and zine-style hero words. Distinct from comic-burst and stamp-slam.

rolling-credits.title: Rolling credits — props
rolling-credits.description: Credits that roll up from a list of {role, names[]} sections under a title: roles in small tracked accent caps beside (landscape) or above (portrait) the names, soft edge fade, a steady scroll that settles on the closing line at the end, or beat-locked glides (set a bpm) that land one section per bar for music.

layout.description: auto | split (role left, names right) | stack (role above names, centred)

bpm.description: 0 = steady scroll to the end; e.g. 96 = glide to a new block every `beatsPerStep` beats

beatsPerStep.description: beats between blocks when bpm is set (4 = one per bar)

background.description: backdrop colour, or "transparent" to roll over footage

x-opus.useFor: End credits for films, videos and podcasts, "made by" rolls, cast / crew / thanks lists; pass bpm to match the music.

rsvp-invite-card.title: RSVP invite card with button press — props
rsvp-invite-card.description: An invitation card rises into place, its title, host and icon rows (date, time, place, dress code) pop in, then a pointer glides to the RSVP button and presses it: ripple, a confirmed check state, confetti and a "see you there" line.

title.description: event name (wraps to up to three lines)

host.description: host / organiser line under the title

details.description: up to four {icon, label, value} rows (icons: calendar, clock, pin, hanger, gift, star, heart, ticket, phone)

thanks.description: line that replaces the reply-by note after the press

background.description: frame colour (hex), or "transparent" to overlay content

accent.description: header panel, icon and button colour (hex)

x-opus.useFor: Party, wedding, webinar, launch-event and meetup invitations, RSVP reminders, event sign-up promos, "reserve your spot" call-to-actions. Replace the title, host, details (icon: calendar, clock, pin, hanger, gift, star, heart, ticket, phone) and the colours.

rundown-board.title: Rundown board (today in this video) — props
rundown-board.description: News rundown: a date block (huge numerals, lemon month, mono week, title) pushes up out of masks while ink story rows with lemon number blocks flip open one per beat with a light sweep; the first row pulses; in recap a lemon tick disc pops onto each row.

mode.description: "open" (rows flip in), "recap" (rows already in, ticks pop) or "both" (open then tick off)

rowEvery.description: frames between row flips (one per beat)

tickAt.description: frame the first tick pops (mode both)

highlightFirst.description: pulse an outline on the first row

backdrop.description: "studio" or "none" (overlay)

x-opus.useFor: "Today in this video" agendas, episode chapter lists, top-N intros and tick-off recaps at the end.

sale-countdown-banner.title: Sale countdown banner — props
sale-countdown-banner.description: Promo banner: headline pill, a huge discount that slams in, a subtitle, a flip-style hours/min/sec countdown, a pulsing call-to-action pill and a scrolling ribbon.

discount.description: the big number / text, e.g. "50%" or "$20"

subtitle.description: one or two lines under the discount
subtitle.default: Everything in the store. Today only.

unitLabels.description: three labels under the timer boxes (hours, minutes, seconds)

timerSeconds.description: timer value at the start, in seconds

tickSpeed.description: timer seconds that pass per video second (1 = real time)

ribbon.description: text that scrolls along the bottom ribbon
ribbon.default: Limited time  •  Free shipping  •  While stock lasts  •

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay content

x-opus.useFor: Flash sales, launch / early-bird offers, Black-Friday style promos, "ends soon" ads, limited-time offers, social and e-commerce video ads.

scene-tag.title: Scene index tag — props
scene-tag.description: Small glass pill in a corner with an index number, a hairline and a name; slides in, holds, fades. Transparent overlay.

tone.description: light (for dark scenes) | dark (for bright scenes)

background.description: "transparent" to overlay (default shows a preview colour)

variant.description: pill (default) | fighter (slanted halftone name plate + sub-bar; name, family = sub-line, color, side, drift, subDelay) | terminal (typed '> ID' box; index = id, name = description, color = box fill, charsPerSecond) | badge (pill logo with cat ears + episode tag; name, episode, ears, idleBob, twitchAt) | flag (bottom event bar; index + name, color)

x-opus-optionLabels.fighter: slanted halftone name plate + sub-bar; name, family = sub-line, color, side, drift, subDelay
x-opus-optionLabels.terminal: typed '> ID' box; index = id, name = description, color = box fill, charsPerSecond
x-opus-optionLabels.badge: pill logo with cat ears + episode tag; name, episode, ears, idleBob, twitchAt
x-opus-optionLabels.flag: bottom event bar; index + name, color

color.description: fighter / terminal / badge / flag: main fill colour

side.description: fighter: which side the plate slides in from

drift.description: fighter: slow drift while held, as a fraction of the width

subDelay.description: fighter: frames before the sub-bar appears

charsPerSecond.description: terminal: typing speed (0 = 40, or 110 when the tag lives < 1.5 s)

twitchAt.description: badge: frames at which an ear twitches

x-opus.useFor: Labelling items in showreels, galleries, portfolios, product feature tours and step-by-step videos.

slice-assemble-glyph.title: Slice-assemble glyph — props
slice-assemble-glyph.description: On black, a big word cut into 8–10 horizontal slices of different heights flies in from both sides at different speeds (some overshoot or sit misaligned like a glitch) and locks into place; a mono caption decodes under it and a red dot pops on at its top-right.

text.description: the word / glyphs to assemble (CJK works if a system font has the glyphs)

caption.description: mono caption that decodes under the word ("" = none)

spread.description: scale of the slices’ start offsets (1 = 0.3–0.6 W)

frames.description: assembly window in frames (each slice flies for 45–90 % of it, starts in its first 40 %)

glitchAt.description: frames where a short glitch re-slice happens while holding ([] = none)

x-opus.useFor: Punchy logo / word reveals with a clean glitch flavour; display type and CJK titles; chapter openers on dark.

split-flap-board.title: Split-flap board — props
split-flap-board.description: A mechanical split-flap (Solari) departure board: a grid of two-half flap cells clatters through the alphabet, the upper flap folding down and the lower flap of the new letter dropping in, rippling across the board to spell each message in turn — auto-sized to the text, wrapped to the board width.

messages.description: array of messages shown one after another; \n starts a new row, long rows wrap to the board width
default:
WELCOME
TO THE SHOW
DOORS OPEN 7PM

title.description: small label above the board ("" to hide)

accentRows.description: row numbers (0-based) drawn in the accent colour

alphabet.description: characters the flaps cycle through, in order

columns.description: board width in cells (0 = fit the longest line, capped per format)

flipFrames.description: frames per single flap (2 = fast clatter, 5 = lazy)

maxFlips.description: most flaps a cell flips before landing (long cycles are shortened to this)

colStagger.description: frames between neighbouring columns starting to flip

jitter.description: random extra start delay per cell in frames

startAt.description: frame the first message starts flipping

hold.description: frames a message stays readable before the next one flips

uppercase.description: upper-case all text (the default alphabet is upper-case)

x-opus.useFor: Announcements, schedules, countdown/updates, retro tech titles, "coming soon" reveals, scoreboards and price boards; give it messages[] with \n for rows.

sponsor-slate.title: Sponsor slate — props
sponsor-slate.description: A "presented by" label flanked by drawing rules, a rounded panel that scales up carrying the sponsor logo (picture or wordmark) with a sheen pass, an optional offer pill and a small disclaimer line, then a fade out.

label.description: small tracked label above the panel (e.g. "presented by", "in partnership with")

name.description: sponsor wordmark shown when no src is given

src.description: sponsor logo picture (public/ path or URL, transparent PNG/SVG best)
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

offer.description: optional pill under the panel, e.g. "Code SAVE10 for 10% off" ("" = none)

disclaimer.description: small disclosure line at the bottom ("" = none)
disclaimer.default: This video is sponsored. All opinions are our own.

background.description: backdrop colour, or "transparent" to sit over footage

accent.description: rules, panel outline and offer pill colour

panelColor.description: logo panel fill (pick one the logo reads on)

fadeOut.description: fade out over the last 16 frames

x-opus.useFor: Sponsor reads and "this video is brought to you by" slates, partner credits, event sponsor cards and disclosure lines.

stacked-repeat-echo.title: Stacked repeat echo — props
stacked-repeat-echo.description: A headline repeated again and again behind itself: copies peel off the crisp front word one after another as offset outlines marching up or down (or alternating solid and hollow, a zooming tunnel, a diagonal trail or a fan), fading from one accent to a second, then breathing slowly.

text.description: the headline (\n = forced break; wraps and shrinks to fit)

count.description: how many echoes behind the front word

mode.description: stack (offset copies) | tunnel (growing copies) | diagonal (trail) | fan (rotating copies)

spread.description: distance between echoes as a fraction of the font size

fade.description: 0..1 how much the echoes fade towards the back

float.description: 0..1 amount of slow breathing after the echoes settle

size.description: max font size in u; shrinks so the stack fits

stagger.description: frames between successive echoes peeling off

stroke.description: outline weight as a fraction of the font size

x-opus.useFor: Bold poster-style hero words, music / fashion / sport titles, repeating-text backdrops behind a subject, section openers; replace the text and colours.

stamp-slam.title: Stamp slam + keyword pop — props
stamp-slam.description: A rotated vermilion label slams down from 1.3x like a rubber stamp over the scene (the serif title blurs away), then a huge keyword punches in.

lines.description: stamp lines; the 2nd+ lines render 1.25x (years / numbers)

preTitle.description: serif title shown first that blurs out as the stamp lands ("" = none)

keyword.description: big word that pops later ("" = none)

keywordStyle.description: plain | box (outlined plate) | indicator (video19 3-node slider under the word)

x.description: stamp centre x as a fraction of width

y.description: stamp centre y as a fraction of height (video10 ≈ 0.18–0.22)

keywordFont.description: keyword font role (sans = Inter heavy, display = Archivo Black)

size.description: stamp text size in px at 1080p

push.description: slow scene push-in amount over the clip

backdrop.description: dusk | peaks | warm | comic | … procedural scene behind

src.description: optional public/ image as the scene
src.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

variant.description: stamp (slam) | seal (small square seal, glyph lines knocked out in the text colour, wet -> dry fade; try color '#B02E22', textColor '#f3ead8', size 40, lines ['朱','印'] or 2-4 letters)

x-opus-optionLabels.seal: small square seal, glyph lines knocked out in the text colour, wet -> dry fade; try color '#B02E22', textColor '#f3ead8', size 40, lines ['朱','印'] or 2-4 letters

sting-bug.title: News sting → channel bug — props

text-scramble-decode.title: Text scramble decode — props
text-scramble-decode.description: A headline starts as flickering random glyphs (blocks, symbols, binary or your own charset) and each character locks onto its real letter in turn — left to right, centre out, edges in or random — flashing the accent colour as it lands, with an optional "decoding 64%" status line and bar; wraps and shrinks for long text, optional scramble-out.

eyebrow.description: small status label above the text ("" to hide)

showProgress.description: show the % counter and progress bar

charset.description: glyphs | binary | hex | letters | symbols | digits — or any string whose characters are used as the noise

x-opus-optionLabels.digits: or any string whose characters are used as the noise

x-opus-optionLabels.random: order in which glyphs lock in

scrambleEvery.description: frames between noise changes (1 = frantic, 4 = calm)

type-architecture.title: Type architecture (credits as a set) — props
type-architecture.description: One line of credits fills the frame as a set: letters stand as black cut-paper pillars, words ride as train carriages on wheels (or colonnade bays) on a flat red ground with telegraph wires behind, while a silhouette agent runs the rooftops, leaps the word gaps and ducks behind the line; the camera opens wide, trucks with the chase and pulls back.

type-marquee-field.title: Type marquee field — props
type-marquee-field.description: A heavy grotesk word rises letter by letter from a baseline mask (a red dot replaces one letter), then outline and solid rows of the word fill the frame, marquee-scrolling in alternating directions while the whole field rolls ≈ −8° and pushes in.

outlineEvery.description: rows alternate outline/solid with this period (1 = all outline, 0 = all solid)

roll.description: final roll of the field in degrees

push.description: final push-in scale

rowsAt.description: frame the rows start fading in (roll/push follow)

hud.description: show the reel HUD (crop marks, label, timecode, segment bar)

x-opus.useFor: Kinetic-type backgrounds for a brand word, poster-style title cards, a "type" chapter in a principles reel.

typewriter-code.title: Typewriter code window — props
typewriter-code.description: macOS-style code editor or terminal window that types syntax-coloured code with a block cursor; the panel grows upward line by line.

phrases.description: phrases typed, held and deleted one after another

ui-shape-morph.title: UI shape morph (one shape, many states) — props
ui-shape-morph.description: One rounded rectangle never cuts: it grows from a button into a loader, a check, a pill, a player, a slider, a toggle, tabs, a chart, a search box and a toast and back, one change per beat on spring physics (leading edges stiffer than trailing edges so it stretches), content cross-blurring inside while the camera keeps the active state framed; the last frame equals the first.

states.description: [{kind:'button'|'loader'|'check'|'pill'|'player'|'slider'|'toggle'|'tabs'|'chart'|'search'|'toast', label, width, height, radius (u), color, content?, action? (toast button word, default 'Undo')}] — end with a copy of the first state to loop

accent.description: accent used inside sliders, charts, search caret

frameFill.description: fraction of the frame the active state fills (0.6)

cursor.description: show a small cursor that operates each state

x-opus.useFor: Product promos, app-store previews, onboarding heroes and "what our app does" loops: edit the `states` table (kind, label, size, radius, colour), set `accent` and `beatFrames` to your music; pairs with cursor-driver.

upload-progress.title: Upload progress card — props
upload-progress.description: A file card with an extension badge, file name and size: the progress bar fills with stop-and-go speed and a live percentage, then turns green with a check at 100%. Enters and leaves so it loops.

fileName.description: file name (its extension becomes the badge)

fileSize.description: total size as a number (shown as "x of y")

sizeUnit.description: unit label after the size (MB, KB, GB)

speedLabel.description: optional speed text next to the status (empty to hide)

showCancel.description: show a small "Cancel" link while uploading

background.description: frame colour, or "transparent" to overlay content

x-opus.useFor: Upload / download / export states, file-sharing and cloud-storage product demos, "your file is being processed" beats, app-store style screenshots.

versus-roster.title: Versus roster — props
versus-roster.description: A row of square contender portraits separated by "vs", each in white corner brackets with a small name above; cards cut in from black, then each one in turn scales up while a mono bio types in below it, on a Klein-blue terminal screen with a scramble-decoded header and blackletter call to action.

cards.description: contenders: {name, bio, src?} (src = public/ image path; otherwise an abstract generated portrait)

default.name: General Onyx
default.bio: Cold, fast and blunt. I strike first and explain myself after the dust settles.

default.name: General Atlas
default.bio: Patient strategist. I map every ridge and river before a single soldier moves.

default.name: General Vega
default.bio: I see the whole board at once and play three turns ahead of everyone else.

default.name: General Nova
default.bio: Warm voice, iron will. I win by keeping my army alive longer than yours.

images.description: portrait images by index (alternative to cards[].src)
images.x-opus-hint: path inside the served public folder ("demo/owl.jpg") or an absolute https:// / data: URL; empty = built-in picture

colors.description: accent colour per contender (name highlight while hovered, avatar tint)

header.description: mono header above the row (scramble-decodes in)

cta.description: blackletter call to action, shown as [ … ]

x-opus.useFor: "Four contenders" intros for comparisons, tournaments, model or product line-ups and team introductions.
